Company :

United Concordia Dental

Job Description :

Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. independently. At this time, we do not offer visa sponsorship for this role.


The Summer 2027 UCD Business PMO Undergraduate Internship provides students with an opportunity to gain hands-on experience supporting strategic business, automation, and artificial intelligence initiatives within the UCD Business Project Management Office (PMO). This internship is designed to develop the next generation of diverse business and technology professionals through direct exposure to project management, process automation, analytics, and AI-driven business transformation efforts.

As a member of the UCD Business PMO team, the intern will contribute to a high-impact summer project supporting the organization's Automation and Artificial Intelligence portfolio. Working alongside project leaders, business stakeholders, and technical teams, the intern will assist in identifying opportunities to enhance efficiency, streamline processes, and support the implementation of innovative solutions that drive business value.


The internship provides hands-on exposure to project management practices, AI use case development, business process improvement, automation technologies, and data analytics. Interns will have the opportunity to work with tools such as Microsoft Power Automate and Power BI while gaining practical experience supporting automation initiatives, business intelligence reporting, and digital transformation efforts. Additionally, the role will include supporting the translation and conversion of existing SAS programs and code into modern analytics languages such as R and Python, helping advance organizational analytics capabilities.


Typical responsibilities include supporting the day-to-day operating objectives of the UCD Business PMO, participating in automation and AI-related projects, assisting with project planning and coordination activities, conducting research and analysis, developing reports and dashboards, contributing to AI use case development, and providing recommendations that support operational efficiency and strategic decision-making. Through mentorship, collaboration, and project-based learning, interns will strengthen their technical, analytical, business, and project management skills while gaining valuable exposure to enterprise transformation initiatives.

SUMMARY OF JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

This job has the goal of providing the opportunity to acquire practical experience through direct exposure to the related business line(s) and to develop the next generation of diverse business professionals. To that end, the program will provide hands-on training and experience in the business line, expose the various career opportunities in the business line and related areas, and prepare participants for positions in the business.

Typical responsibilities include, providing services to the day-to-day operating objectives of the assigned area, participating in projects and programs appropriate to the needs of the assigned area, participating in the planning and implementation of projects and initiatives, conducting research and reporting including recommendations or proposals for action.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Full or part-time enrollment in an accredited college or university baccalaureate program.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Pursuing a degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Management Information Systems (MIS), Business Analytics, Project Management, or a related field.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS
1. Communicate effectively while interacting directly with colleagues, clientele, and/or other internal or external constituencies in the planning of assignments and the resolution of day-to-day operational problems.


2. Under supervision, provide entry-level professional services as appropriate to the day-to-day operating objectives of the area. Receives guidance, training, and mentoring from senior personnel in planning and carrying out activities and assignments.


3. Undertake and/or participates in projects and programs designed to develop professional skills and expertise appropriate to the needs of the organization.


4. Participate in the planning and implementation of unit projects and initiatives within area of expertise and ability.


5. As specifically requested by management, conduct research and reporting inclusive of recommendations or alternative proposals for action.


6. Undertake related studies or enrichment programs as appropriate to the specific objectives of the operating unit.


7. Perform miscellaneous job-related duties as assigned.

jobs.title: Growth Lead
jobs.excerpt: We are looking for a Growth Lead to work with us remotely.
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Growth Lead to work with us remotely.

About Us

Founded in 2006, CXG is a global customer experience uniquely positioned at the intersection of data-driven retail performance, customer experience transformation, and operational execution across 200+ luxury brands worldwide.

The mission of our 270 collaborators is to help brands transform customer and employee experiences through tailored insights, strategy, and implementation. We are passionate about delivering impact.

Our clients include the world’s most admired luxury houses, and our solutions combine research, technology, and human expertise to elevate every customer interaction.

Your role

As Growth Lead, you lead and manage the full acquisition process for Evaluators in Japan. Your mandate is to design, test, and scale acquisition channels by blending global brand positioning with strong local adaptation across Japanese platforms, digital culture, and community engagement practices. You will combine strategic planning with hands-on execution: building local playbooks, running campaigns, owning key growth metrics. This role operates in a matrix reporting to both the local and global teams.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Local Growth Strategy & Planning

  • Own the Japan growth strategy for Evaluator acquisition, aligned with profile needs and country targets.
  • Localize global playbooks for Japanese platforms, culture, and applicable guidelines, in collaboration with relevant stakeholders.
  • Identify, prioritize, and test new channels (campus programs, communities, influencers, niche platforms).

2. Lead Generation & User Acquisition

  • Design and run multi-channel acquisition campaigns (online, offline, social, partnerships).
  • Lead social recruiting on LINE, Instagram, TikTok and other relevant local platforms.
  • Build and manage university, travel, and auto community programs to source qualified Evaluators.
  • Implement direct recruitment campaigns and processes with full autonomy to design and execute strategies.
  • Own performance and budget across channels, optimizing for volume, quality, and cost per qualified lead.

3. Funnel Management & Optimization

  • Own the acquisition funnel from first touch to qualified Evaluator.
  • Diagnose drop-offs in the funnel and partner with Operations and Growth & Engagement teams to adjust targeting, messaging, and incentives.
  • Run structured A/B tests (audiences, creatives, offers, sequencing, timing) to improve sign-up and qualification rates.
  • Build and maintain clear, simple processes so the funnel can be scaled.

4. Data, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Define, track, and report on core acquisition KPIs
  • Maintain dashboards and campaign reports; turn data into concrete next steps, not just slides.
  • Use CRM/marketing tools (Clay, HubSpot, etc.) to structure outreach lists, automations, and follow-ups.
  • Build repeatable playbooks and documentation so Japan can scale beyond a single operator.

5. Communication & Collaboration

  • Partner closely with the Operations team to ensure a smooth handover from qualified Evaluator to first mission.
  • Share funnel insights with Operations (profile quality, channel differences, expectations) to help them optimize activation.
  • Develop and execute targeted communication to nurture potential Evaluators through qualification (email, messaging, content).
  • Write clear, concise marketing and recruiting materials in English and Japanese.
  • Take ownership of projects end-to-end, managing multiple initiatives and stakeholders at once.

Requirements

What you bring along:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, communications, or related field (Master’s is a plus).
  • 3+ years in growth, recruiting, and community engagement in Japan, with clear examples of owning targets.
  • Native-level Japanese and strong business English (written and spoken).
  • Hands-on experience in at least two of: University/campus recruiting or Gig/platform or marketplace recruiting
  • Experience with influencer/social media campaigns
  • Strong analytical skills; comfortable with funnel metrics and campaign reporting.
  • Practical experience with CRM and marketing tools (e.g., HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce), design tools (e.g., Canva), and AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney, Bard).

Role Title: Hospitalist Physician

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Hospitalist Physicians to contribute their medical expertise to a customer project focused on inpatient care and documentation standards. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.

Scope of Work

  1. Review medical records, including FHIR data and clinical notes for AI Training.
  2. Check whether clinical information and claims are supported by the medical record.
  3. Review inpatient documentation, including HPI, PMH, assessments, and plans.
  4. Follow clear guidelines and apply the same standards consistently.
  5. Identify missing, incorrect, or inconsistent information in medical records.
  6. Share feedback to help improve AI models and data quality.
  7. Communicate clearly with the project team about your work and findings.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. MD or DO, board certified in Internal Medicine, Pediatrics, or Hospital Medicine.
  2. Current or recent inpatient/hospitalist experience (within the last 2 years).
  3. Strong understanding of inpatient documentation and hospital workflows.
  4. Comfortable reviewing clinical notes and raw medical record data.
  5. Strong attention to detail and ability to follow clear guidelines consistently.
  6. Experience with chart review, clinical documentation improvement, utilization review, or medical coding/QA is a plus.
  7. Experience working across different inpatient services or specialties is a plus.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

  • Proven commitment to providing exceptional client service (internal and external)

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills

JOB SUMMARY:

Join US Chemical as a Food Service Sales Director, leading a high-performing sales team focused on driving growth with a major food service distributor. In this role, you will serve as the primary customer-facing leader responsible for strengthening the partnership, expanding private label sales, and supporting growth across all classes of trade, with a strong focus on independent food service operators as well as regional and national chains.

This leader will guide a team that trains, supports, and motivates distributor sales representatives—who are primarily focused on selling food—to also sell non-food solutions, including kitchen cleaning products, front-of-house cleaning and sanitizing products, ware wash, and laundry solutions. The role requires close collaboration with cross-functional teams to execute marketing programs, advance joint business plans, maintain account health, and ensure operational excellence across pricing, delivery, supply, and service performance.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Develop and execute a joint growth and profitability plan with the strategic distributor, aligning priorities across private label growth, market share expansion, customer penetration, and category development.
  • Use shared data, customer insights, and field feedback to identify the highest-value opportunities across independent food service operators, regional and national chains, multi-unit accounts, and local market segments.
  • Translate strategic priorities into clear sales plays, resource plans, marketing programs, and execution expectations that drive retention, expansion, and revenue acceleration.
  • Negotiate strategic priorities, investment requirements, and program support using financial analysis, ROI discipline, and a clear understanding of distributor and customer economics.
  • Establish performance targets, monitor KPIs, and create shared accountability with the distributor and internal teams to ensure plans are executed and results are delivered.

Customer Partnership & Distributor Alignment

  • Serve as the primary liaison and senior customer-facing leader for the distributor relationship, building trust, reinforcing alignment, and ensuring both organizations remain focused on shared priorities.
  • Lead regular business reviews, planning sessions, and performance discussions that connect strategy, execution, financial results, operational needs, and future growth opportunities.
  • Champion a win/win partnership mindset by creating transparency, clarifying ownership, resolving issues, and ensuring distributor initiatives are aligned with internal sales and customer strategies.
  • Coordinate with distributor leadership and field teams to improve territory coverage, lead conversion, customer engagement, and execution of agreed-upon growth initiatives.

Team Development & Coaching

  • Recruit, hire, develop, and inspire a high-performing sales team with the capability to influence distributor sales representatives and drive non-food category growth.
  • Provide ongoing coaching, performance management, field support, and development planning to ensure team members are clear on priorities, accountable for results, and equipped to achieve their goals.
  • Build team discipline around customer planning, opportunity management, Salesforce.com accuracy, forecasting, business reviews, and execution follow-through.
  • Lead by example in complex customer conversations, strategic negotiations, and major account opportunities where senior-level alignment or deal support is required.

Performance & Revenue Management

  • Manage revenue, profitability, pipeline health, and sales performance against agreed-upon targets, using clear KPIs and regular performance routines to identify risks and opportunities early.
  • Leverage Salesforce.com and business reporting tools to improve visibility to opportunities, account health, activity quality, team execution, and forecast accuracy.
  • Oversee forecasting, budgeting, reporting, and business reviews to ensure the team is consistently tracking progress and delivering against expectations.
  • Use performance insights to adjust priorities, allocate resources, remove barriers, and improve execution across territories and customer segments.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with internal sales, marketing, supply chain, finance, pricing, customer service, and operations teams to support distributor priorities and improve the customer experience.
  • Lead execution of customer-specific marketing programs, sales campaigns, product initiatives, and joint business plan commitments from planning through field implementation.
  • Ensure the right internal stakeholders are aligned on pricing, delivery, supply needs, service expectations, issue resolution, and overall account health.
  • Drive customer satisfaction and value creation by connecting distributor needs with internal capabilities, resources, and solutions.

Sector & Product Expertise

  • Build strong knowledge of the institutional cleaning, food service sanitation, warewash, laundry, and front-of-house cleaning categories, including private label solutions, US Chemical & Diversey products, programs, and competitive alternatives.
  • Understand how food service distributor sales teams sell, what motivates their field execution, and how to position non-food solutions alongside core food sales priorities.
  • Enable the team and distributor sales representatives to clearly communicate customer value, product differentiation, compliance benefits, operational efficiency, and total cost impact.

Performance Reviews & Continuous Improvement

  • Conduct regular reviews with team members, distributor partners, customers, and internal stakeholders to evaluate progress, reinforce accountability, and identify areas for improvement.
  • Showcase delivered value, quantify results, capture lessons learned, and identify new opportunities to improve sales execution, customer penetration, operational performance, and partnership health.
  • Continuously refine playbooks, training approaches, reporting routines, and field execution strategies based on market feedback and performance trends.

Operational Excellence

  • Manage core administrative and operational responsibilities, including Salesforce updates, expense reporting, pricing coordination, performance reviews, development plans, budget oversight, and issue resolution.
  • Work cross-functionally to resolve pricing, delivery, supply, inventory, service, and account health issues in ways that support both customer satisfaction and business performance.
  • Ensure compliance with contractual terms, pricing policies, inventory expectations, and internal processes while maintaining the flexibility needed to support distributor success.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Food Service & Distribution Experience: Experience in food service, distribution management, or closely related channels, with an understanding of how to drive growth through distributor partnerships.
  • Proven People Leadership: A successful track record of recruiting, hiring, developing, performance managing, coaching, and motivating sales teams to deliver results.
  • Joint Business Planning: Demonstrated ability to develop, align, and execute joint business plans with strategic customers or distribution partners.
  • Customer-Facing Partnership Skills: Strong ability to serve as the main face to the customer, build trust, align priorities, and create shared accountability for growth and execution.
  • Sales Enablement Mindset: Experience training, supporting, and motivating distributor sales representatives to grow non-food categories alongside their core food sales priorities.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Skilled at aligning internal teams across sales, marketing, supply chain, finance, pricing, and operations to support customer success and account health.
  • Operational Discipline: Ability to manage pricing, delivery, supply, CRM updates, forecasting, reporting, and other core processes that support reliable execution.
  • Field Readiness: Willing and able to travel overnight, lift up to 40 lbs., and confidently operate/demo cleaning equipment.
  • Compliance Ready: Holds a valid U.S. driver’s license and meets all mobility requirements for the role.

WHAT WE OFFER:

Full benefits package, including medical, dental and vision coverage from your first day

401(k) with company matching

Company vehicle

Learning and development opportunities

Paid time off, holidays, sick time

In addition to strong scientific leadership, the role is expected to be highly client-facing with an increased business development component - requiring regular engagement at executive level, and the confidence and polish to represent Fortrea with senior client leaders, external partners, and other key stakeholders.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • High level Medical TA and Clinical Trial Subject Matter Expertise (SME) contributions (may be Regional or Global).
  • SME Cross-functional, scientific & technical contributions and interactions with Clients Medical teams, Project teams, Key Opinion Leaders and at Principal Investigator/Site levels.
  • Partner with clients and internal teams to support business development - shaping clinical/medical strategy for proposals, bid defences, and client discussions.
  • Provide oversight of medical monitoring activities to ensure timelines and quality of medical deliverables and assigns physician resources as required.

  • Prepares materials for and actively participates in investigator meetings and assists at site initiation visits.
  • Provides medical/scientific expertise to project team.
  • And any other duties as required or assigned.

YOU NEED TO BRING…

Qualifications (Minimum Required and preferred):

  • MD Degree
  • Board Certification in Internal Medicine
  • Specialization in Rheumatology and broader therapeutic experience in autoimmune diseases (AID)

jobs.excerpt: TTM Technologies, Inc.  – Publicly Traded US Company, NASDAQ (TTMI) – Top-5 Global Printed Circuit Board Manufacturer About TTMTTM Technologies, Inc.
jobs.description:
TTM Technologies, Inc. – Publicly Traded US Company, NASDAQ (TTMI) – Top-5 Global Printed Circuit Board Manufacturer

About TTM

TTM Technologies, Inc. is a leading global manufacturer of technology products, including mission systems, radio frequency (“RF”) components, RF microwave/microelectronic assemblies, and technologically advanced printed circuit boards (“PCB”s). TTM stands for time-to-market, representing how TTM's time-critical, one-stop design, engineering and manufacturing services enable customers to reduce the time required to develop new products and bring them to market.

Additional information can be found at www.ttm.com

Location:

North America. Preferences:

  • Chippewa Falls, WI
  • Eau Claire, WI
  • Syracuse, NY
  • Southern California (Santa Ana, San Diego)
  • Stafford/Stafford Springs, CT
  • Denver, CO
  • Remote – North America

Travel may be required to support talent initiatives across North America TTM sites.


POSITION SUMMARY

The Talent Management Partner Lead is a senior practitioner and people leader within TTM Technologies' Global Talent Management COE, anchored within the third arm of the TM COE dedicated to succession readiness, critical talent pool health, and organizational effectiveness.

This role works in close, day-to-day partnership with HR Business Partners (HRBPs) supporting critical and key talent — moving beyond advisory to direct execution. The Talent Management Partner Lead drives talent review cycles, succession planning, specific development programs, and targeted readiness and retention strategies from design through delivery, ensuring interventions are implemented, tracked, and producing measurable outcomes. Working alongside HRBPs, this role owns the identification, assessment, and development of critical talent within assigned client groups — translating talent data into clear, actionable insights and ensuring those insights result in real movement: successors' readiness, stronger talent pipelines, and enhanced retention of critical talent.

As a people leader, the Talent Management Partner Lead will build, develop, and manage a growing team of Talent Management Partners — setting the standard for quality talent work, coaching team members to operate with both strategic depth and executional rigor, and scaling the team's impact across the organization.

This individual operates with a high degree of autonomy while contributing to the broader goals of the Global Talent Management COE and the HR function.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


A. Strategic Talent Management

· Drive succession readiness across assigned North America client groups by building and maintaining robust successor pipelines for critical roles, ensuring depth of talent bench strength.

· Lead the identification, assessment, and development of critical talent pools — including high-potential (HiPo) employees — through structured talent reviews and calibration sessions facilitated in close partnership with HRBPs.

· Consult and partner with HRBPs on talent strategy and critical role planning within their assigned business units and sectors, serving as the dedicated talent management resource alongside the HRBP team.

· Build, monitor, and evolve succession readiness plans that align with business priorities for assigned client groups

· Assess organizational effectiveness to surface structural and capability gaps and recommend evidence-based interventions to the supporting HRBPs.

· Execute retention strategies including stay interviews, flight-risk identification, and targeted interventions for critical talent segments in partnership with HRBPs.

· Connect critical and high-potential talent to stretch assignments, mobility opportunities, and cross-functional experiences that accelerate readiness and development.

· Design and support targeted development programs in collaboration with Learning & Development and HRBPs to close identified capability gaps.

· Produce and maintain bench strength, pipeline readiness, and talent health reports; translate data into actionable insights for HR leadership and HRBP partners.

· Partner with HRBPs to ensure talent review action plan follow-through and drive accountability for critical talent outcomes within their client groups.


B. People Leadership & Team Development (M4 Managerial Responsibilities)

· Lead, coach, and develop direct reports, setting clear performance expectations and fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement.

· Translate the Talent strategy and vision into team priorities, operational plans, and measurable goals with clear ownership and accountability.

· Conduct regular one-on-ones, performance reviews, and development conversations to grow team members' functional expertise and career progression.

· Hire, onboard, and integrate new team members as the function scales; establish team norms, workflows, and an effective operating cadence.

· Model inclusive leadership behaviors and champion talent practices within the team.

· Identify and remove barriers to team effectiveness; escalate critical risks and resource needs as appropriate.

· Serve as a senior thought partner to the head of global talent management, contributing to the overall strategic direction of TM COE.


C. Strategic Partnership & COE Collaboration

· Build trusted, advisory relationships with HRBP partners to integrate talent strategy into their client group planning and people decisions.

· Communicate talent health, succession risk, and pipeline readiness to HRBP partners and senior HR stakeholders through structured reporting and clear, data-driven narratives.

· Collaborate with Learning & Development, Total Rewards, and other COE partners to source and connect high-impact interventions and development solutions that close succession gaps and enhance retention of critical talent.

· Champion consistent use of talent management tools, frameworks, and processes, aligning to Global TM COE standards.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

· Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Business Administration, or a related field.

· 8+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 5 years in talent management, organizational development, or a closely related specialty.

· Demonstrated experience designing and facilitating talent reviews, succession planning processes, and HiPo identification and development programs.

· Proven track record of consulting with and influencing senior HR partners (HRBPs) on talent strategy, critical role planning, and workforce capability.

· Experience managing or leading HR teams, including setting goals, developing talent, and driving accountability.

· Strong analytical skills with experience translating talent data and bench strength metrics into strategic recommendations.

· Excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to present complex talent insights clearly to HR leadership and HRBP audiences.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

· Master’s Degree in Human Resources, Organizational Psychology, or MBA with an HR concentration.

· Professional certification such as SHRM-SCP, SPHR, or a recognized talent management or coaching credential (e.g., SHL, Korn Ferry, DDI).

· Experience operating in a global, matrixed organization — ideally in manufacturing, technology, or defense/aerospace industries.

· Familiarity with psychometric and assessment tools used in talent identification and succession calibration.

· Experience building or scaling a talent management function or team.

· Proficiency with HRIS and talent management platforms (e.g., Workday, SAP SuccessFactors) and data visualization tools.


COMPETENCIES / SKILLS


Competency/Proficiency Level & Description

Talent Strategy & Succession Planning

Expert – Designs and drives end-to-end succession and talent pool strategies; builds pipeline depth for critical roles.

Consulting & Partnership

Expert – Serves as a dedicated talent management advisor to HRBPs; influences talent decisions without direct authority over client groups.

Organizational Effectiveness

Advanced – Assesses org structure and capability gaps within HRBP-supported areas; surfaces and recommends interventions.

People Leadership & Coaching

Advanced – Develops, coaches, and holds direct reports accountable; models inclusive leadership.

HiPo Identification & Development

Advanced – Designs and supports targeted programs and experiences for high-potential talent in partnership with stakeholders

Retention Strategy & Risk Management

Advanced – Conducts stay interviews, identifies critical talent flight risk, and executes targeted retention interventions.

Data Analysis & Reporting

Advanced – Translates bench strength and pipeline metrics into clear, actionable insights for HR and HRBP partners.

Clear Communication

Expert – Communicates complex talent topics clearly and concisely.

Performance Excellence

Advanced – Sets high standards for self and team; monitors outcomes and drives continuous improvement.

Integrity & Confidentiality

Expert – Handles sensitive talent and organizational data with the highest level of discretion and trust.


WORK ENVIRONMENT / PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

· Standard office or remote work environment; prolonged periods of sitting and working at a computer.

· Travel up to 20–25% within North America to support talent reviews, HRBP partner engagements, and team collaboration.

· Ability to work across time zones as needed to collaborate with distributed HR teams. #CORP

Work


Compensation and Benefits:

TTM offers a variety of health and well-being benefit programs. Benefit options include medical, dental, vision, 401K, Flexible Spending Account, Health Savings Account, accident benefits, life insurance, disability benefits, paid vacation & holidays. Benefits are available 1st of the month following date of hire.

Compensation for roles at TTM Technologies varies depending on a wide array of factors including but not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set and level of experience. As required by local law, TTM provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired in New York, California and Colorado. For California-based roles, compensation ranges are based upon specific physical locations.

Export Statement:
Must comply with TTM Export Control Policies and Procedures and all applicable laws including ITAR, EAR and OFAC including but not limited to: a) being able to identify ITAR product on the manufacturing floor and understand that access to these products and related technical data is restricted to only US Citizens and US Permanent Residents; b) recognition of Foreign Person visitors by badge differentiation; c) understand and follow authorization procedures for bringing foreign visitors into facilities (VAL); d) understand the Export and ITAR requirements for shipments leaving the US; e) manage vendor approvals for ITAR manufacturing and services.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, disability or protected veteran status.

jobs.description:
About the Company

PreVeil is a fast-growing tech company transforming secure communication and compliance for the modern enterprise. Our encrypted email and file sharing platform combines end-to-end encryption with a simple user experience and has been named PC Magazine's Best Encrypted Email and File Sharing Solution five years running.

Trusted by more than 3,000 defense contractors, PreVeil has become the gold standard for protecting sensitive information and achieving compliance efficiently. We're profitable, growing 100% year-over-year, and building for the long term.

About the Role

PreVeil is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own core product strategy, drive execution, and build exceptional user experiences across our portfolio. You’ll sit at the intersection of customer insight, product excellence, and business goals—defining what we build, why we build it, and how we ship it with speed and impact. Think like an owner: every feature is an investment, every problem demands first-principles rigor, and you’re constantly prioritizing resources to deliver maximum value to users and the business.

This is a high-ownership role on a lean, fast-moving team empowered to solve hard product problems. You’ll move fast, dig deep to uncover real root causes, and rally engineering, design, and go-to-market teams around a clear, compelling vision. You won’t be doing it alone. You’ll collaborate closely with top-tier engineers, designers, and company leaders dedicated to building the future of secure and compliant communication and collaboration for the enterprise.

Product Judgment & Strategic Thinking

• Evaluate competing approaches rigorously, form a clear and well-reasoned point of view, and articulate tradeoffs with conviction

• Define and own the product roadmap for your area — set direction, prioritize ruthlessly, and align the team around what matters most and why

• Operate at both the strategic and tactical level: think in years, execute in weeks

First Principles & Root Cause Thinking

• Dig beneath the surface of customer feedback and product problems to find the real underlying need, constraint, or opportunity

• Relentlessly ask why until you understand what's actually true — not just what's visible or what's been assumed

• Reason from fundamentals to reach better conclusions faster, especially in ambiguous or novel situations

Pattern Recognition & Connecting the Dots

• Spot connections others miss — draw on a broad base of experience to recognize when a new problem rhymes with an old one

• Connect signals across customers, market trends, and product gaps to form insight faster than the data alone would suggest

• Synthesize across disparate inputs — user research, eng constraints, competitive dynamics, business goals — into a coherent picture

Deep Customer & Market Understanding

• Develop a genuine, granular understanding of how customers think, work, and struggle — not just what they ask for

• Build relationships with customers directly; bring the voice of the user into every product decision

• Stay ahead of market trends and competitive dynamics to inform strategy and identify opportunities

Systems Thinking

• Understand how different parts of the product connect and affect each other — design solutions that work across the whole, not just the immediate problem

• Anticipate second-order effects of product decisions on users, engineering, and the business

• Hold the full product architecture in mind while working on specific problems

Systems Thinking

• Understand how different parts of the product connect and affect each other — design solutions that work across the whole, not just the immediate problem

• Anticipate second-order effects of product decisions on users, engineering, and the business

• Hold the full product architecture in mind while working on specific problems

Execution & Delivery Rigor

• Drive initiatives from discovery through launch with focus, discipline, and follow-through

• Break down complex problems into clear MVPs and iterative steps that ship with velocity and impact

• Be the kind of PM engineering and design can build with confidently — reliable, unblocking, and always moving things forward

Leadership, Motivation & Collaboration

• Lead and motivate without formal authority — earn trust and followership through clarity of vision, genuine respect, and consistency

• Keep the team aligned and energized through ambiguity, setbacks, and competing priorities

• Partner closely with engineering, design, and go-to-market as a true peer — not a ticket writer or gatekeeper

Communication & Written Clarity

• Communicate with precision and confidence across audiences — customers, engineers, designers, and leadership

• Write sharp, clear product specs that reduce ambiguity and accelerate execution

• Distill complex technical and strategic topics into language anyone can act on

What We're Looking For

Core requirements

  • 7+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning products end-to-end — strategy through launch through business outcomes
  • Enterprise B2B SaaS, collaboration or productivity software experience strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to deeply understand customers and translate that understanding into product decisions
  • Strong product instincts — you know what good looks like and can explain why
  • First principles thinker who digs to root causes and doesn't accept surface-level answers
  • Systems thinker who understands how product decisions ripple across the product, users, and the business
  • Growth mindset and genuine curiosity — you lead with questions, learn fast, and are truly open to feedback
  • Exceptional communicator — clear in writing, sharp in meetings, compelling to leadership
  • High-execution PM who drives things to completion and is deeply reliable
  • Leads and motivates without authority — earns trust through vision, respect, and consistency
  • Collaborative, low-ego, and maker-first — you thrive in a small team and take direction well

Important differentiators

  • Strong technical fluency — fluent in APIs, system architecture, and technical tradeoffs; can hold your own in engineering discussions
  • Familiarity with admin and end-user personas in enterprise software
  • Data-informed — uses quantitative metrics and qualitative research together, not one or the other
  • Ability to prototype ideas quickly using AI-assisted tools, or similar to validate and communicate concepts early
  • Actively uses AI as a force multiplier — e.g. research synthesis, written artifacts, prioritization analysis, and process efficiency
  • Pattern recognition — connects dots across customers, market signals, and product gaps faster than the data alone suggests
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity with a strong bias for action

Working Style & Culture Fit

This role is for someone who thinks rigorously and executes relentlessly — someone who earns the trust of their team through clarity, consistency, and care. You'll be joining a small team that moves fast and expects a lot, but also invests deeply in doing things right.

We value:

  • A strong point of view, formed through genuine investigation and held with intellectual honesty
  • Speed and decisiveness, paired with the rigor to know when to slow down and go deeper
  • People who make the team around them sharper, more aligned, and more motivated
  • The kind of reliability that means you don't have to be asked twice — and the judgment to know when to ask for help

In 2020, Porch Group rang the Nasdaq bell and began trading under the ticker symbol PRCH. We are looking to build a truly great company and are JUST GETTING STARTED.

Job Title: IT Helpdesk Technician

Location: India

Workplace Type: Remote

Job Summary

The future is bright for the Porch Group, and we'd love for you to be a part of it as our IT Helpdesk Technician with the Information Technology team.

Porch Group is looking for an IT Helpdesk Technician who will be responsible for analyzing, troubleshooting, and resolving end-user and technology issues for the Porch Group's Information Technology department. This role provides direct support to Porch Group employees via phone, chat, and standard remote tools, offering guidance and best practices on business-specific programs and technology.

The ideal candidate is comfortable troubleshooting IT products such as Microsoft Windows, Office 365, MacOS, MS Teams, Slack, Zoom, RingCentral, and other business-related hardware or software, and enjoys solving problems in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

What You Will Do As An IT Helpdesk Technician

  • Set up and ship equipment for employee use.
  • Monitor all work orders and requests and troubleshoot tickets for status and compliance with established timeframes for work performance.
  • Maintain help desk requests, ticket updates and status, general data entry, and data gathering from emails and phone calls for user support.
  • Re-image laptops and desktops for re-deployments.
  • Ensure proper installation of IT standards, including operating systems and standard software.
  • Answer user inquiries regarding computer software or hardware operation to resolve problems.
  • Document and maintain an IT knowledge base and maintain inventory of assets and equipment.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation and procedures, or train users in the proper use of hardware or software.
  • Install, maintain, support, and troubleshoot operating systems and a wide variety of software applications, peripheral devices, and network connectivity issues.
  • Answer questions in a friendly, professional manner to resolve computer problems for employees remotely via email, chat, or telephone, or in person.
  • Create, change, and delete user accounts.
  • Support scripting and automation efforts to help employees eliminate repetitive work.
  • Maintain security standards and patch management across supported endpoints.
  • Collaborate with others to resolve information technology issues.
  • Resolve computer software issues, questions, and problems.
  • Perform other IT related duties or projects, as assigned.

What You Will Bring As An IT Helpdesk Technician

  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written (English), attention to detail, dependability, cooperation, integrity, and analytical skills.

Do you have a knack for writing and the time it takes to get your thoughts in front of thousands of Python developers?

The tutorial team is known for making the highest-quality Python tutorials available online. Our mission is to “help Python developers around the world become more awesome.”

And with a reach of over 3 million visitors a month, it feels amazing how far we’ve come—but we think we can do even better!

To help us raise the quality level of our tutorials even further, and expand beyond the topics we’ve covered so far, we are looking for authors who:

  • Love Python and want to share their knowledge to help learners level up
  • Appreciate the importance of clarity and tone in educational writing
  • Want to hone their craft and make the most of our extensive publishing process
  • Have the time to start writing one or more new tutorials a month and meet deadlines

This is a fully remote position. More info here:

Requirements

You should:

  • Have a few years of programming under your belt
  • Be ready to grow as a writer and work on your writing skills
  • Be comfortable learning brand new topics that you have never done before, which are either not documented or poorly documented
  • Have the time to make Real Python a regular part of your week—this will be a significant time commitment and is not easy

Benefits

There are plenty of perks to being on the Real Python team:

  1. Learning: You’ll always be learning something new—and you’ll have fun doing it. You’ll become a better developer, writer, and communicator, while making new friends along the way.
  2. Eyeballs: Our site gets a lot of traffic—over 3 million visitors per month and growing. We’re regularly featured in other Python publications and we also run one of the largest email newsletters and social media accounts in the community. When you publish a tutorial here, it will get read a lot, and people will love you for it.
  3. Tutorial Polish: When you submit a tutorial or article to realpython.com, we will personally work with you to polish your work to a high level of quality. In the end, your tutorial will look much better than when you first submitted it, making you look really good.
  4. Writing Training: When we are done reviewing and editing your tutorial, we will send you detailed feedback on how you can improve your tutorials in the future. This will help you become a better developer, writer, and communicator.
  5. Personal Exposure: Your picture and bio will be prominently featured on your tutorials and on multiple other places on the site. This can lead to a multitude of new opportunities for you—job offers, freelance projects, and conference invitations. An in-depth tutorial published on Real Python can make a great portfolio piece.
  6. Get Paid to Learn: You’ll get paid to learn. We’re not asking you to do this “just for the exposure”—this is a paid part-time position.
  7. Special Opportunities: Members of the tutorial team get access to special opportunities such as contributing to our books and courses, speaking at online meetups we organize, becoming interview guests to chat about an area of your expertise on the Real Python Podcast, working on team projects, and more.
  8. You’ll Have an Impact: We get emails and comments every day about how our tutorials help our readers write their first Python program, get their learning progress unstuck, or accomplish their career dream of working with Python professionally. This means a lot to us and makes all the hard work worth it. Our most prolific authors have been approached at conferences and meetups by other developers who read their articles—a great conversation starter.
  9. 100% Remote-Friendly: At Real Python you’ll join a remote-first, distributed, and diverse team that spans across the globe.
  10. Free Stuff: As a final bonus, by joining the tutorial team you will get a lot of free stuff. You’ll get a free copy of all of the products we sell on the site, access to all of our members-only content, as well as a life-time membership to PythonistaCafe. That’s about $1,000 in value you’ll receive for free.

The UX Designers responsibilities during this phase are to build an understanding of the problem space/statement, the long and short-term business goals, and the user and business needs.

  1. Facilitate the Kick-off meeting with the project team to produce such outputs as:
  • Business Model Canvas
  • 5 Whys
  • User Personas
  • Stakeholder Mapping
  • Strategy Map
  • Short- and Long-Term Goals
  • Fears and Challenges
  • Problem Statement
  1. Facilitate user research activities to produce such outputs as:
  • User interview topic Maps, a summary of interrelated topics for the user interview
  • User Interview Scripts to plan and guide user discussion
  • User Interview Synthesis (collection, aggregation and analysis) of written observations recorded during each interview
  • User research findings report
  1. Inception (Science Fair Day):
  • Showcases the work and key findings from this stage to stakeholders outside of the core project team
  • Aligns entire team (business, technical) on what the next steps will be
  • Planning activities for next phase (Alpha)
  1. Other deliverables typically delivered in this phase include:
  • User Storyboard to communicate a story through images displayed in a sequence of panels that chronologically maps the storys main events.
  • Technical Service Blueprint, a diagram that displays the entire process of service delivery including support systems by listing all the activities that happen at each stage, performed by the different roles involved
  • Defined business Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Delivery Phase 2) Alpha:

Alpha is about testing hypotheses and experimentation. The purpose of Alpha is to determine how to meet the user needs that were identified in discovery. This phase is an opportunity to quickly test different approaches with users before building a service.

Deliverables:

  1. Optionally conduct Google Ventures five (5) Day Design Sprint (or variation). This sprint is a five (5) day process for answering critical business questions through design, prototyping, and testing ideas with customers
  2. Produce clickable prototypes of multiple possible solutions
  3. Validate "clickable prototypes with users through usability testing sessions and produce research findings report
  4. Iterate (improve) on clickable prototypes with insights garnered from research findings report
  5. Identify and document existing processes or policies that will need to change to support the new product or service
  6. Produce a business proposal to justify funding for the next phase (Beta)
  7. Define a clear vision for the solution that will be built in Beta
  8. Create a plan and prioritized list of features to be completed in the Beta phase
  9. Define user solution, and delivery of KPIs

Delivery Phase 3) Beta:

The goal of Beta is to build a real service that works well for a larger group of people. The prototypes that were developed and tested during Alpha are used to build a Minimum Viable Product (MVP) for deployment in a live, user-facing environment. Executed within the context of Scrum methodology, the UX Designer performs the following Agile ceremonies: Stand-up meetings, Sprint Planning, Backlog grooming, Reporting, Acceptance, and Retrospective.

The designers are at the spearhead of this methodology, creating and validating user stories for the developers (typical) one iteration ahead.

Deliverables:

  1. User story creation and validation:
    1. Participates in deciding which priority to tackle
    2. Sketching workshop to create visual representation of ideas or user flows
    3. Create designs
    4. Enhancements made to designs
    5. User Interviews (for validation)
    6. Synthesising individual and overall interview findings
    7. Enhancements to designs made from synthesis
    8. Get product owner sign off and input story into backlog for future iteration planning
    9. Rinse and repeat for each feature, function within a given iteration
  2. Conduct accessibility compliance testing of the solution within each iteration.
  3. Conduct regular usability testing sessions on the MVP built as part of the Beta phase.

Delivery Phase 4) Live:

Live begins when the service has reached a point of maturity and all of the main features in the backlog have been built. While most people understand the purpose of live, its not always given the attention and resources it deserves.

Continuous improvement is one of the core principles of service design and thats what live is all about. The goal is to continuously monitor, research, test and iterate for as long as the service is active.

Deliverables:

  1. Continue to facilitate user research activities to produce such outputs as:
  • User interview topic maps, a summary of interrelated topics for the user interview
  • User interview scripts to plan and guide user discussion
  • User interview synthesis (collection, aggregation and analysis) of written observations recorded during each interview
  • User research findings report
  1. Conduct regular accessibility compliance testing of the live build as improvements are released.
  2. Conduct regular usability testing sessions on the live build.
  3. Analyze usage analytics and user behaviour patterns to track and measure key performance indicators.

Sr. User Experience Designer

Evaluation Criteria

User Experience Design 40%

· Extensive experience in using UX design best practices to design solutions, and a deep understanding of mobile-first and responsive design.

· Ability to iterate your designs and solutions efficiently and intelligently.

· 3+ years of relevant experience in participating in complex projects (products) of different sizes, ensuring alignment to plans, best practices and incorporating user-centred design processes and agile (scrum) methodologies.

· Degree or diploma in graphic design; degree or certification in usability, human-computer interaction, and technical writing a plus

Relationship Management - 20%

Technical Skills - 30%

Soft skills - 10%

Must Haves:

About Us:

From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

About The Role:

YipitData is becoming the default intelligence platform for anyone evaluating companies and markets. Systematic Data Products & Feeds are central to that ambition. We make differentiated data easy for quantitative and systematic investors - as well as sophisticated fundamental investors with dedicated data teams - to discover, evaluate, trust, integrate, and use.

We are seeking a strategic business leader to turn this growing portfolio into a major, repeatable growth engine. This leader will own strategy and performance across Quant products, consumer transaction data, consumer receipt data and our broader portfolio of data feeds - including ARR, portfolio strategy, investment allocation, packaging and pricing, go-to-market and service motions, and overall business performance.

As the leader of this business, you will set the direction for the portfolio and unite leaders across Product, Quant, Data, Engineering, Revenue, Client Strategy, and Operations behind one business plan. You will determine where we compete, how we win, and where we invest - building the operating model and commercial motion required to deliver durable client value and financial outcomes.

As Our Head of Data Feeds, You Will:

Own business performance

  • Own ARR growth, retention, profitability, and overall financial performance.
  • Translate the strategy into a multi-year business plan with clear targets, assumptions, resource requirements, and risks.
  • Establish the business scorecard and give the Public Investor Leadership Team a clear view of performance, trajectory, and required decisions.

Define the portfolio and investment strategy

  • Determine which markets, buyer segments, and systematic workflows YipitData will pursue- and how we will win.
  • Shape transaction data, B2B data, Quant products, and other feeds into a coherent portfolio rather than a collection of independent offerings.
  • Identify opportunities to turn existing data into new products, use cases, and revenue streams.
  • Allocate investment across the portfolio, making explicit decisions about where to scale, maintain, change course, or stop.
  • Prioritize capabilities and data assets that can be reused across multiple products, workflows, and markets.

Build the commercial engine

  • Define a clear portfolio proposition that communicates how YipitData’s Systematic Data products fit together and why they are differentiated.
  • Own packaging, pricing, bundling, entitlements, and other core business-model decisions.
  • Partner with Revenue and Client Strategy to build repeatable sales, trial, onboarding, adoption, retention, and service motions for systematic-data buyers.
  • Build strong relationships with quantitative researchers, data scientists, portfolio managers, and other sophisticated data buyers.
  • Use client feedback, product usage, pipeline performance, and retention signals to continually refine the commercial strategy.

Establish a scalable operating model

  • Create an operating cadence that connects business priorities with product roadmaps, data investments, engineering dependencies, and commercial execution.
  • Establish clear decision rights and accountability across business, Product, Quant, Data, Engineering, Revenue, and Operations.
  • Resolve cross-product dependencies and sequencing conflicts so the portfolio operates as one business.
  • Build the leadership structure, talent, and organizational capabilities required to scale.

Prepare the business for the future of data consumption

  • Set the business requirements that make systematic products trusted and usable, including point-in-time integrity, history, coverage, stable identities, lineage, joinability, and delivery reliability.
  • Shape the portfolio’s distribution strategy across feeds, APIs, MCPs, agents, cloud platforms, notebooks, marketplaces, and third-party integrations.
  • Apply AI and automation to accelerate dataset evaluation, quality assurance, documentation, signal testing, support, and client implementation.
  • Anticipate changes in systematic and agentic investor workflows and translate them into new business and product opportunities.

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

Required

  • Senior leadership experience building or scaling a data, financial-technology, information-services, analytics, or enterprise-software business.
  • Direct ownership of a P&L or business line, including revenue performance, multi-year planning, resource allocation, and investment tradeoffs.
  • A record of turning individual products or differentiated data assets into a coherent, repeatable commercial business.
  • Strong market and portfolio judgment, with the ability to choose among competing buyer segments, growth opportunities, and investments.
  • Experience developing pricing, packaging, go-to-market, onboarding, and service models for sophisticated enterprise or technical customers.
  • The ability to build strong client relationships and translate market evidence into clear business and product choices.
  • Experience leading through a matrixed organization, establishing decision rights, aligning functional leaders, and creating execution discipline.
  • Sufficient technical fluency to engage credibly on data quality, methodologies, schemas, APIs, infrastructure, and delivery reliability.
  • A demonstrated ability to build teams, develop leaders, and design organizations that can scale.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, and executive communication skills, with the ability to turn complexity into clear direction and decisions.

Preferred

  • Experience serving quantitative investors, systematic funds, data scientists, or other technical investment personas.
  • Experience in alternative data, market data, financial information services, or investment-research products.
  • Familiarity with systematic-data requirements such as point-in-time integrity, backtesting, identity mapping, schema stability, lineage, and reproducibility.
  • Experience commercializing data through feeds, APIs, cloud platforms, MCPs, marketplaces, third-party integrations, or agentic interfaces.
  • Experience evaluating, sourcing, licensing, or managing third-party data partnerships.
  • Experience using AI and automation to improve data-product development, quality, evaluation, or client delivery.

What We Offer:

Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary:

  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, flexible vacation, a generous 401K match, parental leave, team events, wellness budget, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!
  • Base Salary + Performance-Based Bonus: The annual base salary range for this position is anticipated to be $225k-$250k, with eligibility for an annual performance-based bonus of up to 25%. Final compensation may be determined by a number of factors, including, but not limited to, the applicant’s experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and internal team benchmarks.
  • The compensation package also includes equity.

This role may be performed fully remotely within the United States. Please note that our US headquarters are located in NYC. If the remote work is performed outside of these offices, income may be subject to New York State tax withholding.

jobs.title: Pflicht-Praktikum (m/w/d) Finance & Modelling – Erneuerbare Energien
jobs.excerpt: Über RenergoRenergo entwickelt bundesweit große PV-Freiflächen, Windparks und Batteriespeicher (BESS) – und geht als unabhängiger Stromerzeuger (IPP) nun den nächsten Schritt: vom reinen Projektentwickler zum Betreiber eigener Anlagen.
jobs.description:
Über Renergo

Renergo entwickelt bundesweit große PV-Freiflächen, Windparks und Batteriespeicher (BESS) – und geht als unabhängiger Stromerzeuger (IPP) nun den nächsten Schritt: vom reinen Projektentwickler zum Betreiber eigener Anlagen.

Für unseren Bereich IPP & Finance suchen wir eine:n Praktikant:in mit gutem Zahlenverständnis und sehr guten Excel-Kenntnissen. Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem VP IPP & Finance zusammen, bewertest reale Projekte und sammelst Erfahrung mit KI-gestützten Prozessen. Unser dezentrales Team hat rund 20 Mitarbeitende und kurze Entscheidungswege: Deine Ergebnisse gehen direkt an die Geschäftsführung.

Deine Aufgaben

Du unterstützt unseren Vice President IPP & Finance im Bereich Finance und Modelling für Projekte im Bereich der erneuerbaren Energien. Zu deinen Tätigkeiten gehören:

  • Unterstützung bei der wirtschaftlichen Bewertung unserer PV-, BESS- und Windprojekte im Excel-Finanzmodell

  • Szenario- und Sensitivitätsanalysen sowie Optimierung technischer und wirtschaftlicher Auslegungsentscheidungen (z. B. Speichergröße, Layout, Vermarktungsstrategie)

  • Modellierung von Anlagenerlösen mit Plattformen wie Re-Twin und enervis

  • Unterstützung unserer Projektmanager:innen bei Modellierungsaufgaben und Wirtschaftlichkeitsrechnungen

  • Mitarbeit an KI-gestützten Arbeitsabläufen (z. B. mit Claude) für Projektanalysen und -vergleiche

  • Dokumentation und Weiterentwicklung von Modellen, Vorlagen und Prozessen

Dein Profil

Du bringst folgende Voraussetzungen mit:

  • Laufendes Studium (Master oder fortgeschrittener Bachelor) in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Finance, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Energiewirtschaft oder einem vergleichbaren Fach

  • Sehr gute Excel-Kenntnisse: Du arbeitest sicher mit Formeln und großen Datenmengen. Kenntnisse in Makros und VBA sind von Vorteil

  • Erfahrung im Financial Modelling, mit Erneuerbaren Energien oder in der Projektfinanzierung ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung

  • Erfahrung mit KI-Tools wie Claude ist von Vorteil

  • Analytische, strukturierte und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise: Du prüfst Zahlen kritisch, bevor du sie übernimmst

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Das erwartet dich

  • Zuschuss zu Fitnessabo für deine körperliche Fitness

  • Entschädigung für Reisekosten bei dienstlichen Wegen

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten zur Vereinbarkeit von Studium und Praxis

  • Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice und Remote arbeiten

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem VP IPP & Finance und Einblick in Entscheidungen der Geschäftsführung

  • Viel Lernpotenzial in Projektbewertung, Projektfinanzierung und Energiemärkten

  • Gute Perspektive auf eine Weiterentwicklung im Unternehmen

Deine ersten Monate

In den ersten Monaten arbeitest du dich in unsere bestehenden Finanzmodelle ein und übernimmst eigene Berechnungen für unsere Solarparks. Du begleitest Wirtschaftlichkeitsanalysen und unterstützt die Geschäftsführung bei Finanzierungsfragen. Solltest du nicht alle Anforderungen zu hundert Prozent erfüllen, freuen wir uns dennoch auf deine Bewerbung.

jobs.title: Founding Harness Engineer (AI Agents)
jobs.excerpt: We're hiring for our partner company, an early-stage startup building an AI coworker: an agent that lives inside a team's everyday tools and actually gets work done.
jobs.description:
We're hiring for our partner company, an early-stage startup building an AI coworker: an agent that lives inside a team's everyday tools and actually gets work done. They need a senior Founding Harness Engineer to build the layer that makes it behave. How it pulls in context, when it speaks up, which tool it reaches for, when it stops and asks permission, and how it finishes a long task without falling over halfway. You'll join a seasoned founder and a founding team who spent years building technology in the services world. They watched clients ask for agents long before anyone could deliver them, so they know where the real demand is. The role starts as a contract, with a path to full-time once it's clearly working for both sides. It is remote from Latin America or Eastern Europe, with solid overlap with US Pacific time, since that's where the founder works. If you've shipped tool-using agents to real users and want to build the next one from day one, read on.

Our Culture & Values (read before applying)

We move fast. We take ownership. We work with AI, not against it. And we expect everyone to bring ideas, not wait for instructions.

There are no daily checklists, no micromanagement, and no corporate politics. You get autonomy, trust, and a small team that's always ready to help you grow. Here, impact matters more than titles, and curiosity matters more than seniority.

If you want to level up fast and see your work in real users' hands - welcome aboard.

Responsibilities

  • Build the agent runtime: context, tool choice, approval waits, and knowing when to act, ask, or stay quiet
  • Write and keep tuning the system prompts. Proactive is great. Spamming the team channel is not
  • Own the eval and regression harness. Prompt changes are code, so they get tested like code
  • Make long-running work survive interruptions, retries, and the occasional flaky API
  • Put the guardrails in: approval gates for risky actions and strict separation between customers' data
  • Work directly with the founder and early users, and turn what you hear into shipped behavior

Requirements

  • You've shipped tool-using LLM agents to real users in production. Demos and prompt wrappers don't count
  • Good instincts for agent initiative, and the test results to back them up
  • Hands-on experience building eval and regression suites for LLM behavior
  • You understand safe tool execution, prompt injection, and multi-tenant data risk
  • Solid backend skills in Python or TypeScript (async jobs, retries, state)
  • You take a fuzzy problem from prototype to production and can explain the tradeoffs along the way
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; you can explain a tradeoff to a founder or a user without a whiteboard

Nice to have

  • MCP, or integrations with tools like Slack, Gmail, Notion, or Linear
  • Eval and tracing tools such as Braintrust, Langfuse, or LangSmith
  • You've been an early engineer at a startup before and still liked it

Benefits

  • A founding seat. You own the agent harness and shape how the product behaves
  • Founding equity
  • A direct line to the founder and early users, with no layers in between
  • Remote from Latin America or Eastern Europe, with solid overlap with US Pacific time
  • The tools and models you need to do the job properly
  • A small, experienced team that trusts you to run your own work

jobs.description:
Description

We are seeking a highly experienced and strategically-minded Senior Insurance Data Science Consultant to join our growing analytics team. This role is ideal for a Data Scientist or Actuary with experience and deep expertise in predictive modeling, machine learning, and insurance analytics. You will play a pivotal role in influencing client decision-making, shaping pricing strategies and delivering actionable insights to clients across multiple lines of business.

What you'll do

Lead pricing strategy discussions using advanced analytics and actuarial insight, ensuring decisions are grounded in data and aligned to business outcomes.

Engage directly with senior executives, translating complex technical results into clear, compelling narratives that drive alignment and action.

Build and evolve predictive models that assess risk and forecast demand—directly shaping pricing and business decisions across insurance products.

Influence decision-making at the highest levels by connecting analytics to business value and strategic priorities.

Demonstrate Earnix capabilities in executive and client settings, showing not just how the platform works—but what it enables.

Lead onboarding and training for new users, ensuring fast adoption and rapid time-to-value from day one.

Act as a trusted advisor to clients, bridging business, analytics, and technology to deliver measurable impact.

Requirements

You’ll do it using:

5+ years of experience in the insurance industry, with deep expertise in analytics, actuarial modeling, and predictive techniques.

Strong hands-on experience with machine learning and statistical modeling to improve the accuracy, performance, and business impact of risk and pricing models.

Advanced proficiency in programming languages such as Python and R, applied to building, validating, and deploying scalable analytical solutions.

Experience working with intelligent decisioning platforms (such as Earnix or similar), integrating models into real-time pricing and personalization workflows.

Strong executive presence with the ability to engage, influence, and advise senior stakeholders in client organizations.

Willingness and flexibility to travel up to 25% domestically and internationally.

You’ll excel by:

Communicating with clarity and executive presence, making complex data and models actionable for senior leadership.

Building trusted client relationships, understanding business needs, and delivering insights that drive measurable strategic outcomes.

Collaborating across teams, sharing knowledge and mentoring others to elevate the organization’s analytical capability.

Adapting quickly to new challenges, staying curious and proactive in a fast-paced, innovation-driven environment.

Position Intro

Earnix is the premier provider of mission-critical, cloud-based intelligent decisioning across pricing, rating, underwriting, and product personalization. These fully-integrated solutions provide ultra-fast ROI and are designed to transform how global insurers and banks are run by unlocking value across all facets of the business. Earnix has been innovating for insurers and banks since 2001 with customers in over 35 countries across six continents and offices in the Americas, Europe, Asia Pacific, and Israel.

jobs.description:
Description

Devereux is seeking a strategic and operationally focused Director of Finance, Ancillary Services to oversee the financial performance of several growing and innovative service lines, including pharmacy services, educational consulting, autism services, and direct care training programs.

In this role, you'll partner with senior leaders to drive financial performance, oversee budgeting and forecasting, manage contracts and revenue streams, and support strategic growth initiatives. This is an ideal opportunity for a finance leader who enjoys balancing high-level strategy with hands-on operational leadership.

Being a Director of Finance, Ancillary Services at Devereux Has Its Advantages!

You'll work alongside talented professionals dedicated to advancing Devereux's mission while helping drive the success and growth of key service lines.

We offer:

  • Competitive Pay: $100,000 - $115,000/year
  • Full-Time Remote Schedule: Day shift hours with availability during Eastern Time business hours; occasional travel to Devereux locations as needed*note: preference will be towards candidates near base office in Villanova for in-person training opportunities
  • ASCEND Career Accelerator Program: Designed to support your professional growth through personalized coaching, development opportunities, and financial assistance
  • Mission-Driven Organization: Support programs that positively impact children, adults, families, and communities
  • Comprehensive Benefits: with 403(b) Retirement Plan with Employer Match and Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

What You'll Do

  • Lead monthly financial reporting, forecasting, analysis, and month-end close activities
  • Manage revenue streams, billing operations, accounts receivable, cash applications, and vendor payments
  • Oversee contract development, execution, and compliance for revenue-generating agreements and independent contractors
  • Lead the annual budgeting process and provide ongoing budget-to-actual analysis
  • Monitor financial performance and recommend strategies to improve profitability and operational efficiency
  • Oversee inventory valuation, forecasting, reconciliations, and cost-of-goods analyses
  • Ensure compliance with tax reporting requirements and applicable regulations
  • Partner with Corporate Finance, Legal, Human Resources, Operations, and other key stakeholders
  • Prepare and present financial reports and performance analyses to senior leadership
  • Lead special projects related to financial operations, productivity, utilization, and business growth initiatives

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field required
  • Minimum of five years experience in a senior level finance role at Devereux or comparable organization required
  • Supervisory and leadership experience preferred
  • Experience in healthcare, behavioral health, pharmacy, education, or a related industry preferred
  • Strong experience in budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, and contract management
  • Experience managing multiple revenue streams and complex financial operations
  • Knowledge of billing, accounts receivable, inventory controls, and financial compliance
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with interdisciplinary teams and executive leadership

Devereux has a zero-tolerance policy for abuse and maintains policies and procedures to systematically reduce the risk of abuse to occur in our organization. Devereux fosters a culture of reporting abuse, and will cooperate with the authorities to the fullest extent possible.

Company Overview

Company Overview

Devereux is one of the nation’s largest nonprofit organizations, providing services, insight and leadership in the evolving field of behavioral healthcare. Founded in 1912, Devereux operates a comprehensive national network of clinical, therapeutic, educational and employment programs that positively impact the lives of 10,000+ children, adults – and their families – every year.

Our Mission: Devereux changes lives – by unlocking and nurturing human potential for people living with emotional, behavioral or cognitive differences.

With nearly 6,500 employees working in programs across the country, Devereux is a trusted partner for families, schools and communities, serving individuals in the areas of autism, intellectual and developmental disabilities, specialty mental health, education and foster care.

Our Culture, Our Expectations

At Devereux, Servant Leadership is embedded throughout our culture and every aspect of our organizational framework. Our mission-driven, people-first mindset is at the heart of the compassionate and high-quality programming we provide – every day – for the individuals and families we serve, and other key stakeholders. Devereux offers challenging and exciting work, and our team environment creates an empowering, positive and rewarding atmosphere. To be successful at Devereux, you will: put the needs of others first, feel called to serve and called to lead. As a member of our team, you will be a significant part of our commitment to providing a welcoming and supportive work environment across all programs and services, and within all policies and employee practices.

We believe a workplace rooted in inclusivity – offering a sense of belonging to all those who walk through our doors – is fundamental to delivering the highest quality healthcare services. Through open dialogue and the creation of brave spaces, we will engage in work that gives each of us a chance to change the world – one person, one family, one community at a time.

What Devereux Offers You

In addition to a competitive salary, Devereux provides a comprehensive health and welfare program to eligible full-time employees, family members and domestic partners. Eligible employees are eligible to start benefits after 30 days of employment. In addition, we offer;

  • Medical (including telemedicine via phone, web, app), dental, prescription drug, preventative care, and mental health services.
  • Student loan debt assistance, tuition reimbursement and continuing education assistance.
  • Generous time-off (start accruing 1st day), 403(b) retirement plan with matching benefit, and voluntary/employee paid supplemental life and accident coverage.
  • Employee assistance / work-life balance program.

Visit www.mydevereuxbenefits.org to see why Devereux is a great place to work!

Devereux is a drug-free workplace, drug screening required. EOE
