jobs.title: Senior Software Safety Engineer, Halos - Autonomous Vehicles
jobs.excerpt: NVIDIA is widely regarded as a leading company in technology.
jobs.description:
NVIDIA is widely regarded as a leading company in technology. It has groundbreaking developments in High-Performance Computing, Artificial Intelligence, and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work enables exploration of new universes, enables outstanding creativity and discoveries that were once science fiction from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars and robotics.


NVIDIA Halos is the full-stack, comprehensive safety system that unifies autonomous machines architecture, AI models, chips, software, tools, and services to ensure the safe development and deployment of Physical AI. We are actively seeking a Senior SW Safety Engineer to join the Halos team and collaborate closely with other teams across NVIDIA working on autonomous vehicle and robotics safety.


What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Be pivotal in ensuring the safety of our AI-based autonomous system software.
  • Engage with a diverse team of engineers across the entire DRIVE platform and related research unit. You will work closely with the groups handling automotive functional safety and safety of the intended functionality.
  • Collaborate with the teams dedicated to robotics, humanoids, industry safety and other safety critical applications across NVIDIA.
  • Apply your skills to guide the teams to specify, build, implement, and verify safety requirements across our software stack from drivers and acceleration libraries to AI-based technologies, including end-to-end models.
  • Help NVIDIA team implementing our Product Life Cycle to integrate the process principles of AI safety.
  • Your role includes engaging in customer interaction and international standardization activities related to safety of Artificial Intelligence.
  • Support system safety activities including decomposition of safety requirements, system and component level build analysis (FTA, DFA, CCF, FMEA, etc.), and architectural safety analysis across hardware and software boundaries.
  • Collaborate with external certification bodies, assessors, and regulators. You will present, defend, and justify safety arguments and evidence. This supports successful safety certification reviews related to functionality and AI.

What we need to see:

  • BS, MS, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related technical field, or equivalent experience.
  • 12+ years of shown experience in Artificial Intelligence and SW safety related processes, methodologies, tools.
  • Experience in AI safety methods and tools (adaptability testing, uncertainty evaluation, out of distribution detection, and other related methods).
  • Familiarity with system software development and embedded platforms.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience in reviewing existing processes and finding gaps to suggest improvements.
  • Experience producing safety plans, safety analyses reports, safety case documentation, and evidence packets in support of safety certification and audit activities.

Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:

  • Strong background in safety standards (ISO PAS 8800, ISO/IEC TR 5469, ISO 21448, ISO 26262, IEC 61508).
  • Background in system safety methodologies & practices (HARA, FMEA, FTA, STPA).
  • Hands-on experience with innovative systems engineering methodologies – such as requirements management, peer review processes, configuration management, requirements management in an agile development environment, risk management, requirements verification and traceability, validation and verification, and architectural decomposition.
  • Hands-on experience in autonomous systems.
  • Success applying the V-Model to sophisticated AI-based engineering projects, ideally in all stages of the SW development life cycle.

#AutonomousVehicles

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Description

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

Role overview

We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell.

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.

You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.

What you will work on

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output;
  • Own the production flow: task distribution, capacity planning, and strict QC - production-grade, not demo-grade;
  • Drive creative direction: concepts, hooks, and visual angles that stop the scroll and convert;
  • Generate ideas yourself and push the team beyond safe iterations - informed by visual trends and competitor creatives;
  • Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;
  • Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;
  • Run regular R&D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;
  • Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;
  • Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation;
  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.

Requirements

Your must-haves

You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you.

  • 5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig);
  • Mature Leader & Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches;
  • Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses;
  • Strong Visual Craft: composition, lighting, color, typography, anatomy. You can articulate exactly why a creative works or doesn't;
  • Design Toolstack: proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; comfortable connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines;
  • AI Geek: far beyond basic prompting. You track every new model release and can't wait to test how it could level up ad creatives. Hands-on with modern AI image platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar), using them for creating photorealistic visuals. Able to choose the right tool for each task, as well as to catch and fix artifacts.
  • Performance Marketing DNA: solid understanding of static ad creatives (Google, Meta, and other paid channels). You know what stops the scroll, what makes a visual sell, and how creative decisions move CTR, CPA, and conversion rate;
  • Fluency in English - both spoken and written.

Nice to have

  • A strong portfolio showcasing performance marketing creatives and AI-generated photorealistic work - ideally with examples shipped under your leadership and the results they drove;
  • Experience with creatives for high-CPA verticals (home improvement, insurance, health, legal, finance, or similar);
  • Experience creating visuals for North American audiences - you know what looks native to a US consumer;
  • Understanding of how static visuals feed video production pipelines.

What we offer

  • Remote Work - we offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
  • Paid vacations - generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge.
  • Unlimited Sick Days - we understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
  • Ongoing Learning - people at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
  • Home Office - we will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
  • Physical Well-Being - we will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
  • Fun Stuff - there is never a shortage of fun stuff.

jobs.excerpt: Who we are:Magellan AI gives brands, agencies and publishers visibility into the podcast advertising market and proof that it works.
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Magellan AI gives brands, agencies and publishers visibility into the podcast advertising market and proof that it works. Our audio analysis and NLP track ad placements across thousands of shows. Our measurement and attribution tools connect those ads to the traffic and conversions they drive, so buyers can optimize campaigns and sellers can prove performance.

We are looking to hire an experienced full-stack developer to join our team of seven engineers, to help launch a major new feature and continue to enhance our core product. The job has changed shape over the past year: most of our code is now drafted by AI agents — Claude Code and Codex — working under close supervision. We ship considerably more than we used to, and the scarce skill is no longer typing speed. It is knowing what to build, specifying it precisely, and being able to tell a correct answer from a convincing one. We are seeking someone who can handle many responsibilities, including:

  • Adding new features to our Ruby on Rails application from top-to-bottom, full stack. You will work with operations and sales to help creatively design ‘good enough’ yet professional solutions.
  • Directing AI coding agents through real work: framing the problem and its constraints, reviewing what comes back line by line, pushing back when a solution has outgrown the problem, and starting over simpler when that is the right call. You own the result regardless of who typed it.
  • Increasing system/code quality by using practices such as TDD and refactoring. Quality around the core of the system has become more important as we scale up — and more important still now that the volume of code we produce has gone up.
  • Writing the design down before the code: specs, architecture decision records, and product documentation for our operations team. Precise writing is a core engineering skill here, because it is both how we align with each other and how we brief our agents.
  • Extending our own tooling — the skills, subagents and CLI helpers that encode how we work. Codifying a workflow so the whole team, and their agents, can repeat it is ordinary, reviewed work here.
  • Building AI-facing product surfaces, like our Ad Intelligence MCP server, where the consumer of the API you design is a language model rather than a browser — with the authentication, policy gates and audit logging that implies.
  • Enhancing usability of existing features via Turbo/Stimulus and other front-end improvements.
  • Troubleshooting and fixing performance issues and complicated logic across Postgres and ClickHouse. Help simplify the system by bringing in smart design decisions.
  • Experimenting and providing stopgap solutions for potential opportunities. Sometimes this involves quick and dirty solutions such as scripting, SQL exports, web scraping and the like.
  • Sharing in providing operational support to make sure the system stays running and address any bugs. (Most usage is during normal business hours…we don’t do pagers.)
  • Experimenting via internal hackathons to produce novel solutions and feature enhancements.

Software Development at Magellan AI

We adhere to a lightweight Agile development process.

  • Every week, we have one formal product meeting with the revenue and operations team to reset priorities. The rest of the time is self-directed, with developers figuring out how to best solve any problems. In general, we are not working against any deadlines and make sure we take the time to do the job right.
  • We practice Collective Code Ownership so that anyone can change any line of code and anyone can introduce new libraries or tools.
  • We deploy code on a regular basis, usually every day. IOW, we ship fast and learn fast. A typical recent week is around 45 pull requests merged.
  • Claude Code and Codex do most of the typing. Engineers spend their time deciding what to build, writing the spec, and judging what comes back.
  • We work one task per git worktree, which lets each of us keep several agent sessions running in parallel on isolated branches. Managing that parallelism is a skill in itself, and we will teach it.
  • Every change runs a review gauntlet before it merges: a local pre-PR review, a cross-agent review where Codex critiques Claude’s work, GitHub Copilot’s automated review (our branch rules will not let us merge until every thread is resolved), and a human reviewer. Different models catch different things.
  • We invest heavily in the context our agents read: a repository-level conventions file, roughly two dozen project-specific skills, and purpose-built subagents. When someone learns something the hard way, it gets written down where the next agent will find it.
  • Decisions get recorded as ADRs — we are up to 159 — and business rules live in a shared documentation repository linked into every worktree, so both people and agents can find out why the system works the way it does.
  • We usually host a biweekly team retrospective to discuss ways to improve communication and collaboration.
  • We make it easy for the tech-adjacent team members to run QA with clear documentation and steps to test our work.

Tools and Technologies

The main application is Ruby on Rails, hosted on Heroku, with Postgres as the primary database and ClickHouse behind our measurement and attribution product. Background work runs on Sidekiq. JavaScript in the application is minimal, and is mostly Turbo and Stimulus with some Bootstrap. A separate Python application handles all of the machine learning. Infrastructure is managed in Terraform across AWS, GCP and Cloudflare. Day to day we work in Claude Code and Codex, with MCP servers wired into ClickHouse, Postgres, New Relic, Rollbar, CircleCI and Trello so our agents can gather their own evidence.

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of software development experience
  • Expertise with Agile web development, with practices such as TDD and Refactoring
  • Fluency working with AI coding agents day to day, or the obvious appetite for it. You do not need our exact toolchain, but you should be someone who reviews what an agent hands you rather than trusting it.
  • Clear writing. You will be writing specs, ADRs and documentation read by people who are not engineers.

Nice to Have:

  • Ruby on Rails
  • ClickHouse
  • Python
  • NYC-based
  • Experience designing MCP servers or other LLM-facing APIs
  • Background in ad tech
  • Interest in the podcasting world

Compensation and benefits:

  • Competitive base salary and bonus structure
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage - individual coverage is free
  • Company-subsidized family coverage
  • Home office improvement reimbursement up to $500 per year
  • Company laptop and external monitor
  • 11 company holidays
  • 20 PTO days for vacation, illness, and personal time

More about Magellan AI

Magellan AI is a first mover, early-stage SaaS startup funded by Brooklyn Bridge Ventures, C2 ventures and a few independent investors. The company was founded in 2016 by Cameron Hendrix (formerly Goldman Sachs) and Rex Madden (formerly Stride Consulting NYC). Magellan AI is the all-in-one platform for audio advertising intelligence, media planning, and measurement. Advertiser and agency media buyers rely on Magellan AI's audio media planning and measurement platform to discover, connect with, and analyze the performance of broadcast radio, podcasts, streaming audio, and YouTube. Publishers trust Magellan AI to grow audio ad sales with intelligence and performance measurement, powered by the world's largest database of podcast advertising data, covering over 60,000 podcasts. You will have the chance to shape the direction of a popular product in a rapidly evolving industry.

We’re a remote-first company (though we’re still based in NYC). We offer great benefits for our size (medical, dental, equipment stipend, vacation), off-site retreats, as well as a generous options grant.

Magellan AI is an equal opportunity employer; in keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on gender, sexual orientation, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, marital domestic partner status, physical ability, gender identity, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination and harassment based on 'protected categories,' we also strive to prevent other, subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (e.g., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our company culture. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at Magellan AI.

Salary: $100,000 – $140,000 / year

jobs.title: YouTube Long-Form Editor
jobs.excerpt: Job PurposeThe YouTube Long-Form Editor owns the end-to-end edit pipeline across two channels in The Scalable Company's orbit: • Roland Frasier (partner): 3-4 long-form videos per month, totaling 3–6 hours of finished content.
jobs.description:
Job Purpose

The YouTube Long-Form Editor owns the end-to-end edit pipeline across two channels in The Scalable Company's orbit:

  • Roland Frasier (partner): 3-4 long-form videos per month, totaling 3–6 hours of finished content.
  • Ryan Deiss (CEO): 3-4 long-form videos per month, totaling 3–6 hours of finished content.

You're the person who turns hours of unstructured camera files into the kind of long-form videos that actually get watched: tight pacing, clean audio, deliberate B-roll, and structure that earns the viewer's attention all the way through.

Important context: Until now, both channels have been edited by an outside agency. You are not stepping into a polished in-house pipeline. You are stepping in to build it. The templates, the asset libraries, the project organization, the revision workflow, the feedback loops — none of that exists in-house yet. You'll be designing and refining those foundational systems alongside the Senior Content Strategist as you do the work.

This is a, strategic, hands-on craft role, and a system-building role. Success looks like videos that publish on time, hold retention above benchmark, require minimal revision rounds — and a documented edit workflow that any future team member could plug into.

Success in this role is measured by on-time publish cadence across both channels, average view duration, revision efficiency, the quality bar of every finished cut, and the durability of the workflows you build.

Critical Accountabilities

  • Own the long-form edit pipeline across both channels — taking raw footage to publish-ready cut for 3-4 Roland Frasier videos per month (~30 min finished length each) and 3-4 Ryan Deiss videos per month (~30 min finished length each).
  • Build the foundational in-house edit workflow from scratch — templates, asset organization, revision loops, feedback systems, project archiving. By month 3, the workflow should be documented well enough that a future team member could plug into it without a 4-week ramp.
  • Build and refine each channel's edit signature — pacing, B-roll usage, music/SFX choices, lower-thirds, transitions. Roland and Ryan have distinct voices and audiences. Your job is to make each channel feel unmistakably like itself.
  • Manage project files, asset libraries, and version control in Frame.io and Premiere — projects organized, archives clean, revisions clearly tracked so nothing gets lost or duplicated.
  • Direct your own creative decisions on cuts, pacing, and structure — bring the Senior Content Strategist a draft that's ready to evaluate, not a rough assembly that requires rebuilding.
  • Iterate fast on revision feedback — target is ≤2 revision rounds per video. You take notes well, ask the right clarifying questions before opening the project, and ship the next version quickly.
  • Watch the analytics on your own work — pull YouTube Studio retention curves on every published video and adjust future edits based on where audiences are dropping off.

What Success Looks Like

  • Videos ship on cadence across both channels, week after week, without the Senior Content Strategist having to ask "where are we" the day before publish.
  • Both Roland's and Ryan's channels have recognizable, distinct edit signatures — visibly improving quarter over quarter.
  • The in-house edit workflow is documented, organized, and durable — onboarding a junior editor or motion designer down the road would take no more than 2 weeks.
  • Revision rounds stay at 2 or fewer per video because your first draft already accounts for each channel's voice and the strategist's priorities.
  • Project files are clean, archived, and findable months later — no panic searches for a missing B-roll clip.
  • You proactively flag what's not working in the raw footage before spending hours editing around a problem.

KPIs / Success Metrics

Primary KPIs (Core Success Metrics)

  • On-Time Publish Rate: % of videos delivered publish-ready by the agreed-upon date (target: 95%+).
  • Output Volume: 6-8 finished long-form videos per month across both channels (3-4 Roland + 3-4 Ryan), totaling 6–8 hours of finished content.
  • Watch Time / Retention: Channel-wide Watch Time trends upward & 30s retention is improving over time.
  • Revision Rounds per Video: Average revision rounds before approval (target: ≤2).
  • Workflow Maturity: Documented and adopted in-house edit pipeline by month 3 — project organization standards, revision tracking, asset libraries, template projects, feedback loops.

Secondary KPIs

  • Editor Turnaround Time: Time from raw footage handoff to first-cut delivery.
  • Average View Duration: vs. channel baseline, trending up.
  • Audio Quality: Evaluated by the Senior Content Strategist on each publish.
  • Re-use Library Growth: Reusable templates, lower-thirds, transitions, and SFX organized for faster future builds.

Who You'll Work With

You'll report directly to our Senior Content Strategist — the person who owns the CEO's content strategy across every channel (long-form, short-form, podcast, the whole ecosystem).

This is someone who owns the content strategy and editorial calendar across every channel, directs every video shoot, and serves as the connective tissue that keeps every piece of content on-brand and on-cadence. They know exactly what good looks like, and they'll push you to do work you're proud of because they're protecting these channels as brand assets — not just content outputs.

If you want to be told what to do down to the cut, this isn't the seat. If you want a strategic partner who will give you real creative latitude and real creative feedback, this is exactly the seat.

You'll also collaborate directly with both Ryan Deiss (CEO) and Roland Frasier (partner) — sometimes on creative direction for upcoming videos, sometimes on feedback for what you've already cut. Bring your point of view. We're not hiring you to push buttons. We're hiring you to help us build a channel.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of full-time experience editing long-form YouTube content (15+ minute videos), with a portfolio of at least 5 published long-form edits where you were the primary editor.
  • Comfortable building systems from scratch — you've been the first editor at a place before, or you've built your own pipeline in a freelance or agency-spinoff context. You don't need a pre-existing template library to be productive. You create the templates.
  • Strong motion graphics and animation proficiency — every video we ship needs polished animated B-roll, kinetic typography, data visualizations, and motion design that elevates the storytelling. This is not occasional polish — it's a core deliverable on every video. We don't ship cuts that look like uncut interviews with lower-thirds slapped on.
  • Expert-level Davinci Resolve Studio or Adobe Premiere Pro proficiency — multicam, nested sequences, audio mixing, color correction, and proxy workflows. You do not need to learn this on the job.
  • Strong audio engineering instincts — you know how to use EQ, compression, and noise reduction to make dialogue sound clean without making it sound processed.
  • Demonstrated storytelling instinct — your portfolio shows you understand pacing, narrative structure, and how to keep a viewer watching past the 3-minute mark.
  • Frame.io (or equivalent review tool) proficiency — you know how to organize project assets, run a clean revision loop, and keep version history sane.
  • Self-managing on deadlines — you don't need a project manager. You see the publish calendar, you back-time the work, and you deliver.
  • AI fluency — you use AI tools daily (Opus 5.5 for Motion Graphics, Premiere AI features, transcription, B-roll search, etc.) to move faster and test more. This is a competitive advantage we expect on Day 1.
  • A workstation capable of editing 4K ProRes footage without performance issues — we'll cover software, plugins, and asset libraries, but you provide the machine.
  • Strong written communication — you give and receive feedback in writing without drama. You can read a revision note and ask the right clarifying question instead of guessing.

Nice to Haves

  • Color grading chops in DaVinci Resolve or experience with high-end Lumetri work.
  • Experience editing for a founder or CEO person brand channel in the B2B or entrepreneurship niche — you understand the difference between editing for a corporate brand and editing for a person and actively follow some of the bigger names in the space.
  • Comfort cutting clips for short-form repurposing (Reels / Shorts / TikTok) — even if it's not your primary deliverable.
  • YouTube Studio analytics fluency — you can pull a retention graph and tell us what story it's telling.

Benefits

Salary Band: $70,000 – $85,000 / year

Benefits: Full-time employees are eligible for health and welfare benefits including:

  • Competitive Salary + Performance-Based Compensation
  • Health, Dental, + Vision Insurance
  • HSA Plan with Company Matching (for eligible HDHP enrollees)
  • Company-Paid Telemedicine Plan
  • Company-Paid Mental Wellness, Financial Wellness, + Legal Counseling Services
  • Company-Paid Life and Disability Insurance
  • Unlimited PTO
  • 401K Plan with Company Matching
  • Parental Leave
  • And more...

About the Team

The Agentic Security Engineering team is a horizontal, shared services engineering team that enables every Databricks security function AI-native. We enable building the AI agents, "personas," and own the shared platform that security teams across the org (Detection & Response, Threat Intelligence, Vulnerability & Product Security, Red Team, GRC, and Continuous Monitoring) build on to operate at machine speed, safely and reliably.

We leverage AI to transform how security is done.

The Role

As a Senior Staff Security Software Engineer on the Agentic Security Engineering team, you will be a senior technical authority and architect for Databricks’ shared Security AI platform.

You will define the platform architecture, technical standards, and multi-year engineering direction that allow security teams to build, deploy, and operate governed AI personas safely at scale. Your work will span secure agent identity, isolation and sandboxing, policy enforcement, auditability, observability, evaluation, orchestration, and reliable integration with Databricks and security infrastructure.

You will operate across organizational boundaries, aligning engineering and security leaders on platform architecture, driving adoption of common patterns, and resolving complex technical problems that affect multiple security functions. You will influence the quality, safety, reliability, and velocity of the broader Security AI ecosystem without owning the domain logic or business outcomes of every individual persona.

The Impact You Will Have

Shared Security AI Platform Architecture

  • Define and evolve the architecture for the shared Security AI platform and its paved road for governed agentic workflows.
  • Establish reusable patterns for agent identity, least-privilege access, sandboxing, egress control, secret isolation, policy enforcement, auditability, and rollback.
  • Set engineering standards for reliability, observability, evaluation, incident response, cost instrumentation, and safe production deployment.
  • Make high-leverage build, buy, and adopt decisions that keep the platform focused on security-specific capabilities while using Databricks platform primitives wherever they meet the need.
  • Design the platform to support secure multi-agent workflows, tool registries, policy-aware orchestration, and agent-to-agent collaboration.

Reliable and Safe Agentic Systems at Scale

  • Lead the design and development of production-grade platform capabilities that enable security personas to operate reliably across a growing AI and security surface.
  • Define how the platform measures successful runs, latency, failure rates, rollback readiness, safety, governance coverage, trust, autonomy, and business value.
  • Establish qualification and maturity mechanisms that determine what a security persona may do, what controls it requires, and how it earns additional autonomy.
  • Drive technical solutions for high-risk workflows, including offensive security personas, untrusted inputs, sensitive data, production access, and automated tool execution.
  • Improve the velocity of safe AI development without compromising security, governance, or operational reliability.

Cross-Organizational Technical Leadership

  • Serve as a technical authority for the shared Security AI platform across Security Operations, Product Security, Governance and Risk, Compliance and Assurance, Enterprise Security, and other partner functions.
  • Align engineering and security leaders on platform direction, architectural tradeoffs, adoption priorities, and standards for safe agentic systems.
  • Partner with AI Champions and domain teams to turn recurring cross-functional needs into reusable platform capabilities.
  • Represent the platform in architecture reviews and technical decisions involving agent identity, isolation, policy, observability, evaluation, orchestration, and secure integration.
  • Drive adoption of common platform patterns and retire duplicated or inconsistent implementations across security teams.

Mentorship and Team Capability

  • Mentor engineers on distributed systems, platform architecture, AI security engineering, agentic threat modeling, and technical leadership.
  • Lead high-rigor design reviews and raise the bar for reliability, operability, security, and maintainability.
  • Help establish a culture of measurable outcomes, disciplined evaluation, safe experimentation, and continuous improvement.
  • Influence technical direction beyond the immediate team through clear written proposals, architecture reviews, and cross-functional execution.

What We Look For

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, security platform architecture, or systems security, with a proven track record of operating at an L7/Senior Staff level at a major cloud, platform, or high-growth tech company.
  • Production Systems Engineering: Exceptional fluency in Python and modern cloud-native systems architecture (Kubernetes, distributed streaming/storage, high-throughput microservices) with experience delivering fault-tolerant, low-latency security infrastructure.
  • Multi-Org Architectural Execution: Demonstrated ability to align multiple VP/Engineering Director-level organizations on complex technical strategies and successfully ship multi-quarter architectural transformations.
  • Deep practical expertise in AI/ML security, agentic system trust boundaries, prompt injection and tool-use risks, adversarial testing, identity and authorization, data protection, and secure deployment of AI-enabled systems.
  • Experience designing platform guardrails for sensitive workflows involving untrusted input, privileged tools, secrets, production systems, or confidential data.
  • Strong technical communication skills, including the ability to explain complex platform, security, and reliability tradeoffs to engineers, security leaders, and senior executives.
  • A track record of raising the technical bar through design reviews, mentorship, written architecture proposals, and influence beyond formal reporting lines.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building secure agent platforms, developer platforms, security control planes, or internal infrastructure used by multiple teams.
  • Experience with MLOps, AI serving infrastructure, security data platforms, detection systems, or large-scale security automation.
  • Published research, patents, or recognized contributions in adversarial ML, AI safety frameworks, or open-source security platforms.
  • Hands-on experience building or securing large-scale LLM training pipelines, vector databases, or AI agent runtime environments.

The Senior Informaticist serves as a strategic analytics partner supporting CenterWell Traditional Pharmacy. As the analytics environment increasingly incorporates AI-assisted capabilities such as Databricks Genie One, success in this role is less dependent on advanced programming expertise and increasingly dependent on business acumen, analytical curiosity, sound judgment, and the ability to critically evaluate analytical results. The Senior Informaticist will use governed data and AI-assisted analytical tools to investigate business performance, identify potential drivers of headwinds and tailwinds, test hypotheses, and help business partners understand not only what is occurring, but why it is occurring and what actions may improve outcomes.

The Senior Informaticist serves as a strategic problem solver who partners across business, operations, technology, and analytics teams to address complex and often ambiguous challenges. You will identify opportunities, framing problems, evaluating alternatives, and delivering grounded recommendations that guide measurable outcomes. Success requires the ability to create clarity in uncertain situations, balance competing priorities, and develop practical solutions when perfect information is not available.

Key responsibilities include:

jobs.description:
Remote role in the USA

Role Overview 🚀

Uncapped lends working capital to e-commerce sellers across the UK, US and Canada. Some of that business comes through partners: credit brokers, affiliates, agencies, software companies and embedded platforms who introduce sellers to us. Brokers are our largest partner group.

We are looking for someone to own that channel completely. You will decide which partners we go after, bring them in, get them referring, and be accountable for the revenue that comes out of it. It is a broad remit and a visible one. The channel's number is reported weekly and you will be the person who explains it.

You will have a proper stack behind you. PartnerStack is the partner system of record, HubSpot is the CRM, Clay handles enrichment and list building, Instantly and HeyReach run outbound, and Customer.io runs lifecycle comms. All of it is live and already connected, so your time goes on partners and programs rather than on setting tools up.

This is a hands-on role. You will do the prospecting, build the campaigns and run the reporting yourself. Marketing will build assets you brief and Analytics will build you reporting you ask for, but nobody is dedicated to this channel. If you want to manage a book of relationships and have someone else own the pipeline, the tools and the numbers, this is not the right job. If you want a channel that is genuinely yours to run, it is.

About Uncapped 👫

Founded in 2019, Uncapped is a leading fintech provider of working & growth capital to e-commerce companies in North America and Europe. We leverage multiple data sources and use cutting-edge models to make credit decisions faster and safer. We work with some of the largest global e-commerce platforms — including Amazon and Walmart — and strive to be the best alternative lender globally.

What will you do ✍️

1. Recruitment: bring new partners in

Build and work the pipeline of new brokers, affiliates, agencies and platforms. Source lists in Clay, run sequences through Instantly and HeyReach, take the meetings, agree terms, and get them live in PartnerStack. You are doing your own prospecting.

2. Activation: get them to a first funded deal

Signing a partner is the easy part. Getting them to send a first deal, and then a second, is where most partner programs stall. Own the path from signed agreement to first submission to first funded deal, and set yourself a time limit on it.

3. Top partners management: keep them close and keep them informed

The partners who produce need real attention. Regular contact, honest feedback on what is converting and what is not, quarterly reviews, co-marketing, early sight of new products. A lot of this is teaching. A broker who understands what we lend against and who we lend to will send better deals, not just more of them.

4. The long tail: run it as a program

Most of the base will never justify a monthly call. Those partners still need to hear from us, so build the always-on layer that reaches them: segmented Customer.io journeys, newsletters, product and rate updates, reactivation campaigns, and self-serve material in the partner portal. Decide what good looks like for this group and measure whether the program is working.

5. Deal outcomes: own the channel's number

Our AEs work the deals that partners send. You are still accountable for what happens to them. Chase deals that stall, unblock what is stuck in underwriting, make sure partners hear back, and fix routing when a deal sits with the wrong person. Close the loop with partners on declines and losses so their next submission is better.

6. Partner economics and commission

Commission is a share of the fees we earn, and the rate varies by partner. You will run the payouts, keep attribution accurate, and understand what each partner costs us against what they bring in. Bring us recommendations on which rates should change.

7. Reporting and forecasting

Own the weekly channel report and the forecast: applications, approvals, funded deals and originations, measured against plan. You will be the person who explains the number each week, including in the weeks it is bad.

Requirements

Who you are 👀

Must have

  • 3+ years in partnerships, channel sales, or a similar commercial role. Lending, fintech, payments or e-commerce SaaS is useful background but not essential
  • A track record of building pipeline from scratch and converting it, whether that was partners, direct sales or something else
  • Comfort owning a revenue number and reporting against a plan
  • Working knowledge of a GTM stack. A CRM plus at least one of a PRM, a sequencing tool or a lifecycle marketing platform. You should be happy setting things up yourself rather than raising a request for it

Nice to have

  • PartnerStack, HubSpot, Clay, Instantly, HeyReach or Customer.io specifically
  • SQL, or a habit of building your own reporting rather than waiting for it
  • Having worked on building a channel, rather than inheriting one that already ran

Benefits

At Uncapped, our people make us successful. We're a start-up with big goals — we work hard, and we want to give everyone the benefits they really want. Some of what you can expect:

  • Competitive base + uncapped commission — top performers earn meaningfully
  • Unlimited holiday — well-rested people make the best closers
  • MacBook
  • Personal growth fund — raise your game from great to spectacular
  • Monthly recognition and awards — celebrate wins big and small
  • The opportunity to close deals every day with US e-commerce founders building real businesses

We can only consider applications from candidates eligible to work in the USA without requiring visa sponsorship.

Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. A Senior Director serves as a leader within Gartner’s Business and Technology Insights (BTI) group, establishing oneself as a credible voice within their designated market at local, regional and global levels. Utilizing exceptional research and analytical skills, a Senior Director plays a significant role in producing pragmatic and provocative insights which Gartner clients consume and apply to propel their business toward key objectives. They are a trusted source of advice for clients, reinforcing Gartner’s value every day by engaging them via in-person meetings, virtual meetings, sales support visits and Gartner conferences to discuss complex client challenges and offer appropriate recommendations.

What you will do:

  • Create innovative, thought provoking, and highly leveraged “must-have insights” content

  • Develop new insights and ideas through thought leadership and offer compelling, actionable approaches to client's needs and requests that accelerate the client's ability to act

  • Develop in-depth analysis to identify the root cause of a client’s barriers or overall needs and reframe thinking to drive strategy forward

  • Demonstrate thought leadership in establishing Insights positions across a team of analysts

  • Bring provocative, independent insights to Gartner leaders that can evolve the course of a research agenda

  • Research, analyze and predict market trends and shifts to provide clients and vendors with actionable insights

  • Provide clients and prospects with actionable advice aligned to their designated content area via virtual or face-to-face interactions

  • Create and deliver high value presentation materials on and off stage for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and client briefings

  • Support BTI and Sales: Provide sales support serving as voice of the market to help Insights teams create content and to drive engagement with clients to make progress against their critical priorities to grow their business

  • Provide high quality and timely content peer review

  • Actively participate in innovation, ideation, and research discussions and collaborate effectively with peers in the Insights community

  • Be a mentor and a coach by supporting more junior team members

  • Be client-centric while actively seeking to help clients engage regularly and often with Gartner insights and interactions

What you will need:

  • Bachelor's degree and 12+ years of relevant field or industry experience or an equivelant combination of education and experience

  • Demonstrate experience in leading enterprise leadership capability strategies, experience redesigning leadership models for AI, digital transformation and organizational change

  • Demonstrate executive presence; can immediately establish credibility with executives and additional stakeholders

  • Strong organizational skills; ability to work under tight deadlines and produce high quality deliverables

  • Demonstrate excellence in research and writing ability

  • Strong written and verbal proficiency, analytical and presentation skills; ability to engage clients and respond effectively to questions

  • Proficient in analyzing and synthesizing data; can effectively apply patterns and frameworks while drawing and defending conclusions to client challenges

  • Strong communication skills - able to explain complex concepts concisely and simply

  • Subject matter expertise; comfortable presenting at large and small-scale speaking engagements

  • Ability to represent Gartner's research methodology and strategies effectively at all levels

  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% (where applicable)

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.

In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

jobs.description:
The Senior Database Administrator is responsible for the design, implementation, optimization, and support of Experity’s cloud-native database platforms, focusing primarily on Aurora PostgreSQL and MySQL running on AWS RDS.


This role plays a critical part in ensuring high availability, performance, scalability, and security of mission-critical SaaS databases. The DBA partners closely with Engineering, DevOps, and Infrastructure teams to operate a highly observable, resilient, and cost-efficient data platform.


This role is expected to act as a technical leader in database reliability and performance, influencing architecture decisions, mentoring team members, and driving operational excellence across multiple database platforms.


Responsibilities:

  • Deploy, configure, and manage PostgreSQL and MySQL databases in AWS RDS and Aurora environments.
  • Configure and manage MySQL parameter groups, option groups, automated backups, snapshots, and maintenance windows.
  • Architect and support high availability solutions leveraging clusters, read replicas, Multi-AZ deployments, writer/reader endpoint strategies and read scaling.
  • Monitor and mitigate replication lag across replicas to ensure read consistency and performance.
  • Tune and manage database-specific parameters.
  • Optimize workloads for Aurora storage architecture, including I/O patterns, autovacuum behavior, and checkpoint tuning.
  • Optimize database indexing, query execution plans, and MySQL InnoDB configuration for production workloads
  • Monitor and troubleshoot database performance using AWS CloudWatch, DataDog, and Database-native tools (e.g., pg_stat_statements, EXPLAIN).
  • Analyze and optimize query performance, indexing strategies, and resource utilization.
  • Investigate and resolve complex production issues, including locking, blocking, replication lag, and connection saturation.
  • Implement and manage backup and recovery strategies including point-in-time recovery (PITR), automated snapshots, and cross-region resilience.
  • Partner with engineering teams to improve schema design, query patterns, and database access efficiency.
  • Drive observability best practices, including alerting, logging, and performance metrics across database environments.
  • Optimize cloud database cost and performance, including instance sizing, storage utilization, and workload tuning.
  • Support and contribute to database migrations and modernization efforts.
  • Automate database provisioning and operations using Infrastructure-as-Code and scripting.
  • Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement processes.
  • Support MySQL version upgrades, patching, and database migrations with minimal downtime.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.

Experience:

  • Minimum 5 years of database administration experience, with 3+ years focused on PostgreSQL in high-volume OLTP production environments.
  • 2+ years administering MySQL in production, preferably on AWS RDS.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS Aurora PostgreSQL and AWS RDS MySQL.
  • Deep understanding of PostgreSQL internals, including query planner, indexing, vacuuming, WAL, and replication.
  • Strong understanding of MySQL architecture, including InnoDB storage engine, replication, indexing, and query optimization.
  • Proven expertise in database performance tuning and troubleshooting in high-availability, high-throughput environments.
  • Experience supporting systems with significant transaction volume (e.g., 100–200+ TPS) and scaling for continued growth.
  • Experience troubleshooting contention scenarios, including locking, blocking, connection saturation, and long-running transactions.
  • Experience with AWS services including RDS, Aurora, EC2, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch, and S3.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as DataDog and CloudWatch.
  • Experience designing and supporting High Availability and Disaster Recovery solutions.
  • Strong understanding of relational database design and data modeling.
  • Experience with automation (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar) and scripting (Python, Bash, etc.).
  • Experience operating in a production SaaS or high-transaction environment.

Team Member Competencies:

  • Demonstrates ownership and accountability for production systems.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with engineering and operations teams.
  • Communicates clearly and effectively in both technical and non-technical contexts.
  • Continuously seeks to improve processes, performance, and reliability.

POSITION SUMMARY: The Software Development Engineer in Test provides testing services that mitigate the risk of software defects and increase the quality, effectiveness, and efficiency of Republic Services’ software solutions. In addition, this role leads the end-to-end quality of projects within the Company’s Web, Mobile, and other Application Portfolios through test automation. The Software Development Engineer in Test is responsible for architecting new automated test strategies and frameworks in addition to creating, testing, and planning for both manual and automated test frameworks to optimize the testing of complex web and mobile applications. This role must demonstrate innovation, leadership, and mentorship skills in addition to possessing a strong technical and programming/test automation skill set. The Software Development Engineer in Test delivers creative and innovative solutions to support the development team through planning and prioritization of test design, test development, and test automation activities to be accomplished within an Agile methodology or other methodologies in support of a Continuous Delivery Pipeline with frequent application releases.


PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Coaches and mentors Software Test Engineers in the execution of automated testing efforts.
  • Leads effort to review product specifications and work with others to develop appropriate test strategies, detailed test plans, and test architectures.
  • Leads formal reviews of test plans, designs, and requirements with cross-functional teams.
  • Participates in the evaluation of new tools and technologies to continue enhancing the automation framework.
  • Researches, develops and/or recommends tools to assist Software Test Engineers in test planning, execution, and reporting.
  • Develops, debugs, and maintains test automation for applications and services.
  • Develops, implements, and automates test plans and test cases in an Agile environment.
  • Builds, executes, and maintains automated test frameworks for end to end integration testing across applications, devices, and platforms using JavaScript or other appropriate languages such as C#, Java, and TypeScript.
  • Builds automation and test coverage tools using JavaScript or other appropriate languages to enable Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery.
  • Builds or uses existing automation tools to test interfaces between systems and applications such as web services, Tibco services, or other APIs.
  • Accountable for all aspects of quality within the software development team.
  • Tracks and prioritizes defects throughout product releases and lifecycles.
  • Uses quality control tools and metrics to discover defects and make recommendations for resolution.
  • Report defects found through test automation.
  • Works with Agile teams or other IT teams to plan, estimate, schedule and execute testing for applications including:
    • Establishes, organizes and executes testing deliverables.
    • Documents and executes complex software test plans and strategies.
    • Ensures traceability of test cases back to project requirements.
    • Executes end to end test scenarios.
    • Coordinates and supports user-acceptance test plans.
    • Works with an Agile team or other IT teams to report and resolve complex issues.
  • Ensures software applications meet functional requirements.
  • Participates in all aspects of testing at all levels, including functional, system, regression and load testing.
  • Works collaboratively with Software Test Engineers and Developers.
  • Tests manually, as needed.
  • Records and reports on testing metrics.
  • Follows test documentation standards and makes updates as necessary.
  • Performs other job-related duties as assigned or apparent.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience with software automation testing methodologies including regression, functional, unit, integration, coverage, performance and load.
  • Experience testing applications that integrate with other systems through RESTful API's.
  • Experience with test management tools such as qTest, ALM, TFS, or similar tools.
  • Experience with API testing frameworks such as Karate, Gatling, JMeter, or Postman.
  • Some experience with load and performance testing.
  • Knowledge of Cloud platforms and services such as Amazon AWS, Azure, Heroku, Perfecto Mobile, and SauceLabs.
  • Experience in reviewing and providing feedback to team members during pull requests.
  • Understanding of Service Oriented Architecture.
  • Strong critical thinking skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal skills.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

  • 2 - 4 years of software test experience with test automation and a focus on web, mobile, database, or web services.
  • Experience in Agile software development methodology using tools such as Rally, Jira, ServiceNow, or similar tools.
  • Advanced understanding of open-source web frameworks and web application testing tools.

Rewarding Compensation and Benefits

Eligible employees can elect to participate in:
• Comprehensive medical benefits coverage, dental plans and vision coverage.
• Health care and dependent care spending accounts.

• Short- and long-term disability.

• Life insurance and accidental death & dismemberment insurance.

EEO STATEMENT:Republic Services is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, relationship or association with a protected veteran (spouses or other family members), genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. For any concerns relating to Republic Services’ commitment to equal opportunity employment, you may contact the AWARE Line at 1-866-3-AWARE-4.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).


RECENT RECOGNITION

  • Barron’s 100 Most Sustainable Companies
  • CDP Discloser
  • Dow Jones Best-In-Class Indices
  • Ethisphere’s World’s Most Ethical Companies
  • Fortune World’s Most Admired Companies
  • Great Place to Work
  • Sustainability Yearbook S&P Global

10-06-2026

The Company expects to accept applications for this position until the posting end date but encourages interested applicants to apply as soon as possible.

ABOUT GREYSTAR


Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

The S2C Operations Advocate provides day-to-day support for an assigned portfolio within Upstream Source-to-Contract functions, including supplier record setup and maintenance, compliance program support, and third-party credentialing coordination. This role maintains supplier attributes across property accounting systems, supports training and troubleshooting for assigned properties, and partners with the Manager, S2C – Operations to ensure consistent, compliant supplier support.

JOB DESCRIPTION

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Supplier Record & Compliance Support

  • Assist assigned portfolio with the supplier compliance program, third-party credentialing processes, and e-procurement system, including ongoing training on these systems.
  • Maintain supplier record setup and attributes across property accounting systems, ensuring accuracy and compliance with owner requirements.
  • Maintain working knowledge of supplier requirements and order/invoice processing procedures to ensure consistent process adherence.
  • Assist third-party suppliers with onboarding, registration, and general inquiries related to compliance and credentialing requirements.
  • Serve as an escalation point for bank account validation exceptions, conducting additional supplier outreach when automated validation checks fail.

Help Desk & Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Provide ongoing support by maintaining the Help Desk queue and responding to tickets and emails within established timeframes.
  • Interact with accounting, operations, and other departments to ensure changes and processes are understood and followed.
  • Escalate complex or higher-priority issues to the Sr. S2C Operations Advocate or Manager, S2C (Upstream) – Operations, as needed.

Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Complete financial, administrative, and other reports and analyses as assigned.
  • Participate in ongoing process improvement through review and feedback on assigned portfolio processes.
  • Maintain relationships with team members and property-level stakeholders to support consistent execution.

BASIC KNOWLEDGE & QUALIFICATIONS

  • Fluency in French required; proficiency in Canadian French preferred.
  • Property & Casualty Insurance license preferred; applicable experience will also be considered.
  • Relevant experience in procurement, accounts payable, or property operations; college degree a plus but not required.
  • Prior experience in the multi-family real estate industry (e.g., as a Community Manager) preferred, but not required.
  • Demonstrated ability to read, write, and communicate effectively with team members and property-level stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in word processing, spreadsheet, property management, and database management tools.
  • Basic mathematical skills necessary to complete financial records, budgets, and other fiscal reporting information.

SPECIALIZED SKILLS

  • Strong attention to detail and follow-through on assigned portfolio tasks.
  • Comfortable managing a Help Desk queue and responding to routine tickets within SLA.
  • Effective, clear communicator with property-level and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Eager to learn supplier compliance processes and systems; open to coaching from senior team members.
  • Organized, with the ability to manage multiple ongoing requests across an assigned portfolio.

The hourly range for this position is $24.00 - $26.44.

Vividly is the leading modern trade promotion management (TPM) solution built by and for the consumer packaged goods industry. From campaign creation to deductions management and promotion measurement, we help brands manage every element of trade spend. With our easy-to-use platform and industry-leading experience, we pride ourselves on our ability to bring businesses to the next level.

Not familiar with trade promotion spend? That’s OK. Most people aren’t. It’s an $8 trillion dollar problem that is ripe for disruption by an innovative SaaS startup. In order to grow, consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands spend 20% of their topline revenue to get into retailers and promote their products within those retailers. The problem is that today 70% of those promotions are not ROI positive. This is because ROI is hard to track. The industry operates on emails, pdfs, and xls spreadsheets. At Vividly, we’re solving this massive problem with exciting tactics including AI, Machine Learning, and Fintech and adding value to everyone in the chain. Some of our customers include brands you may use and love - Liquid Death, Amy’s, and Perfect Snacks.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for an Account Executive who brings both SaaS sales expertise and a deep understanding of the CPG ecosystem. This is a unique opportunity to operate at the intersection of technology, finance, and commercial strategy - selling a high-impact solution into organizations where trade spend directly influences revenue, margin, and growth. You will own the full sales cycle, lead complex, multi-stakeholder deals, and partner with senior leaders across Sales, Finance, and Operations to drive meaningful business outcomes.

What You’ll Do

Who You Are

You are a consultative, value-driven seller who thrives in complex environments and understands how large organizations make decisions.

You bring a strong grasp of how CPG businesses operate and can confidently engage stakeholders across both commercial and financial functions. You are equally comfortable discussing margin impact with Finance as you are with execution challenges with Sales teams.

You are resourceful, proactive, and motivated by solving real business problems - not just closing deals.

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • 5+ years of quota-carrying experience in SaaS sales, with a track record of closing complex, multi-threaded deals
  • Experience working in or selling into the CPG industry (brand, broker, retailer, or distributor ecosystem)

  • Strong experience with consultative sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDIC, Challenger, SPIN, Sandler, or similar)
  • Demonstrated success in outbound prospecting and building pipeline independently
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and storytelling skills

Highly Preferred

  • Operate in a complex, strategic sales environment: Multi-stakeholder deals with real business impact
  • Define a category: Be part of modernizing trade promotion management—not selling a commoditized solution
  • Leverage your domain expertise: Your CPG knowledge is not a “nice-to-have”—it’s a competitive advantage

Compensation Range:

Base salary: $ 100,000 per year

On-Target Earnings (OTE): $200,000 per year

Your actual earnings may vary depending on performance, quota attainment, ramp period, and other factors.

A modern, remote-first workplace
