jobs.excerpt: About Positron AI Positron AI specializes in developing custom hardware systems to accelerate AI inference.
jobs.description:
About Positron AI

Positron AI specializes in developing custom hardware systems to accelerate AI inference. These inference systems offer significant performance and efficiency gains over traditional GPU-based systems, delivering advantages in both performance per dollar and performance per watt. Positron exists to create the world's best AI inference systems.

Role Overview

Senior Software Engineer – Machine Learning Systems & High-Performance LLM Inference

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to contribute to the development of high-performance software that powers execution of open-source large language models (LLMs) on our custom appliance. This appliance leverages a combination of FPGAs and x86 CPUs to accelerate transformer-based models. The software stack is written primarily in modern C++ (C++17/20) and heavily relies on templates, SIMD optimizations, and efficient parallel computing techniques.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement high-performance inference software for LLMs on custom hardware.
  • Develop and optimize C++-based libraries that efficiently utilize SIMD instructions, threading, and memory hierarchy.
  • Work closely with FPGA and systems engineers to ensure efficient data movement and computational offloading between x86 CPUs and FPGAs.
  • Optimize model execution via low-level optimizations, including vectorization, cache efficiency, and hardware-aware scheduling.
  • Contribute to performance profiling tools and methodologies to analyze execution bottlenecks at the instruction and data flow levels.
  • Apply NUMA-aware memory management techniques to optimize memory access patterns for large-scale inference workloads.
  • Implement ML system-level optimizations such as token streaming, KV cache optimizations, and efficient batching for transformer execution.
  • Collaborate with ML researchers and software engineers to integrate model quantization techniques, sparsity optimizations, and mixed-precision execution.
  • Ensure all code contributions include unit, performance, acceptance, and regression tests as part of a continuous integration-based development process.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional experience in C++ software development, with a focus on performance-critical applications.
  • Strong understanding of C++ templates and modern memory management.
  • Hands-on experience with SIMD programming (AVX-512, SSE, or equivalent) and intrinsics-based vectorization.
  • Experience in high-performance computing (HPC), numerical computing, or ML inference optimization.
  • Experience with ML model execution optimizations, including efficient tensor computations and memory access patterns.
  • Knowledge of multi-threading, NUMA architectures, and low-level CPU optimization.
  • Proficiency with systems-level software development, profiling tools (perfetto, VTune, Valgrind), and benchmarking.
  • Experience working with hardware accelerators (FPGAs, GPUs, or custom ASICs) and designing efficient software-hardware interfaces.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with LLVM/Clang or GCC compiler optimizations.
  • Experience in LLM quantization, sparsity optimizations, and mixed-precision computation.
  • Knowledge of distributed inference techniques and networking optimizations.
  • Understanding of graph partitioning and execution scheduling for large-scale ML models.

Leveling & Scope

While this role is currently posted at a specific level, we are a growth-oriented organization and are open to hiring at a more senior level for the right candidate. Please note that this job description serves as a focused but generalized overview of the role; specific responsibilities and impact expectations will be tailored to the experience and seniority of the final hire.

Why Join Us?

  • Work on a cutting-edge ML inference platform that redefines performance and efficiency for LLMs.
  • Tackle challenging low-level performance engineering problems in AI and HPC.
  • Collaborate with a team of hardware, software, and ML experts building an industry-first product.
  • Opportunity to contribute to and shape the future of open-source AI inference software.

Compensation and Benefits

The base salary range for this role is $150,000 – $250,000.

Please note that the figures provided represent the base salary range only and do not include other elements of our total compensation package, equity, or comprehensive benefits.

At Positron AI, we value the unique expertise each candidate brings. While the range above reflects our typical expectation for the position, we reserve the flexibility to exceed this range for candidates whose specialized skills, significant experience, or unique qualifications fall outside the standard scope of the role. Final offers are determined based on a variety of factors, including internal equity, and individual impact.

Equal Opportunity Employer. If you’re excited about the role but don’t meet every bullet, we’d still love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps/SRE Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Senior DevOps / SRE EngineerThis is a remote position within the UK.
jobs.description:
Senior DevOps / SRE Engineer

This is a remote position within the UK. We currently don’t provide visa sponsorship.

We are a B2B Fintech focusing on disrupting the small business lending market. SMEs make up 99% of all UK businesses yet are traditionally underserved by big banks and financial institutions. Built from nearly a decade of experience powering a digital credit broking marketplace, our SaaS solutions serve banks, lenders, and the wider SME finance ecosystem. Leveraging live, validated transactional data from the UK’s advanced data environment, FXE Technologies’ products drive accurate decisioning and proactive engagement. Our products are used by over 80 leading high street and challenger banks and specialist lenders

Role Description

Behind those products is a platform that has to earn the trust of the institutions that depend on it. FXE is a lean, fast-moving organisation with strong ambitions, and the DevOps team sits at the centre of it. We build and operate multi-tenant platforms used by customers including Tier 1 banks, so everything we build must meet the security, reliability and scale expectations of regulated financial institutions.

It's an exciting time to join. We're delivering several projects that will shape where FXE goes next, and the DevOps team is critical to making them happen.

We're looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to take real ownership of DevOps at FXE. You'll bring deep, hands-on infrastructure and networking expertise, a strong command of Terraform, AWS, identity and access management, delivery pipelines and observability, and recent, extensive experience running infrastructure through automation.

Your decisions on infrastructure, delivery pipelines, operations, FinOps, maintainability and reliability, together with the product and application architecture decisions you help shape, will directly determine how fast the business ships, how confidently it scales and how well it holds up under pressure.

This isn't a role where you quietly maintain someone else's designs. You'll create and help define them. You'll lead infrastructure and delivery initiatives end to end, hold your own in design and planning discussions with the most experienced engineers in the company, and bring modern DevOps, SRE and security thinking to how we build, deploy and run systems.

You'll also be a bridge between DevOps and Engineering. You'll understand infrastructure deeply, but you'll also be able to read, reason about and ideally contribute to application code, so that platform and application decisions are made together rather than handed over a wall.

Beyond product infrastructure and delivery pipelines, the DevOps team is responsible for FXE's security systems, supports our corporate IT infrastructure (including Microsoft 365 and our zero-trust network access), and assists with compliance activity such as SOC 2 and Cyber Essentials Plus. This role shares in all of that, not just product-facing infrastructure.

If you want a role where your judgement genuinely counts, where your thinking will be challenged rather than rubber-stamped, and where the scope runs from network design to production reliability to shaping how Engineering and DevOps work together, this is it.

What you'll do

Infrastructure & platform

  • Design, build and operate cloud infrastructure on AWS, with a strong emphasis on IAM and identity services, compute and container services such as EC2 and EKS, networking (VPC design, routing, service mesh, load balancing, DNS, connectivity, segmentation and security boundaries), database services, serverless (e.g. Lambda, Step Functions) and analytics services.
  • Own infrastructure-as-code using Terraform and the delivery pipelines that move code changes across environments.
  • Design for resilience, maintainability, availability (multi-AZ, failover, self-healing, backup and recovery), security and operability (observability, alerting, capacity), and overall functional and non-functional suitability, efficiency, and effectiveness.
  • Securely and reliably integrate and configure 3rd party services used to complement the AWS environment.
  • Use languages such as Python to automate DevOps tasks and support production capabilities owned by DevOps
  • Identify, document, and remediate as necessary infrastructure and platform-level technical risks following established processes.

Delivery pipelines and developer experience

  • Design, build and maintain software delivery (CI/CD) pipelines that are fast, reliable and secure by default.
  • Build and maintain infrastructure-as-code configuration, security and guardrail solutions (e.g. Helm charts, Open Policy Agent policies, and EKS admission controllers) to enforce secure, consistent deployment patterns across environments.
  • Improve build, test, release and deployment workflows in collaboration with Engineering.
  • Contribute to environment strategy (dev/test/staging/production) and release management strategies.
  • Support the Engineers during rollouts and deployments.

Bridging DevOps and Engineering

  • Work directly with Engineering teams to understand application-level constraints, so infrastructure and pipeline decisions reflect real delivery needs.
  • Ideally, read, debug and reason about backend and/or frontend code where needed, enough to have credible technical conversations with engineers, contribute to root-cause analysis, and make informed platform decisions that account for application behaviour.
  • Represent DevOps in architecture, design and planning discussions, including with senior engineers and product, and be able to constructively challenge and defend a technical position, as well as understand when trade-offs are necessary.

Leadership and initiative

  • Take ownership of significant infrastructure and delivery initiatives from proposal through to delivery and operations.
  • Research emerging tools, practices and approaches to identify improvements to our platform, delivery pipelines and operational processes, and propose practical, well-reasoned solutions to the problems you find.
  • Participate as a peer in design and planning conversations across DevOps and Engineering, contributing independent judgement rather than executing instructions.
  • Support the Head of Architecture and Security and the other DevOps Engineers in technical direction-setting and be capable of covering senior technical decisions and initiatives in their absence.
  • Document significant technical decisions (e.g. via ADRs/RFCs), review and contribute to RFCs written by Engineers, and to the team's standards, patterns and reference architectures.

Monitoring, observability and reliability

  • Design observability across infrastructure and services: metrics, logs, tracing and alerting that give early warning rather than after-the-fact explanations.
  • Bring SRE practice into how the team works: define and track metrics where meaningful, drive incident response and blameless post-incident review, and turn recurring issues into permanent fixes rather than repeat firefighting.
  • Continuously improve signal quality, reduce alert noise, close observability gaps, and make it fast to answer "what's actually happening in production right now".

Security, IT infrastructure and compliance support

  • Evaluate, monitor, and improve as necessary the security resilience of FXE’s systems. Keep IT and network controls aligned with security and architecture requirements, and to keep audit evidence current and defensible.
  • Help support and operate FXE's corporate IT infrastructure, including Microsoft 365 (identity, device management, mail, collaboration tooling) in collaboration with a 3rd party, and our ZTNA network.
  • Assist with technical evidence, control implementation and remediation work for compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 and Cyber Essentials Plus.
  • Balance this work proportionately alongside product infrastructure and delivery responsibilities, this is a supporting part of the role, not the majority of it.

What we are looking for

Essential

  • Extensive, hands-on experience in infrastructure; you can design, troubleshoot and reason about network architecture at depth, not just consume managed services.
  • Real experience developing, deploying and supporting complex infrastructures made up of many moving parts, not just designing them on a whiteboard. The kind of knowledge and judgement that only comes from having built these systems, watched them break, and fixed them under pressure.
  • Strong, production-grade experience with Infrastructure as Code, including design, state management and multi-environment workflows, as well as scripting languages such as Python.
  • Deep working knowledge of AWS across compute, networking, storage, IAM, and managed services in a multi-account setup.
  • In-depth understanding of access controls, encryption, and networking concepts and protocols.
  • Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD delivery pipelines in a production environment.
  • Experience with containerisation and orchestration (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes or equivalent).
  • Experience implementing security and guardrail controls in Infrastructure as Code and Kubernetes environments to enforce policy at deploy time rather than relying solely on after-the-fact review.
  • Solid experience with monitoring and observability tooling (metrics, logging, tracing, alerting) and using it to drive real reliability improvements, not just dashboards.
  • SRE experience or equivalent; comfortable owning production reliability, leading or contributing to incident response, and working from SLIs/SLOs where appropriate.
  • Recent, hands-on experience developing and supporting modern, multi-tenant systems, using AI-assisted tooling and workflows in day-to-day engineering, current DevOps practices, and close, ongoing collaboration with developers/engineers.
  • Track record of taking technical ownership of initiatives from design through to delivery, with minimal oversight.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate as a credible technical peer in design and architecture discussions with senior/lead-level engineers.
  • Working knowledge of software development sufficient to read and reason about application code (backend and/or frontend) and engage meaningfully with engineers on design trade-offs.
  • Solid understanding of resilience, security and operability considerations in infrastructure design (e.g. failover, backup/recovery, least-privilege access, secrets management, observability).
  • Strong written and verbal communication; comfortable documenting decisions and rationale for technical and non-technical audiences.

Desirable

  • Experience working in a small or mid-sized organisation where DevOps and Engineering are separate but tightly coupled teams.
  • Experience with configuration/decision-recording practices such as ADRs and RFCs.
  • Hands-on development experience in Kotlin/Java and/or React, beyond simply reading code.
  • Experience administering Microsoft 365 (identity, device management, security configuration) and/or ZTNA network solutions.
  • Direct experience supporting SOC 2 and/or Cyber Essentials Plus certification or renewal, including evidence gathering and control remediation.

How you’ll work

  • You'll report to the Head of Architecture and Security, and work day-to-day alongside the DevOps team, sharing ownership of the infrastructure and delivery platform rather than working in a silo. This includes being part of on call rotas.
  • You'll engage directly and regularly with Engineering; this role is as much about acting as bridge between platform and application teams as it is about infrastructure delivery.
  • You'll be trusted to make and defend significant technical decisions independently, with appropriate visibility and documentation rather than sign-off at every step.

What success looks like

  • First 30 days
    You've built a working understanding of FXE's infrastructure, delivery pipelines, and the applications they support, enough to start contributing to technically sound, well-reasoned decisions that reflect real application constraints, not just infrastructure best practice in isolation. You've met the Engineering and Product teams you'll be working with and understand how DevOps and Engineering currently collaborate.
  • First 60 days
    You're an active contributor to the DevOps team and joint decisions between Engineering and DevOps rather than someone waiting to be looped in; collaboration on initiatives has visibly increased as a result. You've taken ownership of at least one meaningful piece of infrastructure or pipeline work, and the DevOps team's delivery capacity is measurably higher with you in it.
  • First 90+ days
    You're leading significant initiatives end to end, from design through to operations, with clear ownership and minimal oversight. You're recognised as a credible technical peer by the team's most experienced engineers. You regularly collaborate in the definition of designs and architecture patterns through mechanisms such as RFC reviews. You are actively contributing to the definition and delivery of DevOps strategic roadmap items, as well as the improvement to the efficiency and effectiveness of processes and tools.

Benefits

  • Salary banding 70K-85K GBP.
  • This position offers fully-remote work, you must be based within the UK.
  • Flexible working.
  • Autoenrollment in the pension scheme with contributions from FXE.
  • 25 days annual leave PLUS UK Bank Holidays.
  • Talent Referral Scheme.
  • Regular socials and team get togethers.

FXE is an equal opportunities employer and all positions are open to all suitably qualified candidates, regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation.

About the Role:

As a Strategic Account Executive, you will own the full sales cycle for Zūm's SaaS offerings, providing self-operated districts AI-driven routing, real-time vehicle and student visibility, and tools that improve on-time performance and communication with parents and students. You will build trusted relationships with transportation directors, superintendents, and district technology teams, guiding them through complex, multi-stakeholder, public-sector buying processes. This role reports to our Vice President of SaaS Sales.

What You'll Do:

  • Own your territory from first conversation to signed contract, and build account plans that map each key district's decision-makers, influencers, budget calendar and procurement path

  • Run discovery and tailored demos of Zūm CMX that connect real-time visibility, AI-driven routing, and fleet efficiency to each district's goals for on-time performance, attendance, trust from parents and students, and cost savings

  • Maintain a healthy, well-documented pipeline, and accurate forecast in our CRM

  • Use in-depth knowledge of industry trends to consult and support prospective customers, and share customer and competitive insights across Sales, Marketing, Product, and Legal teams

  • Respond to and shape RFPs, RFQs, and proposals, partnering with Product, Solutions, Legal, and Finance to craft pricing and contract structures that win

  • Represent Zūm at national and state education and transportation conferences, building a strong reference network in your territory

What You Bring To Zūm:

  • 5+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, ideally as a strategic or enterprise Account Executive, with a track record of closing six-figure and multi-year deals and consistently meeting quota

  • Direct experience selling technology or services to K-12 school districts or other public-sector buyers, including familiarity with RFPs, cooperative purchasing, and board approvals; school transportation experience a plus

  • Proven ability to run complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders, from superintendents and CFOs to operations and IT leaders

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly in consultative selling, presentation, and negotiation, and strong analytical and creative problem solving abilities

  • Ability to hold your own in meetings with both senior officials and day-to-day operators and speak as a thought leader in the transportation space

  • Entrepreneurial self-starter who is comfortable with travel within the territory, motivated by the mission of improving students' daily journey to school, and excited to work in a fast-growing, quickly changing environment

Description

As a Sales Director at Earnix, you will play a critical role in driving new business growth within the insurance sector. You will be responsible for owning complex sales cycles end-to-end, developing executive‑level relationships, and positioning Earnix’s intelligent decisioning solutions as transformational assets for insurers navigating digital and operational evolution. This role requires a strategic, highly motivated hunter with deep industry understanding and a relentless drive to win.

What you’ll do

Own the full sales cycle from lead to close, driving pipeline generation, qualification, solution positioning, and deal negotiation using a structured MEDDPICC approach. You will work closely with prospects to understand their business challenges and articulate how Earnix can deliver measurable value.

Develop and execute territory and account strategies, focusing on expanding Earnix’s footprint within the insurance market. You will leverage market insights and customer intelligence to identify opportunities and strengthen Earnix’s competitive positioning.

Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers across actuarial, product, underwriting, pricing, IT, and executive leadership. You will lead conversations that help insurers modernise and transform their operations through intelligent decisioning.

Collaborate with global remote teams in product, marketing, presales, and delivery to ensure a seamless customer journey. You will drive alignment across multiple time zones and functions to deliver an exceptional prospect experience.

Represent Earnix at industry events, conferences, and customer engagements, delivering compelling presentations and communicating Earnix’s value proposition. You will be a visible ambassador of the brand in the insurance ecosystem.

Requirements

You’ll do it using

5+ years of proven, successful sales experience in the insurtech space, ideally gained at a fast-growing startup or scale-up, demonstrating the ability to navigate complex organisations and close strategic deals in a high-growth, less-established environment.

A strong understanding of how insurers operate today, combined with deep knowledge of the digital transformation challenges and opportunities across the sector. You will use this knowledge to influence strategic discussions and guide prospects toward modern, analytics-driven decisioning.

Hands-on experience running deals through a MEDDPICC (or comparable) qualification methodology, with fluency in metrics, economic buyer identification, decision criteria/process mapping, pain identification, and champion building.

A passion for hunting and new business acquisition, consistently driving pipeline growth, identifying new revenue streams, and generating momentum in competitive markets.

Experience operating within global, distributed teams, using collaboration tools and communication best practices to ensure cohesion and momentum across regions.

A highly motivated, results-oriented work style, committing to doing what it takes to win while upholding Earnix values and delivering a world-class customer experience.

Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, enabling you to convey complex concepts with clarity and build trust with diverse stakeholders.

Willingness to travel extensively when required, meeting customers, attending events, and strengthening Earnix’s presence in key markets.

You’ll excel by

Demonstrating exceptional relationship‑building and stakeholder management skills, enabling you to engage effectively with executives and influence high‑impact decisions.

Applying MEDDPICC rigour instinctively — qualifying hard, forecasting accurately, and knowing when to walk away from a bad deal.

Communicating with clarity, confidence, and insight, tailoring messages to technical, commercial, and leadership audiences.

Exhibiting strong teamwork and collaboration, even while working independently, by aligning with global colleagues and sharing knowledge and field intelligence.

Showing resilience, tenacity, and a competitive drive, maintaining focus on results and adapting quickly in a dynamic, fast‑paced environment.

Presenting yourself as a trusted advisor, helping customers navigate change while positioning Earnix as an indispensable strategic partner.

Position Intro

Earnix is the first AI company purpose-built for insurance decisioning, providing the industry with the intelligence, governance, and decisioning agility to drive profitable growth, improve resilience, and operate with speed and precision in a rapidly changing risk environment. A trusted provider of production-grade AI and decisioning technology, Earnix builds on more than 25 years of experience in artificial intelligence risk, pricing, rating, analytics, and decisioning. Earnix brings vertical AI into the workflows and decisions that shape insurance performance across insurers’ pricing, underwriting, claims, customer engagement, retention, and other insurers high-value insurance moments. Earnix’s AIOS enables insurers to orchestrate intelligence across the insurance decision lifecycle and drive governed, real-time decisions that deliver measurable business outcomes. Earnix is headquartered in Boston, MA and has been innovating for insurers and banks since 2001 with customers in over 35 countries across six continents and offices in the Americas, Europe, Asia Pacific, and Israel.

jobs.description:
(This is for a RevPilots' client)

Senior Sales Executive - Account Executive

Location: Remote - USA

About Our Client

Our client is part of a company applying frontier technology in partnership with leading management teams and founders across the American services sector. Through the strategic use of AI, our client is modernizing how American businesses manage their people operations, reducing friction, cutting costs, and unlocking new levels of efficiency.

For more than 30 years, our client has served as a Professional Employer Organization (PEO) that makes it easier for small- and mid-sized businesses to employ people by streamlining payroll, employee benefits, HR, safety, and workers’ compensation services. Their single-source solution gives each client a dedicated Payroll Specialist and HR Business Partner plus access to a robust cloud HRIS platform for onboarding, PTO tracking, benefits administration, and employee self-service.

Recognizing that “business is personnel,” our client combines smart technology with experienced HR professionals so leaders can focus on growing their businesses while their employees thrive.

Role Overview

The Senior Sales Executive is responsible for originating, developing, and closing new PEO client relationships within the 20–500 employee market. This role owns the full sales cycle including prospecting, broker development, financial analysis, proposal presentation, and closing.

This is a quota-carrying role with direct accountability for revenue growth, new worksite employees (WSE), and long-term client value.

The ideal candidate understands the PEO model, can effectively compete against other PEO providers, and has experience building opportunities through broker, CPA, and referral relationships.

Core Responsibilities

New Business Production

Generate and close new PEO clients through direct prospecting, referral networks, and broker partnerships.

  • Developing and maintaining a pipeline of qualified prospects

  • Conducting employer needs assessments and discovery meetings

  • Analyzing payroll, workers’ compensation, benefits, and HR costs

  • Building and presenting PEO financial models and proposals

  • Leading executive-level sales presentations

  • Negotiating and closing service agreements

  • Managing opportunities through the full sales cycle from discovery to signed agreement

Broker & Referral Channel Development

Build and maintain a productive referral network that consistently generates new opportunities.

  • Recruiting new insurance broker and referral partners

  • Training brokers on our client’s PEO value proposition

  • Conducting joint prospect meetings

  • Structuring broker compensation and partnership agreements

  • Maintaining ongoing engagement with partners to drive consistent deal flow

Strategic Sales Process

Lead a structured consultative sales process from discovery through implementation.

  • Financial and HR diagnostic analysis

  • Competitive positioning against other PEO providers

  • Proposal development and pricing strategy

  • Managing complex client decision processes

  • Coordinating with underwriting and implementation teams to ensure smooth client onboarding

Pipeline Management & CRM Discipline

Maintain accurate and transparent pipeline reporting to support forecasting and sales performance visibility.

  • Maintaining consistent CRM hygiene and timely pipeline updates

  • Logging meetings, activities, and opportunity updates within the CRM

  • Managing opportunity stages and forecasting accuracy

  • Maintaining a qualified pipeline of active opportunities

  • Participating in pipeline reviews and sales forecasting discussions

Continuous Improvement

Actively contribute to the improvement of sales processes and market strategies.

  • Sharing market intelligence and competitive insights

  • Refining messaging based on client feedback

  • Collaborating with marketing and leadership on go-to-market initiatives

  • Continuously improving sales skills and industry knowledge

Performance Expectations

Typical performance metrics include:

  • Annual Admin Revenue Production: $350K+

  • New Worksite Employees (WSE): 300–500 annually

  • Qualified Pipeline: 8–12 active opportunities maintained at all times

  • Referral Source Mix: Broker, CPA, and direct prospecting

Top performers typically generate $400K+ in annualized admin revenue.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 12 months, a successful hire will:

  • Close 3 opportunities with leadership support within the first 90 days

  • Build and expand a broker and referral network generating consistent leads

  • Maintain a qualified pipeline of 8–12 active opportunities

  • Close multiple PEO deals generating $300K+ in admin revenue

  • Establish themselves as a trusted advisor to business owners and referral partners

Qualifications

Required Experience

  • 5–7+ years of PEO sales experience

  • Proven success selling PEO or ASO services

  • Documented history of meeting or exceeding quota

  • Experience working through insurance brokers and referral channels

  • Ability to present financial and HR cost analyses to business owners and executives

Preferred Experience

  • Existing broker or referral network

  • Experience selling into 20–500 employee businesses

  • Strong understanding of workers’ compensation programs, employee benefits funding, HR compliance and risk mitigation, and payroll and tax administration

Ideal Candidate Profile

The strongest candidates typically come from:

  • Existing PEO providers

  • Employee benefits brokerage firms

  • Payroll or HR technology companies / HR SaaS selling into mid-market employers

They are entrepreneurial, highly competitive, and consultative, with the ability to sell complex financial solutions to business owners and executive decision-makers.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base salary: $115,000 – $135,000, DOE

  • Uncapped commission structure

  • On-target earnings: $200,000 – $350,000+

  • Top performers regularly exceed $400,000+ total compensation

Benefits include:

  • Employer-subsidized health plans (six medical options), dental, and vision

  • Life and disability insurance

  • 401(k) plan

  • Generous PTO and paid holidays

  • Ongoing professional development and training

This role translates business andtechnical requirements into scalable solutions that consolidate securityfindings, enrich them with asset and threat context, prioritize exposures,assign remediation ownership, and track resolution across Armis VIPR andServiceNow USEM workflows.

This is atechnical, client-facing consulting role that provides design authority, leadsEngineers, and works with Managers to ensure successful delivery. The Architectalso helps clients evaluate and implement AI-enabled security and remediationcapabilities using Armis intelligence and ServiceNow Otto, including exposureanalysis, prioritization, predictive ownership, guided remediation, automation,and agentic workflows. These capabilities must be designed with appropriatesecurity, privacy, governance, explainability, human oversight, andresponsible-use controls.

ClientConsulting and Solution Leadership

  • Lead discovery sessions, stakeholder interviews, requirements workshops, maturity assessments, design sessions, and solution reviews for Armis VIPR and ServiceNow SecOps engagements.
  • Develop a clear understanding of each client’s security environment, vulnerability-management processes, asset landscape, data sources, remediation model, governance requirements, and desired business outcomes.

Armis VIPR Architectureand Delivery

  • Design Armis Centrix for VIPR Pro solutions that consolidate, normalize, deduplicate, enrich, prioritize, assign, and track vulnerabilities and other security findings.
  • Define approaches for integrating vulnerability scanners, cloud-security platforms, application-security tools, endpoint technologies, asset-intelligence sources, threat intelligence, and other security data with Armis VIPR.
  • Design risk-prioritization models that incorporate technical severity, exploitability, threat intelligence, asset criticality, business impact, exposure context, and client-defined risk factors.
  • Develop remediation ownership, assignment, exception, service-level, escalation, and closure processes that support accountable and measurable risk reduction.
  • Evaluate Armis AI-enabled capabilities, including predictive ownership and prioritization, and ensure their use aligns with client governance, security, transparency, and human-oversight requirements.

ServiceNowSecOps Architecture and Delivery

  • Design ServiceNow Security Operations solutions across Unified Security Exposure Management, Vulnerability Response, Security Incident Response, Security Posture Control, Configuration Compliance, and related capabilities.
  • Define ServiceNow workflows for finding ingestion, asset association, risk scoring, remediation-task creation, assignment, exception handling, approval, escalation, validation, and closure.
  • Design solutions that use CMDB, CSDM, business-service, asset, ownership, and organizational data to add business context and support accurate prioritization and assignment.
  • Determine the appropriate use of out-of-the-box functionality, configuration, integration, automation, or custom development based on client requirements and Templar Shield and ServiceNow platform leading practices.
  • Evaluate ServiceNow Otto capabilities for incident analysis, exposure prioritization, guided remediation, knowledge generation, reporting, and other security use cases while ensuring responsible AI implementation.

Integrationand Data Architecture

  • Design integrations between Armis VIPR, ServiceNow SecOps, CMDB, ITSM, ITOM, vulnerability scanners, SIEM, EDR, cloud-security platforms, application-security tools, threat-intelligence sources, and other enterprise technologies.
  • Define integration patterns, APIs, data mappings, transformation rules, reconciliation logic, synchronization schedules, error handling, monitoring, and support requirements.
  • Establish clear system-of-record and system-of-action responsibilities across Armis VIPR, ServiceNow, security tools, asset repositories, and remediation platforms.
  • Design bidirectional workflows that preserve data integrity, prevent duplicate records, synchronize status and ownership, and provide traceability across the remediation lifecycle.
  • Develop data-quality, asset-correlation, normalization, deduplication, and governance strategies that improve the accuracy of exposure prioritization, assignment, and reporting.

TechnicalLeadership and Quality Assurance

  • Develop and maintain solution architecture documents, integration designs, data models, process flows, functional specifications, architectural decisions, and implementation guidance.
  • Establish technical standards and review configurations, workflows, integrations, data mappings, automation, and reporting for security, scalability, performance, maintainability, and upgrade compatibility.
  • Provide technical direction to Engineers and consultants, assign design and configuration activities, resolve complex technical issues, and validate completed work.
  • Support testing strategy, integration testing, user acceptance testing, deployment planning, release readiness, production transition, and post-deployment stabilization.
  • Identify architectural risks, dependencies, assumptions, and technical debt and work with Managers and client stakeholders to develop appropriate mitigation plans.

Practice and Sales Support

The Armis VIPR and ServiceNow SecOps Architect supports Templar Shield’sPractice Leads by providing solution leadership and subject-matter expertisethroughout business development and practice-growth activities.

  • Support Practice Leads in identifying, qualifying, shaping, and expanding Armis VIPR, ServiceNow SecOps, and integrated exposure-management opportunities.

jobs.title: Director of Revenue Operations
jobs.excerpt: The RoleAt Uscreen, we help creators build something that lasts, powering independent video businesses to build sustainable revenue and scale their impact.
jobs.description:
The Role

At Uscreen, we help creators build something that lasts, powering independent video businesses to build sustainable revenue and scale their impact. We're a fast-growing SaaS company, and our all-in-one video membership platform helps creators generate revenue through subscriptions, communities, courses, and live-streamed events across web, mobile, and TV apps.

We're hiring a Director of Revenue Operations to own the systems, data, and strategy that drive revenue performance across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success. This is the person who connects the dots: how we map and segment our market, how leads are scored and routed, how reps are territoried and incentivized, how pipeline is forecast, and how all of that flows between the CRM, the warehouse, and the teams who act on it.

This is a build role. The foundations are here: a CRM with real history in it, a data warehouse that holds our source of truth, an outbound motion getting off the ground, and a sales team with momentum. What's missing is someone to connect them into one engine and own what comes out of it. You'll get real latitude to decide how this function works, and you'll be expected to build it yourself rather than direct it from a distance.

You'll do it inside an AI-native team. We treat AI as a core part of how we work, and in this role especially: mapping and enriching a market that no off-the-shelf database covers well, automating the operational work that shouldn't take a human, and getting to answers faster than a traditional ops function could.

What You'll Do

Revenue Strategy & Outcomes

  • Set and track the operational targets that feed the revenue engine: pipeline coverage, opportunity generation, conversion by stage, speed to lead
  • Build the market map. Define how we segment, target, and prioritize accounts in an SMB and DTC creator market that standard playbooks don't cover
  • Design territories and account assignment so reps have both ownership and a pool to go win
  • Drive ICP targeting, CAC efficiency, and pipeline velocity in partnership with GTM and Analytics

GTM Infrastructure & Systems

  • Own and optimize the GTM tech stack (Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, Intercom, and related tools), including how they integrate, what we buy, and when we replace something
  • Implement scalable processes for lead routing, scoring, attribution, and enrichment
  • Ensure high data integrity and system hygiene across all revenue systems: deduplication, territory structure, and the standards that keep lifecycle marketing and outbound from firing on bad data
  • Lead and support the Salesforce admin function in managing system configuration, integrations, and automation
  • Use APIs and custom scripts to integrate data across CRM, marketing automation, product usage, and billing
  • Build and maintain automated workflows with AI tooling (Clay, LLM APIs, Python and similar), driving experimentation and continuous improvement across the revenue engine

Forecasting, Analytics & Reporting

  • Build and maintain real-time dashboards on funnel metrics, pipeline health, and revenue forecasts
  • Identify and influence the metrics that drive revenue growth: pipeline value, campaign ROI, close rates, conversion by stage
  • Partner with the CRO, Finance, and Marketing on strategic planning, forecast accuracy, and budgeting
  • Work with the Analytics team on the handoff between CRM and warehouse, so reporting is built where the data actually lives
  • Use AI tooling to generate predictive insight and make reporting scale without more headcount

Revenue Process & GTM Enablement

  • Define and document GTM processes, rules of engagement, SLAs, and territory models
  • Own deal desk and approvals management: pricing and discount approvals, non-standard terms, quote-to-close workflow, and the escalation path that keeps deals moving without leaking margin
  • Support compensation planning, quota design, and incentive alignment in partnership with Finance
  • Enable onboarding, offboarding, training, and operational workflows across Sales, CS, and Marketing

Strategic Projects & Cross-Functional Support

  • Identify and remove friction points in the sales process
  • Act as the connective layer between Sales, CS, Marketing, and Finance
  • Support pricing strategy, pipeline inspection, and contract workflows
  • Build the readouts that let leadership see what's working without having to ask

Lead the Function

  • Manage and develop our Revenue Operations Manager, who owns day-to-day core ops today and is ready for a strategic leader to learn from
  • Direct GTM engineering capacity, whether in-house or contracted, toward the highest-leverage build work
  • Operate as one point of a three-way partnership with FP&A and Data/Analytics, where each function is a check and a balance on the others

What You Bring

  • 6+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Ops, BizOps, or GTM Strategy at B2B SaaS companies, including time as a hands-on individual contributor
  • You have scaled a company through the roughly $20M ARR range in a capital-efficient, lean-team environment. You're energized by building the system rather than inheriting a finished one
  • Hands-on and technical. You don't need to write production SQL, but you need to understand systems integration, how CRM and warehouse data flow into each other, and what breaks when they don't. You build things yourself before you delegate them
  • SMB, DTC, or PLG market experience. Our buyers are independent creators, not procurement departments, and they cannot be pulled off a list in ZoomInfo. You'll need to be creative and analytical about how we find and qualify them
  • Real depth in the strategic side of RevOps: comp and attainment design, pipeline modeling, segmentation, and partnering with Finance on planning
  • Experience running a deal desk or approvals process, or standing one up
  • Fluent with AI tools as part of how you work, not as an experiment. You use them for enrichment, market mapping, agent workflows, and automating the repetitive parts of ops, and you have the judgment to know where their output needs a human
  • A communicator who produces readouts, not just meetings. You can show a team what changed and why it matters
  • Comfortable in a remote-first, fast-moving environment with a small team and a wide surface area

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in the creator economy, video, membership, or community software
  • Salesforce and HubSpot in the same stack, with a warehouse behind them
  • Background building outbound and prospecting motions from close to zero
  • Experience with revenue recognition workflows or multi-currency billing
  • Direct experience partnering with a CRO or a founder-led GTM team

How We Work, Our Values

These are the five values we hold ourselves to, and what they look like in this role:

  • Customer Obsessed. You build systems that make the creator's experience better, not just the reporting easier. You remember there's a real business at the end of every record in the CRM.
  • Push the Pace. You ship the working version and improve it. You move at the speed of the decision in front of you.
  • Own the Outcome. You own the revenue numbers this function influences, not just the dashboards that display them.
  • Simplicity Wins. You take a tangle of tools and process and make it something the team can actually follow.
  • Go Further Together. You build the trust with Finance, Analytics, Sales, and Marketing that makes this function work at all. Without it, RevOps has no inputs.

What We Offer

  • 100% remote first company
  • Flexible PTO plus 8 paid company holidays
  • Medical benefits with cost sharing: health, dental, and vision (US based)
  • 401(k) plan with company match (US based)
  • Flexible parental leave
  • Remote-first
  • Stipends for technology, coworking space, and professional development

Note: Benefits may vary depending on location and local regulations. Final eligibility and coverage details will be shared during the hiring process.

jobs.excerpt: About FrontierFrontier is a subsidiary of Fresh Prints.
jobs.description:
About Frontier

Frontier is a subsidiary of Fresh Prints. Fresh Prints is a New York-based, fast-growing, fully remote, 150-person company with most of our team based in India and the Philippines. A few years ago, Fresh Prints began helping other fast-growing companies build their teams. We got so good at it that we spun out a new company to focus exclusively on that — and called it Frontier.

At Frontier, we help companies grow full-time, cross-functional teams abroad. We hire the smartest people and place them into the best companies. In three years, we’ve never lost a client. If you’re interested in a Frontier role and you apply and are accepted, we’ll screen you through a couple of internal interviews and aim to get you an interview for a full-time job within the month.

Think of us as your personal talent agent — and good luck with the application! 😊

About 100x and the ticketing team

100x Hospitality builds VIP packages, travel packages, and destination events for major touring artists, festivals, and live entertainment partners. Our Artist Services division runs VIP programs on 30+ active tours at a time, and our Presents division produces our own destination events, many of them international.

The ticketing team is small and busy. A Ticketing Director leads it, a Ticketing Manager owns builds, inventory changes, ADA requests, refunds, and vendor relationships, and a coordinator owns the daily and weekly reporting cadence that keeps partners informed. This role is that coordinator seat, working remotely and reporting to the Ticketing Manager.

Role summary

Title: Ticketing Coordinator. Reports to the Ticketing Manager, with day-to-day direction from the Ticketing Director.

This person owns the reporting rhythm of the ticketing team. Every day, they pull sales counts across our ticketing platforms and send a midday counts email. Every week they build and send VIP and travel package sales updates to artist managers, agents, and promoters on a portfolio of roughly 15 to 20 tours. Around each show, they confirm VIP sales are closed on time and reconcile what sold against what we were allocated.

The work is detail-heavy and deadline-driven, and much of it goes straight to outside partners, so accuracy and clear written English matter more than anything else.

Core responsibilities

The list below reflects the work this seat actually does today, roughly in order of how much time it takes.

Weekly partner counts (the heart of the job)

  • Pull weekly VIP and travel package sales for each assigned tour from Ticketmaster, AXS, Tixr, or venue box office reports, depending on how that tour is ticketed
  • Update the master counts grid and build the per-tour sales summary: sold, allocated, open, and percent sold, plus change since the last update
  • Draft and send the weekly counts email to each tour's management, agency, and promoter contacts, typically on Wednesdays
  • Flag tours where sales are lagging and prepare hold release recommendations for internal sign-off before they go to the partner
  • Roll up an internal department summary of all Artist Services counts for leadership

Daily reporting and inbox

  • Send a daily counts email by 12 PM ET covering our owned destination events, with day-over-day changes
  • Monitor the shared ticket counts inbox each day and route partner questions, data requests, and issues to the right owner

Per-show execution

  • Confirm VIP packages go offsale on time for each show, usually 3 to 7 days before the date
  • Complete post-show ticketing settlements: what sold against what was allocated, fees, holds released or returned, and net to partner
  • Track refunds and price adjustments, including ones a venue processes on its own, so our records reconcile
  • Request purchaser lists from venues and chase the slow ones

Program setup and support

  • Send ticketing details and hold requests to venues and promoters ahead of presales
  • Check that presale and on-sale links work and match what was built
  • Spot-check pricing and package data across platforms and raise discrepancies
  • Help Guest Services with ticketing questions from VIP and travel package buyers
  • Keep source notes current for every tour (which platform, which login, which venue contact) so the work is never stuck in one person's head

Tools and systems

Category

What we use

Ticketing platforms

Ticketmaster (TM1 and ISM), AXS, Tixr, Ticketstoday, venue box office reports

Internal data

Web-based database; master counts grid in Google Sheets

Work management

Asana (task queues per tour and per show)

Communication

Gmail, Google Workspace, Slack, Google Meet

Reporting

Excel and Google Sheets for counts, settlements, and attachments

We're automating parts of the counts work with Claude and scripts, so comfort working alongside Claude is a plus.

Schedule and hours

Full time, Monday through Friday, overlap with US Eastern business hours each day.

  • Pull work (counts, settlements, reconciliation) can happen outside the overlap window
  • Wednesdays are the heaviest day because weekly partner sends go out then
  • Occasional flexibility around presales, on-sales, and show weeks, agreed in advance

Qualifications

Required

  • Strong spreadsheet skills: lookups, pivots, clean formatting, and catching numbers that don't add up
  • Excellent written English. Partner emails go to senior music industry contacts and need to read as polished and confident
  • Careful with detail and reliable on recurring deadlines
  • Comfortable managing a large queue of recurring tasks in a tool like Asana without reminders

Preferred

  • Hands-on experience with Ticketmaster (TM1 or ISM), AXS, or Tixr
  • Background in live music or travel and hospitality
  • Familiarity with settlement or reconciliation work
  • Experience working remotely for a US-based team

About Us

AI coding is the largest use case of enterprise AI adoption today, as is evident from the success of Anthropic on Claude Code, Cursor’s $60B exit to SpaceX, and Cognition’s $48B valuation.

The bottleneck now has moved from code generation to security and safety - AI agents write code faster than any team can review it, and over 65% of the lines of code produced by them are insecure. Vulnerabilities are piling up 16x faster than companies can fix them, and adversaries are able to exploit these new vulnerabilities within hours.

AURI by Endor Labs closes that gap. It runs inside the harness where coding agents work, through hooks, skills and MCP, so the controls sit outside the model and every agent action is visible. Underneath is our patented code context graph, which maps code, open source, containers and infrastructure. It shows which vulnerabilities can actually be reached and exploited, then delivers fixes that won’t break the application. Security teams get evidence instead of noise, and developers get fixes instead of tickets.

The companies building AI trust us to secure it - our customers include OpenAI, SpaceX, DoorDash, Dropbox, Atlassian, MongoDB, Snowflake, Robinhood and Peloton to name a few.

Independent | Referral Commission | 10% of Collected Revenue

Who We're Looking For

Sometimes you hear someone describe what is happening at work and immediately think:

I know something that might help.

Maybe it's a colleague, friend, family member, client, performer, professional, or someone else you genuinely know.

SteadyState is looking for people who can recognize when someone may benefit from our services and make a meaningful introduction.

You don't have to sell anything. You make the right introduction. We take it from there.

What We Do

SteadyState™ Work Partners is a human capital consulting firm specializing in human capital risk mitigation.

We work with organizations when a valuable person's Heat-of-the-Moment actions or inaction are creating business consequences—and knowing better hasn't been enough to stop it.

Our proprietary TAU Core™ intervention develops the I Caught Myself Reflex™: the ability to interrupt an automatic reaction before it becomes consequential action or inaction.

TAU Core™ includes an in-person component delivered in Austin, Texas.

What Counts as a Referral

A referral is more than telling us about someone. You know the person and make the introduction.

For example:

Not a referral:
“I met someone who sounds like they need this.”

A referral:
“I know someone who may benefit from SteadyState. I've told them what you do and that participation includes coming to Austin. They're interested. I'll introduce you.”

You don't have to sell the service or determine whether it's right for them. You make the qualified introduction. SteadyState owns the sales process from there.

Who You Might Know

You may know someone who:

  • Keeps reacting in ways they later regret

  • Knows what they should do but doesn't always do it in the moment

  • Is dealing with recurring conflict or workplace consequences

  • Is struggling with a Heat-of-the-Moment pattern that keeps showing up

  • Has already tried other ways of addressing the problem

  • Wants to interrupt what happens before it becomes a consequential action or inaction

You don't need to diagnose what's happening.

If you recognize the situation and they are interested in talking with us, introduce us.

Compensation

10% of collected revenue on eligible new business resulting from your qualifying referral.

For example: One $5,000 engagement = $500 referral commission.

There is no minimum number of referrals required. Make one introduction or make several.

If an eligible referral becomes a paying SteadyState client and SteadyState collects the revenue, you get paid. If the referral does not result in collected revenue, no commission is earned.

What You Don't Have to Do

You are not responsible for:

  • Prospecting

  • Conducting sales conversations

  • Explaining the entire TAU™ intervention

  • Determining whether someone should participate

  • Managing the enrollment process

  • Closing the sale

Your responsibility is the introduction. SteadyState handles everything after that.

Where You Will Work

You can be located anywhere in the United States.

There is no set schedule and no required volume of referrals.

The person you refer can live anywhere, provided they understand that the in-person portion of TAU Core™ is currently delivered in Austin, Texas, and they are willing to travel to participate.

The Question

Who came to mind while you were reading this?

If you know someone who should know about SteadyState, tell them about us. If they're interested, make the connection.

jobs.title: Social Media Manager Trading & Finance (Remote, Freelance)
jobs.excerpt: Bist du auf der Suche nach einer neuen Herausforderung, in der du Social Media nicht nur bespielst, sondern strategisch skalierst?
jobs.description:
Bist du auf der Suche nach einer neuen Herausforderung, in der du Social Media nicht nur bespielst, sondern strategisch skalierst?

Du willst kein klassisches Agentur-Umfeld, sondern echte Ownership für starke Personal Brands im Trading- und Finance-Bereich übernehmen?

Bei uns gestaltest du Wachstum nicht mit – du verantwortest es.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Team zusammen, entwickelst skalierbare Content-Strategien und baust Social Media als messbaren Wachstumskanal aus.

Wenn du Performance liebst, Daten ernst nimmst und Social Media als strategisches Spielfeld verstehst – dann sollten wir sprechen.

Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst eine plattformübergreifende Content-Strategie für Instagram, YouTube und TikTok
  • Du planst, koordinierst und optimierst unseren Content-Kalender
  • Du konzipierst Kampagnen, Serienformate und skalierbare Content-Mechaniken
  • Du analysierst Performance-Daten und leitest konkrete Optimierungsmaßnahmen ab
  • Du führst A/B-Tests für Hooks, Thumbnails, Titel und Formate durch
  • Du identifizierst Trends frühzeitig und übersetzt sie in performante Content-Ideen
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Video Editor zusammen und steuerst die Content-Produktion strategisch
  • Du entwickelst Engagement- und Community-Strategien
  • Du definierst klare Wachstumsziele und trackst deren Erreichung

Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung:
    Du hast bereits nachweisbare Erfolge im Social Media Management erzielt – idealerweise im Educational-, Trading- oder Finance-Umfeld.
  • Mindset:
    Growth ist für dich kein Buzzword. Du denkst in KPIs, Conversion, Retention und Skalierung.
  • Plattform-Verständnis:
    Du verstehst die Algorithmen von Instagram, YouTube und TikTok nicht nur oberflächlich, sondern strategisch.
  • Analytik:
    Du arbeitest sicher mit Analytics-Tools wie Instagram Insights, YouTube Analytics etc. und leitest daraus konkrete Handlungen ab.
  • Strategie + Kreativität:
    Du kannst virale Ideen entwickeln – aber immer mit einem klaren strategischen Ziel.
  • Arbeitsweise:
    Eigenständig, strukturiert, verantwortungsvoll. Kein Micromanagement nötig.

Für wen die Rolle weniger passt:

Wir suchen jemanden, der im Thema schon zu Hause ist. Die Rolle passt deshalb eher nicht zu dir, wenn …
- … du mit Trading und Finanzmärkten bisher keine Berührungspunkte hattest. Profi-Trader musst du nicht sein, aber die Grundlagen solltest du mitbringen.
- … dein Schwerpunkt bisher auf Lifestyle-, Beauty- oder E-Commerce-Kanälen lag und Finanzthemen dich wenig reizen.
- … du Entscheidungen ungern an Kennzahlen festmachst.
- … du dir ein Umfeld mit engen Vorgaben wünschst. Bei uns übernimmst du die Kanäle eigenverantwortlich.

Benefits

  • Volle Verantwortung für spannende Kanäle mit Wachstumspotenzial
  • Ein Team aus Top-Performern und Gründer:innen, das gemeinsam auf Wachstum setzt.
  • Eine Kultur, die Verantwortung, Höchstleistungen und Ehrlichkeit schätzt – hier zählt, was du erreichst, nicht nur, was du sagst.
  • Mental- & Physical Health wird großgeschrieben.
  • Work from anywhere, wir sind 100% remote und arbeiten mit Kunden in der deutschen Zeitzone
  • Workations? Bei uns gehören sie dazu und werden von uns gelebt.
  • Raum für Experimente, Learnings & persönliche Weiterentwicklung

Hat dich das überzeugt ?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt und starte bald gemeinsam mit uns durch! Lade einfach deinen Lebenslauf hoch – ein Anschreiben oder Zeugnisse sind überflüssig. Wir halten es lieber unkompliziert.

Bewerbungseingang: Sobald deine Bewerbung bei uns eingeht, erhältst du eine kurze Bestätigung – du kannst dir sicher sein, dass wir deine Unterlagen sorgfältig prüfen.

Get-to-know-Call: Passt dein Profil, laden wir dich zu einem ersten Videocall (ca. 30 min.) ein. Hier finden wir gemeinsam heraus, ob es vom Mindset passt – und du bekommst erste Insights in unsere einzigartige Arbeitskultur.

Competence-Call: Als nächstes lernst du deinen Teamlead kennen. In einem 60–75-minütigen Gespräch sprechen wir über deine fachlichen und persönlichen Stärken – und finden gemeinsam heraus, ob es ein Match zwischen uns gibt. Nach dem Call bekommst du schnellstmöglich unser Feedback.

Founder Call: Zum Abschluss möchte dich unser Co-Founder Sam persönlich kennenlernen (ca. 30 min.). Keine Sorge – du bekommst innerhalb von 2 Tagen Feedback. Wenn alles passt, starten wir gemeinsam durch!

jobs.excerpt: The Role, Manager, Implementation - this role is based for applicants located in Canada SiteDocs, a GoCanvas company, is a leading provider of digital safety management software, trusted by thousands of teams to modernize and simplify workplace health and safety across construction, engineering, infrastructure, logistics, and beyond.
jobs.description:
The Role, Manager, Implementation
- this role is based for applicants located in Canada

SiteDocs, a GoCanvas company, is a leading provider of digital safety management software, trusted by thousands of teams to modernize and simplify workplace health and safety across construction, engineering, infrastructure, logistics, and beyond. We’re the highest-rated EHS platform on Gartner-owned Capterra, empowering field teams and safety leaders to replace paperwork, boost compliance, and drive real-time visibility where it matters most.

SiteDocs is part of the Nemetschek Group — a publicly traded European software company with a multi-billion-euro market capitalisation. The group brings together more than 15 specialised brands, including GoCanvas, Bluebeam, FirmusAI, Nevaris, AllPlan, VectorWorks, and SpaceWell, serving customers across the full AECO (Architecture, Engineering, Construction & Operations) spectrum. Together, we’re shaping a smarter, safer, and more sustainable built world.

Position Overview:

The Manager, Implementation leads the GoCanvas/SiteDocs Implementation team, owning team performance, development, and process. This role holds 1:1s and career development conversations for a team of 3–8, proactively monitors dashboards, KPIs, and quality metrics to identify coaching opportunities and process gaps, and partners with the Director of Implementation to build and continuously improve playbooks, methodologies, and the end-to-end customer journey. The Manager works cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Support, Professional Services, and Product to remove blockers, represent the team's needs, and surface ideas that improve time-to-value and customer outcomes.

Your Most Important Initiatives:
  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of 3–8 (Team Lead, Sr. Implementation Managers, Implementation Managers, and Implementation Specialists) through regular 1:1s, performance management, and career development planning.
  • Proactively monitor dashboards, KPIs, and quality/CSAT metrics to identify performance trends, coaching opportunities, and process gaps across the team.
  • Own and continuously improve implementation playbooks, methodologies, tooling, and training to increase consistency, quality, and time-to-value at scale.
  • Manage team capacity planning, account/workload assignment strategy, hiring, and onboarding of new team members, in partnership with the Team Lead.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Support, Professional Services, and Product to improve the end-to-end customer journey and resolve systemic blockers.
  • Assist the Director of Implementation in leading team meetings, communicating strategic priorities, and cascading company and departmental goals.
  • Track and report on team- and portfolio-level implementation metrics (time-to-go-live, adoption, CSAT, escalation trends) to the Director of Implementation.
  • Surface ideas and recommendations to the Director of Implementation on team structure, process design, and broader customer journey strategy.

What You Bring:
  • 6–8+ years of experience in onboarding, implementation, customer success, or project management, specifically in a tech-driven environment, including at least 2 years of direct people-management experience.
  • Deep understanding of GoCanvas/SiteDocs products, implementation methodology, and common industry use cases and workflows.
  • Proven people-management experience, with the ability to coach, develop, and hold a team accountable to performance and quality standards.
  • Strong project and program management skills, with experience defining and scaling repeatable delivery processes.
  • Data-driven approach to team performance and customer outcomes; comfortable using dashboards, CRM, and analytics tools to guide decisions.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to represent the team's needs to senior leadership and cross-functional partners.
  • Experience improving or scaling implementation processes, playbooks, or tooling in a high-growth SaaS environment.
  • Strong interpersonal skills for building relationships with cross-functional partners (Sales, Professional Services, Support, Product) and peers.
  • Adaptable and comfortable with change in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Extra:

Experience managing a team spanning multiple experience levels (individual contributor through player-coach) is a plus.

Why Join Us?

Join a mission-driven team focused on proactive customer success and long-term partnership. You'll collaborate with supportive colleagues, impact business growth, and play a critical role in ensuring our customers thrive with GoCanvas & SiteDocs solutions.

Our success is rooted in a wonderfully wholesome culture, best defined by our four overarching values:

  • Authentic Relationships - People are never a means to an end.
  • Continuous Learning - Test every assumption and never stay stagnant.
  • Interdependence - We build systems that require everyone to perform with excellence, we are a team, and we succeed or fail together.
  • Data Driven Decisions - Because wisdom requires understanding the facts of the matter, disputes between competing perspectives are resolved with data.

If you have any questions about your personal data privacy at SiteDocs, please visit our privacy page.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. If you need special assistance or accommodation while seeking employment with us, please email or call: (703) 547-8588. We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in Canada. However, we are not able to sponsor visas.

We take into account an individual’s qualifications, skillset, and experience in determining final salary. This role is eligible for health insurance (medical, dental & vision), life insurance, 401(k) & paid time off. The expected base salary for this position is $92,500 CAD. The actual offer will be at the company’s sole discretion and determined by relevant business considerations, including the final candidate’s qualifications, years of experience, skillset, and geographic location.

Description

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

Role overview

We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell.

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.

You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.

What you will work on

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output;
  • Own the production flow: task distribution, capacity planning, and strict QC - production-grade, not demo-grade;
  • Drive creative direction: concepts, hooks, and visual angles that stop the scroll and convert;
  • Generate ideas yourself and push the team beyond safe iterations - informed by visual trends and competitor creatives;
  • Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;
  • Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;
  • Run regular R&D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;
  • Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;
  • Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation;
  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.

Requirements

Your must-haves

You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you.

  • 5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig);
  • Mature Leader & Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches;
  • Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses;
  • Strong Visual Craft: composition, lighting, color, typography, anatomy. You can articulate exactly why a creative works or doesn't;
  • Design Toolstack: proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; comfortable connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines;
  • AI Geek: far beyond basic prompting. You track every new model release and can't wait to test how it could level up ad creatives. Hands-on with modern AI image platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar), using them for creating photorealistic visuals. Able to choose the right tool for each task, as well as to catch and fix artifacts.
  • Performance Marketing DNA: solid understanding of static ad creatives (Google, Meta, and other paid channels). You know what stops the scroll, what makes a visual sell, and how creative decisions move CTR, CPA, and conversion rate;
  • Fluency in English - both spoken and written.

Nice to have

  • A strong portfolio showcasing performance marketing creatives and AI-generated photorealistic work - ideally with examples shipped under your leadership and the results they drove;
  • Experience with creatives for high-CPA verticals (home improvement, insurance, health, legal, finance, or similar);
  • Experience creating visuals for North American audiences - you know what looks native to a US consumer;
  • Understanding of how static visuals feed video production pipelines.

What we offer

  • Remote Work - we offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
  • Paid vacations - generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge.
  • Unlimited Sick Days - we understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
  • Ongoing Learning - people at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
  • Home Office - we will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
  • Physical Well-Being - we will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
  • Fun Stuff - there is never a shortage of fun stuff.
