Position Summary:


The Compliance Manager is responsible for building, executing, and continuously improving Dozee's
healthcare compliance program across all regulatory domains — Medicare RPM billing, HIPAA privacy and
security, FDA device compliance, and Anti-Kickback Statute adherence. The role reports to the VP
Administration and is the organization's primary day-to-day compliance operator, translating policy into
procedure and ensuring every business function performs within established legal and regulatory boundaries.

Responsibilities

    1. CMS / Medicare RPM Billing Compliance
    • Own the monthly billing compliance review cycle — validate CPT code selection (99453–99470), data-day
    thresholds, and mutual exclusivity rules before claims are released.
    • Monitor CMS Final Rules, MAC Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs), and OIG Work Plan items
    affecting RPM billing; brief leadership on material changes within 30 days.
    • Maintain the pre-bill dual-attestation workflow and enforce the 99458 MUE cap and time-counting rules.

    2. HIPAA Privacy & Security Program
    • Serve as Dozee's designated HIPAA Compliance Officer — conduct annual Security Risk Assessments,
    manage the Notice of Privacy Practices, and oversee BAA lifecycle for all vendors and SNF partners.
    • Lead breach investigation and notification workflows; coordinate with Melvin Law Group on any reportable

    incident.

    3. SOP Development & Version Control
    • Own and maintain the full CAIT/Dozee SOP library (currently seven SOPs, v2.1) — initiate updates within
    30 days of any material regulatory change.
    • Manage the annual SOP review cycle; obtain CEO and VP sign-off; track version history and change logs.

    4 .Internal Audit — Monthly Claims Sampling
    • Conduct monthly random-sample claims audits (minimum 10% of submitted claims) — verify
    documentation completeness, code accuracy, and consent/care-plan compliance.
    • Track audit findings in the Compliance Tracking Log; escalate repeat findings to VP Administration;
    implement and verify corrective actions within agreed timelines.

    5. Staff Training & Annual Attestation
    • Design, deliver, and track annual compliance training for all clinical, billing, and administrative staff —
    covering CMS billing rules, HIPAA, AKS, and the OIG RPM Compliance Framework.
    • Maintain training attestation records in Circle Health Domain 0.2; generate compliance attestation reports

    for VP and CEO annually.

    6. Overpayment Management — 60-Day Rule Enforcement
    • Maintain the Overpayment Tracking Log; ensure all identified overpayments are investigated, classified
    (isolated vs. systemic), and refunded within the 60-day statutory deadline.
    • Coordinate with the Billing Manager on MAC refund submissions; consult Melvin Law Group on any

    systemic overpayment before refund.

    7. Regulatory Intelligence & State Monitoring
    • Monitor applicable state NP practice act changes across CAIT's six operating states (TX, OH, PA, FL, NY,

    MO) and Dozee's expansion targets.

    • Track RHTP, THRIVE, and NIH grant compliance obligations as Dozee enters new government programs.

    8. Contract & AKS Compliance Support
    • Review all SNF partner and vendor agreements against the Anti-Kickback Statute checklist before
    execution; escalate any FMV or referral-contingency concerns to VP Administration and Melvin Law

    Group.

    • Maintain executed contract files and the annual contract review schedule.

Requirements

    Experience : Minimum 5 years in healthcare compliance — Medicare billing, HIPAA, or post-acute / RPM environment strongly preferred.

    Certifications: Certified in Healthcare Compliance (CHC) required or obtainable within 12 months of hire. CHPC (privacy) a plus.

    Technical : Working knowledge of CPT coding (99453–99470), CMS PFS Final Rules, OIG Work Plan, MAC audit processes, and AKS/Stark safe harbors.

    Skills : Strong SOP writing, audit documentation, and cross-functional communication skills. Ability to deliver training to clinical and non-clinical staff.

    Systems : Familiarity with healthcare compliance platforms (preferred); proficiency in Microsoft 365 required.

    Education : Bachelor's degree required; healthcare administration, law, or clinical field preferred.

jobs.excerpt: At Treewalk, you’ll be the finance engine behind growing private companies: tight month-end closes, management reporting that actually gets read, forecasts leaders can steer by, and systems and controls built to scale.
jobs.description:
At Treewalk, you’ll be the finance engine behind growing private companies: tight month-end closes, management reporting that actually gets read, forecasts leaders can steer by, and systems and controls built to scale. You’ll own the internal finance function for a portfolio of clients from a broad range of industries. Many engagements will tap you as a hands-on fractional controller and trusted advisor to owners and leadership teams; others will lean on you to build finance processes from the ground up. Either way, every file is yours to run.

Deadlines are real; overtime isn’t a lifestyle. We staff sensibly, treat extra hours as the rare exception, and back that up with true schedule autonomy and remote flexibility—so your evenings stay yours.

If you’ve built your foundation in public accounting or run the close as a controller in industry, and you’re ready to trade 70-hour busy-season marathons for high-impact work, tangible ownership, and genuine balance, then we would love to hear from you.

How You’ll Create Impact Day-to-Day

  • Own the close – Run full-cycle accounting and month-end close for your client files, review the team’s work, and deliver clean, reconciled books on a timeline leaders can count on.
  • Keep leadership laser-focused – Prepare monthly internal management packages and variance reports against budgets and forecasts, translating the findings into clear, action-ready recommendations.
  • Shape the roadmap – Build annual budgets, rolling forecasts, and cash-flow models, aligning owners around targets that push the business—without breaking it.
  • Turn data into insight – Create and maintain dashboards and KPI reporting that spotlight trends, margins, and red flags before anyone else sees them.
  • Build the foundation – Design and implement accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls across key cycles so the finance function scales with the business.
  • Make systems work harder – Lead ERP implementations, clean-ups, and process improvements, finding automation opportunities that cut manual effort.
  • Keep everything compliant – Oversee payroll, sales tax, and other government and regulatory filings so nothing slips through the cracks.
  • Make year-end painless – Prepare airtight year-end working papers and support, and quarterback conversations with external accountants, auditors, and tax advisors.

Result: clients see you as the steady, trusted partner who keeps their operations running on accurate numbers—while you build mastery across industries without the grind of traditional public practice.

Who We Are

Treewalk is Vancouver-born, scaling nationwide, and obsessed with turning financial complexity into clarity. From owner-managed private companies to TSX-V, CSE, NASDAQ, and OTC issuers, we give clients the finance and accounting expertise to run their businesses with confidence—so they can focus on growth.

But labels like “accounting firm” don’t capture our DNA. Picture a tech startup powered by CPAs:

  • Holacracy over hierarchy – Ideas outrank titles, and ownership lives on every desk.
  • Industry-agnostic curiosity – From construction and manufacturing to biotech and next-gen retail, if it’s innovative, we’re already in it—or will be tomorrow.
  • Growth at warp speed – One of Canada’s fastest-rising advisory practices, we set audacious goals, then sprint past them.
  • Training ground for tomorrow’s CFOs – Whether you’re two years post-designation or a seasoned controller, Treewalk is where accountants level-up for industry roles and strategic finance leadership.

The Values That Power Us

Mastery: We hunt knowledge relentlessly and build expertise into every engagement.

Support: No one goes it alone—collaboration is our default setting.

Ownership: We celebrate wins and own slip-ups with equal conviction.

Kaizen: Continuous improvement isn’t a buzzword; it’s our daily operating system.

Requirements

Our ideal candidate...

    • CPA designation required.
    • Significant controllership and/or public accounting experience - ideally supporting private, owner-managed, or growth-stage companies.
    • Assurance experience at a public accounting firm is an asset.
    • After the base experience requirements are met, we hire first and foremost, strong analytical and problem solvers.
    • Relationship builder – You maintain professional relationships with clients and team members alike with open and effective communication.
    • You take pride in making sure everything is correct; account balances that do not reconcile make you crazy. You find joy in solving that unsolvable problem.

Please mention these bonus skills if you have them

    • ERP systems experience (NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, Xero, Sage)
    • Construction industry experience
    • FP&A or financial modelling experience

Benefits

Why Treewalk Feels Different

It’s Treewalk for a reason: we invest in your growth, trust your judgment, and protect your life outside the ledger.

  • No-Strings Learning Fund – We pay 100% of your CPA modules, annual dues, and any pro-dev courses you choose—and we’ll never claw it back if you move on.
  • Freedom Over Face-Time – Own your deadlines, shape your schedule. Hit a midday workout, do the school run—just bring the results.
  • Day-One Peace of Mind – Extended health, dental, vision, and parental-leave benefits start the moment you join.

Annual Salary - $105,000

Our data environment is complex but modest in volume, with limited history, so you can shape the data model early.   • Build compliance into your designs, including HIPAA considerations and role-based and row-level access controls
  • Review SQL, dbt, and AI-generated code for correctness, not just style, and raise the technical standard for the team
  • Document models, metric definitions, and design decisions so others can build on them

What You Bring

  • 6+ years of experience in analytics or data engineering (or a closely related role), building and maintaining data models and pipelines
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience
  • Strong SQL and dbt skills, including incremental models and testing
  • Hands-on Snowflake experience, including semantic modeling
  • Commitment to data quality, with experience building tests and monitoring that catch issues before stakeholders do
  • Experience working with product teams, ideally technical ones, to define metrics and scope ambiguous problems
  • Fluency with AI coding tools like Claude, with the judgment to use, build, and validate AI-generated code
  • Comfort working in a regulated environment with privacy and compliance requirements
  • The ownership and end-to-end thinking to see a problem from raw data to a metric someone trusts
  • Strong communication skills with technical and non-technical partners

Nice to Have

  • Working knowledge of statistics and experimentation
  • Healthcare, claims, or insurance background; HIPAA familiarity

  • Fivetran or other ELT experience, including troubleshooting sync and CDC issues
  • Tableau or other BI tools

  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits
  • A 401k retirement plan
  • Paid vacation and company holidays
  • Opportunity to make an impact at a rapidly growing mission-driven company transforming healthcare in the U.S.

The Client Assurance Resolution Leader is responsible for driving the end-to-end management and resolution of critical client escalations while advancing quality, operational excellence, and continual improvement across AHEAD’s Service Deliver organization.

This role ensures that client-impacting issues are swiftly contained, root causes are identified, and long-term corrective actions are implemented through disciplined quality and service improvement practices. The Resolution Leader acts as the central point of accountability during high-visibility situations—bridging AHEAD’s delivery, engineering, and client success teams to restore confidence, strengthen relationships, and drive sustainable improvements.

Roles & Responsibilities

    Escalation Leadership & Resolution Management

    • Lead critical, high-impact client escalations from initiation through closure, ensuring containment, clarity, and complete resolution.

    • Serve as the single point of accountability for escalation resolution, coordinating cross-functional response teams across Engineering, Delivery, Operations, and Client Success.

    • Provide structured escalation management, including clear recovery plans, ownership assignments, and communication cadences.

    • Facilitate daily or weekly stand-ups, executive briefings, and client updates for active escalations.

    Quality Management & Root Cause Analysis

    • Drive structured Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) for all major client incidents.

    • Embed quality management practices in every stage of escalation handling, ensuring data-driven and sustainable resolutions.

    • Partner with Product, Service Delivery, and Quality teams to identify recurring issues and integrate findings into the AHEAD Quality Management System (QMS).

    • Lead post-incident reviews and “lessons learned” sessions to strengthen AHEAD’s quality culture and client assurance model.

    Continual Improvement & Process Excellence

    • Identify systemic challenges, process gaps, and improvement opportunities across escalation management and service delivery.

    • Collaborate with the Continual Improvement and Operational Excellence teams to enhance Client Assurance processes, tools, and frameworks.

    • Develop and execute improvement plans aligned with AHEAD’s CX Quality Objectives, measuring outcomes through defined KPIs (e.g., time-to-resolution, CSAT, recurrence rates).

    • Promote knowledge sharing, best practices, and proactive risk mitigation across teams to prevent future escalations.

    Client Communication & Advocacy

    • Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for clients, ensuring transparent, empathetic, and outcome-oriented communication throughout the resolution process.

    • Represent client perspectives in internal governance meetings and improvement forums.

    • Reinforce client trust by ensuring accountability, responsiveness, and continuous follow-up until full closure.

    Governance, Metrics & Reporting

    • Track and analyze escalation performance metrics including time-to-resolution, RCA completion, and post-resolution client satisfaction.

Ici, on est accros aux social ads sur Meta / TikTok et on a une mission : faire exploser les campagnes ads de nos clients (Sephora, Rare Beauty, Legal Place, Wecasa, IAD, Bitstack,...).

On teste, on analyse, on ajuste, on re-teste, jusqu’à trouver LA recette créative qui fait décoller chaque compte.

Et pour y arriver, on a plusieurs cordes à notre arc :

Stratégie créative – On scrute les comptes de nos clients sous toutes leurs coutures et on propose des recommandations créatives structurées et actionnables pour maximiser la perf'.

Copywriting – On rédige des scripts, storyboards et briefs calibrés pour scaler, jusqu’à la moindre virgule.

Production de vidéos – On produit des formats courts verticaux pensés pour la performance (UGC, VSL, contenus IA, etc.), adaptés aux codes des plateformes comme TikTok & Instagram, avec un seul objectif : capter l’attention et convertir.

Production de static ads – On crée des visuels ultra-impactants pour que même auprès d’une audience froide (glaciale !), nos créas donnent envie de cliquer.

Bref, on ne laisse rien au hasard et on met tout en œuvre pour transformer chaque euro investi.

Vos missions

Ce qu’on attend de toi 🫵

En tant que monteur vidéo freelance spécialisé UGC & VSL, tu seras un maillon clé de la performance de nos campagnes.

Tes missions incluront :

Montage UGC orienté performance

Transformer des rushs bruts (créateurs, clients, assets existants) en ads qui captent l’attention dès la première seconde et convertissent. Hook, rythme, storytelling : rien n’est laissé au hasard.

Montage VSL (Video Sales Letter)

Structurer et monter des vidéos longues ou semi-longues pensées pour vendre : narration fluide, dynamisme visuel, gestion du tempo, overlays impactants… Tu sais garder l’attention tout en maximisant la conversion.

Optimisation créative

Adapter tes montages aux codes des plateformes (TikTok, Reels, Meta Ads). Tu comprends ce qui fait performer une vidéo : pattern interrupt, pacing, sous-titres, sound design, etc.

Déclinaisons & itérations

Créer plusieurs variations à partir d’un même concept pour tester différents hooks, angles, rythmes. Chez nous, une créa = plusieurs tests.

Collaboration avec l’équipe créative

Travailler main dans la main avec les Creative Strategists pour donner vie aux concepts et scripts. Tu ne montes pas “dans ton coin” : tu contribues à la perf globale.

Vos compétences

Profil recherché 🕵️

Expérience solide en montage vidéo UGC et/ou VSL orienté performance.

Appétences pour le motion design.

Maîtrise des codes des social ads (TikTok / Meta).

Excellente compréhension du rythme, du storytelling et de la rétention.

Capacité à transformer des rushs simples en vidéos ultra engageantes et optimisées pour la conversion.

Bonne sensibilité marketing (tu comprends ce qui vend, pas juste ce qui est “beau”).

Autonomie, rapidité d’exécution et sens du détail. Pas de fautes d'orthographes ou d'erreurs de safe zones.

Ultra important : respect des deadlines !

Avantages

Ce que nous t’offrons 🎁

Un environnement de travail flexible et collaboratif, entièrement en télétravail.

Des projets variés avec des marques ambitieuses.

Un volume de créas important (tu ne vas pas t’ennuyer).

Une équipe ultra orientée performance avec laquelle tu vas progresser vite.

Une culture qui valorise la créativité, le test & learn et l’exigence.

Ici, on est des accros aux social ads sur Meta / TikTok et on a une mission : faire exploser les campagnes ads de nos clients (Sephora, Rare Beauty, Legal Place, Wecasa, IAD, Bitstack,...).

Pour ça, on ne se contente pas de balancer quelques créas dans les campagnes, prier le St Esprit de la Performance et espérer que ça marche. Non.

On teste, on analyse, on ajuste, on re-teste, jusqu’à trouver LA recette créative qui fait décoller chaque compte.

Et pour y arriver, on a plusieurs cordes à notre arc :

Stratégie créative – On scrute les comptes de nos clients sous toutes leurs coutures et on propose des recommandations créatives structurées et actionnables pour maximiser la perf'.

Copywriting – On rédige des scripts, storyboards et briefs calibrés pour scaler, jusqu’à la moindre virgule.

Production de vidéos – On produit des formats courts verticaux pensés pour la performance (UGC, VSL, contenus IA, etc.), adaptés aux codes des plateformes comme TikTok & Instagram, avec un seul objectif : capter l’attention et convertir.

Production de static ads – On crée des visuels ultra-impactants pour que même auprès d’une audience froide (glaciale !), nos créas donnent envie de cliquer.

Bref, on ne laisse rien au hasard et on met tout en œuvre pour transformer chaque euro investi.

Vos missions

Ce qu’on attend de toi 🫵

En tant que monteur vidéo freelance spécialisé en contenus IA, tu seras en charge de produire des créas innovantes, scalables et ultra-performantes grâce à l’intelligence artificielle.

Tes missions incluront :

Création de vidéos UGC IA ultra réalistes

Produire des contenus qui ressemblent à du vrai UGC (brolls, face-cam,…), mais générés par l’IA. L’objectif : l’oeil humain ne doit pas faire la différence entre tes contenus IA et de vrais UGC.

Création de contenus IA non réalistes / personnages fictifs

Créer des vidéos avec des avatars, personnages animés ou univers totalement générés (type storytelling, ads concepts, hooks visuels forts). Ici, ta créativité fait la différence.

Montage & intégration IA

Assembler, éditer et enrichir des contenus issus d’outils IA (vidéo, voix, image). Tu sais combiner plusieurs outils pour arriver à un rendu final fluide et engageant.

Itération & test

Créer rapidement plusieurs variations d’un même concept pour tester différents angles, hooks, visuels ou formats. Chez nous, la vitesse d’exécution = avantage compétitif.

Collaboration avec l’équipe créative

Travailler main dans la main avec les Creative Strategists et copywriters pour donner vie aux concepts et scripts. Tu ne montes pas “dans ton coin” : tu contribues à la perf globale.

Vos compétences

Profil recherché 🕵️

Expérience en montage vidéo + utilisation d’outils IA (Nano Banana, VEO, Sora, Kling, Freepik,…).

Maîtrise des codes des social ads (TikTok / Meta).

Excellente compréhension du rythme, du storytelling et de la rétention.

Bonne sensibilité marketing (tu comprends ce qui vend, pas juste ce qui est “beau”).

Créativité ++

Autonomie, rapidité d’exécution et sens du détail.

Avantages

Ce que nous t’offrons 🎁

Un environnement de travail flexible et collaboratif, entièrement en télétravail.

Des projets variés avec des marques ambitieuses.

Un volume de créas important (tu ne vas pas t’ennuyer).

Une équipe ultra orientée performance avec laquelle tu vas progresser vite.

Une culture qui valorise la créativité, le test & learn et l’exigence.

  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.


In this role, you will:

  • Product Expertise: Become an expert on Samsara’s product portfolio of complete Internet of Things (“IoT”) solutions combining hardware, software, and cloud to bring real-time visibility, analytics, and AI to operations across multiple industries.
  • Technical Troubleshooting: Use your technical knowledge and product expertise to troubleshoot and resolve customer issues with medium to high complexity.
  • Responsiveness & Resolution: Respond to customers and resolve their inquiries in a timely and helpful manner with a primary focus on meeting our SLA goals.
  • Documentation: Partner with Enablement to author and maintain customer-facing knowledge base articles to help improve the self-serviceability for our end users.
  • Partnerships: Work closely to develop partnerships with our Engineering and Product teams in order to reproduce bugs and build testbeds as necessary.
  • Feedback Loop: Provide direct feedback to Support Management for product and process improvements to help enhance the customer experience.
  • Team Player: Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering (Mechanical/Electrical), or other technical fields.
  • 1-3 years of experience in support, engineering, or other technical roles.

Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish is a must.

  • Experience with troubleshooting and supporting hardware & software products.
  • Strong familiarity with using CRMs like Zendesk or Salesforce.
  • Technical know-how - you’re comfortable interfacing with engineers, translating complex technical concepts into everyday language, and working with SaaS systems.
  • Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills coupled with the ability to influence individual contributors and leaders across the company.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, accessible language for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to automate repetitive tasks, improve processes, and drive greater efficiency
  • Strong bias for action, ability to dive deep, and insistence on the highest standards.
  • Ability to work in a hyper-growth environment with shifting priorities.
  • Willingness to work holidays and weekends as needed to meet customer demands.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience with industrial systems, electronics, tinkering with cars or IoT devices, or similar hands-on work is a big plus.
  • French or German proficiency is a big plus.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.excerpt: Who We AreAt Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

Most companies are still talking about AI. We want someone who will put it to work.

As Director, Business Systems & AI Enablement, you'll lead how Partnerize uses technology to run a smarter, faster business. You'll own Salesforce and Asana, the core platforms our teams use every day, along with the integrations that connect them to other business systems such as NetSuite, HubSpot and DocuSign. You'll also bring enterprise AI tools like Google Gemini Enterprise into how we work, so our teams spend less time on manual work and more time on customers and growth.

You'll be a player-coach. You'll lead and develop a small team of two while rolling up your sleeves yourself. One week you might be redesigning a Salesforce sales workflow. The next, you might be building a Gemini agent that removes hours of admin from the Sales team, or presenting ROI results to the executive team.

What you'll own:

  • Business systems: the roadmap, intake, delivery and vendor relationships for Salesforce, Asana and the integrations that connect them across the business.
  • Process optimization: finding friction, redesigning workflows and making sure data stays clean as we scale.
  • AI enablement: rolling out enterprise AI, designing functional agents, driving adoption and measuring the results.

You won't be doing this alone. You'll be part of a leadership group shaping how Partnerize moves into a human-AI enabled future, with one shared goal: a workplace where people and AI do their best work together. Our Director, Product brings the vision for AI in the Partnerize platform. Our Director, Business Performance Optimization brings the framework we use to evaluate new AI opportunities and helps guide proofs of concept. Our People Success team makes sure our people grow alongside the technology. You bring it all to life across the business: working with teams to find where AI can make the biggest difference, then turning big ideas into real change in how we work every day.This role has high visibility and real autonomy. You'll have a direct line to measurable business impact.

Key Responsibilities

1. Business Systems & Process Optimization

  • Salesforce & Asana ownership: Own the configuration, roadmap and health of Salesforce and Asana as our primary business platforms, ensuring they scale with the business and support clean, reliable data.
  • Integration oversight: Oversee the integrations between Salesforce and Asana and connected systems, including NetSuite, HubSpot and DocuSign, so data flows accurately across Sales, Marketing, Finance and Operations.
  • Process optimization: Find friction in how teams work and redesign processes to improve efficiency, data quality and scalability.
  • Requirements and solution design: Partner with stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Finance and Operations to develop user stories, define solution designs and write clear business requirements.
  • Agile delivery: Manage intake and triage for business systems requests. Prioritize and maintain backlogs in Jira so developers can deliver smoothly.
  • Hands-on building: Personally configure, prototype and build solutions (e.g., Salesforce Flows, Asana workflows, Gemini agents) alongside your team.
  • Testing and quality: Own the strategy and execution of user acceptance testing (UAT) so delivered solutions meet business requirements.
  • Change management and enablement: Lead end-user training, documentation, process flows, data dictionaries and communications for new features and workflow changes.

2. AI Enablement & Agent Adoption

This role leads internal AI adoption in close partnership with Product, Business Performance Optimization and People Success.

  • Enterprise AI platform ownership: Act as the internal product owner for enterprise AI platforms, starting with Google Gemini Enterprise. Manage rollouts, end-user enablement, prompt templates and feature adoption.
  • Agent and workflow design: Lead the design, testing and deployment of functional, business-led agents and automated multi-step workflows that remove manual work across teams.
  • AI embedded in core systems: Identify opportunities to embed AI and automation directly into Salesforce and Asana workflows, not just alongside them.
  • AI opportunity delivery: Work with business teams to find high-impact AI use cases. Take them through the Business Performance Optimization evaluation framework, partner on proofs of concept, and lead approved tools from pilot to full rollout.
  • AI governance: Put responsible-use guidelines, data security practices and access controls into practice for internal AI tools, in partnership with IT, Security and Legal.
  • Impact measurement: Define, track and report on business outcomes such as hours saved, cycle-time reduction and adoption rates, with seat utilization as one input, to show the ROI of AI across departments.

3. Leadership & Strategy

  • Team leadership: Lead, coach and develop a team of two business systems professionals, and manage external consultants as needed. Set clear goals, run performance reviews and support ongoing growth.
  • Roadmap and prioritization: Own the consolidated Business Systems and AI roadmap across departments. Balance competing requests against company priorities, and explain "No" or "Not Yet" decisions clearly.
  • Vendor and license management: Manage relationships, SLAs and engagements with software vendors and implementation partners. Oversee renewals and license optimization to control cost.
  • Key partnerships: Work closely with the Director, Product, sharing AI learnings, tools and vendor insights so internal and product AI efforts stay aligned. Partner with the Director, Business Performance Optimization to take AI opportunities through the evaluation framework and proofs of concept to delivered, measurable business results. Work with People Success on AI skills, change readiness and how roles evolve as AI takes on more routine work.
  • Internal champion: Advocate for technology and AI modernization across the company, and communicate the value the Business Systems team delivers to executives and department heads.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 90 days: Assess the current Salesforce, Asana and integration landscape. Build relationships with key stakeholders. Deliver an initial prioritized Business Systems and AI roadmap.
  • First 6 months: Launch at least [X] functional AI agents or automated workflows in production. Establish an AI adoption and impact dashboard. Streamline intake and delivery processes.
  • First 12 months: Reach 100% active adoption of Gemini Enterprise. Show measurable time savings of [X] hours per month across teams. Present a roadmap approved by the executive team for the following year.

What You Bring

Experience

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in business systems, business process optimization or enterprise application management.
  • Experience leading, coaching or managing business analysts, systems administrators or similar roles. You enjoy building as much as leading.
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Technical Skills

  • Salesforce: Deep hands-on administrator or power-user experience, including automation (e.g., Flows) and data management.
  • Asana or similar work management platforms: Experience configuring and scaling tools such as Asana, Monday.com, Smartsheet or similar.
  • Integrations: Working knowledge of how core platforms connect to systems like NetSuite, HubSpot and DocuSign. A solid understanding of APIs, data models, ETL and data sync between systems.
  • AI and automation: Practical experience rolling out and driving adoption of commercial AI tools (e.g., Google Gemini Enterprise, ChatGPT Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot), including prompt design, agent or workflow building and measuring impact. Experience with automation platforms (e.g., Zapier, Workato) is a plus.
  • Agile delivery: Experience managing backlogs, prioritizing sprints and writing user stories in Jira.

Leadership & Communication

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical workflows in clear business language.
  • A collaborative style, with experience delivering results through peer partnerships where ownership is shared across functions.
  • Proven ability to manage executive expectations, work through competing requests and apply prioritization frameworks with tact.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and technologies.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Salesforce certification(s) (e.g., Administrator, Advanced Administrator, Business Analyst).
  • Experience with Salesforce AI capabilities
  • Familiarity with digital, performance, affiliate or partner marketing.
  • Experience supporting users across multiple regions (EMEA, Americas, APAC).
  • Training or certification in process improvement methods (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma).

US Benefits & Perks

  • Flexible Time Off Policy – Take the time you need
  • Enhanced Parental Leave: 16 weeks for birth parent, 8 weeks for non-birth parent at full pay after one year employment
  • Robust Company Sponsored Health & Welfare Benefits
  • 401k Plan – 4% employee match
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP and Wellness Coaching
  • Regular company events and activities

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization’s success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

HexCoded is an AI video studio: you should be able to make anything you can imagine. We are a very small team building the tools that are reshaping how video, image and audio get made. Check out hexcoded.ai

What you'll actually work on

  • Make the content. Reels, shorts, posts, hooks, thumbnails, captions. Most of it made in HexCoded itself, posted in public.
  • Run our editors. We work with a bench of freelance video editors. You write the brief, pick the reference, chase the deadline, and send it back when it isn't right. Content nobody chases doesn't get made.
  • Fill the Discord. We have one. It's nearly empty. Getting people in there and keeping it alive is yours — inviting them, welcoming them by name, starting the conversation on the quiet days, and telling the rest of us what those people actually want from us.
  • Write the emails. All of them. The hello when someone signs up. The nudge that gets them to make their first ad. The note to people who drifted away. The announcement when we launch something. You write it, you send it.
  • Write the ads. You'll sit with the ad account, see which ads are doing well, and write the next batch. You won't control the budget. You'll be the one who knows why the winner won.
  • Watch the numbers. Views, saves, Discord joins, replies, signups. Not for a report. Because you can't get better at this without knowing which of your posts worked and which died.

What you'll bring

  • An account you've actually run. Yours, a friend's, a college club's, a page about something you love. Send us links and real numbers, including the posts that flopped.
  • Taste you can explain. Show you two thumbnails and you can say which one wins and why, in a sentence. "It just feels better" is where you start, not where you stop.
  • You already build things with AI. Not a chat tab you ask questions in. Actual work. You've had a model rename two hundred clips at once, pull a week of numbers into one place, write thirty versions of a caption so you could pick the best one, or make some small thing that saves you an hour every day. You'll do a lot of that here, including in Claude Code, which is Claude running on your computer where it can work on your files directly. You don't need to know it already. You do need to have used AI to save yourself real time, and be able to show us what you made.
  • Short, clear writing. Most of what you make is a few words a stranger reads once and judges us on.
  • You're properly online. You knew what happened on Instagram this week before anyone told you. You can name a format that died and say what killed it.

Samsara is seeking a strategic and highly technical Director of Sales Engineering – New Products to build and lead a specialist Sales Engineering team focused on incubating and scaling new products. This team will operate in close alignment with our mainline sales and specialist sales teams to ensure a cohesive, integrated customer experience and a seamless transition from incubation to scaled execution.

You and your team will engage in executive-level customer conversations, lead complex technical discovery, architect solutions, execute proof-of-value initiatives, and collaborate cross-functionally to remove technical and operational barriers to adoption. You will act as trusted advisors to both customers and internal stakeholders, shaping how new products are positioned, demonstrated, packaged, deployed, and supported in the field.

The ideal candidate is an experienced Sales Engineering leader who thrives in ambiguity and has a proven track record of launching new technical solutions into enterprise and mid-market segments. You are equally comfortable engaging executives and diving deep into architecture, integrations, and deployment strategy, with a focus on driving measurable adoption and revenue impact.

  • Build and lead Samsara’s New Product Sales Engineering organization, defining the operating model and success metrics for new product incubation and scale.

  • Ensure alignment and seamless collaboration between specialist SEs, mainline SEs, and broader GTM teams to deliver a cohesive customer experience.
  • Continuously elevate the organization by leveraging Samsara’s leadership frameworks and fostering a culture of learning, experimentation, and accountability.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team

  • 7+ years of experience managing a technical team, ideally in a sales engineering capacity
  • Proven success in hiring, developing, and retaining leadership talent
  • Experience creating scalable and consistent feedback loops enabling your Management Team to participate in process improvements and scaling activities
  • Experience with SE capacity planning based on Sales need across different segments globally
  • Experience building process and integrating software tools to measure organizational performance impact throughout the build/sales lifecycle
  • Experience driving product development based on input from Sales Leadership, prospects, and customers
  • Experience collaborating with internal cross functional teams (Product Management, Engineering, Customer Success, Support, etc.) to deliver results as part of the sales cycle
  • Success in managing relationships with external technology partners through complex sales cycles

  • 7+ years of experience managing a Sales Engineering Team selling cloud managed hardware product lines
  • Experience partnering with GTM teams in frontier markets to increase sales and drive product development
  • Experience clearly defining roles and responsibilities through corporate change, including cross-functional team interactions as well as internal team growth
  • Experience managing an organizational budget
  • Understanding of vehicle diagnostic systems, including Controller Area Networks (CAN bus) and Power Take Off (PTO) applications
  • Hobbyist interest in working with things driven by electronic systems (car audio installation/classic car restoration, home automation, building things with raspberry pi, arduino, etc.)

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Total Rewards

Anchor closed $40M in top-tier VC funding and grew 500% last year, transforming the $74B services payments market. Our platform automates billing and collections so businesses can focus on growth.

We’re hiring AI-First Account Executives as part of Anchor’s AE founding team. You’ll be among the first AEs to shape how we sell, setting the standard for everyone who comes after. You’ll own the full sales cycle across SMB and Mid-Market accounts - prospecting, consulting, demoing, and closing - with AI embedded into how you work at every stage, not layered on top of it. This isn’t about volume alone. It’s about combining consultative selling with AI-powered precision to close faster and deliver real value to every prospect.

Reporting to the Director of Sales. Entrepreneurial mindset. AI hands-on experience. Deeply tech savvy - you configure and adopt tools yourself, you don’t wait for someone else to set them up. High-energy. Fast-paced. Hungry to grow.

At Anchor, AI-first isn’t a selling point on a JD - it’s how we operate. As an AE, you’re expected to run your territory the way a lean, high-output operator would: using AI to eliminate the manual work that slows most reps down, so your time goes toward conversations that move deals forward. Prospecting research, email personalization, call prep, follow-up sequencing - if AI can own it, you build the system and let it run.

Anchor is pioneering the future of sales, where AI is already empowering Account Executives. Join our team and help us redefine industry standards.

Responsibility

  • Own the full sales cycle. Prospecting, discovery, demo, negotiation, and close. You source opportunities and grow revenue across all channels.
  • Sell consultatively. Act as a trusted advisor. Understand each prospect's billing, collections, and payment pain points deeply. Tailor solutions to their specific business challenges, not a one-size-fits-all pitch.
  • Run an AI-powered sales motion. Your prospecting is AI-researched. Your outreach is AI-personalized. Your calls are prepped and analyzed by AI. You don’t use AI as a shortcut - you use it to go deeper on every deal than a traditional rep could.
  • Drive outbound pipeline. Proactively engage Anchor's target market with AI-enhanced outreach to build and maintain a robust pipeline. Hunter mentality.
  • Generate revenue at events. Drive leads and close through direct engagement at industry conferences.
  • Track, analyze, optimize. Use data and AI-driven insights to inform decisions, forecast accurately, and continuously improve your processes.
  • Invest in your growth. Commit to daily training, enablement, and building your AI selling toolkit.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Customer Success, Marketing, and Product to ensure a seamless customer experience.

Requirements

  • 3-6 years of SMB/Mid-Market B2B SaaS sales (new business). Full-cycle experience required.
  • Consultative selling skills. You diagnose before you prescribe. Comfortable navigating complex business challenges and multi-stakeholder conversations.
  • AI-first approach to sales, with receipts. You already use AI in your day-to-day workflow and can name the tools, the workflows you’ve built or automated, and the impact on your output. Not "familiar with AI" - actively using it to outperform.
  • Hunter mentality. Proven outbound skills. SDR/BDR background is a plus.
  • Top performer. Consistent track record in the top 10% of your team. Quota attainment is the norm, not the exception.
  • Strong communicator. Excellent presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills. You build credibility with decision-makers at all levels.
  • Experience with service providers. Ideally, accounting firms, bookkeeping firms, or finance professionals in billing, collections, or payments (ERP, AP Automation, Expense Management, GL).
  • Sales tech proficiency. Comfortable with HubSpot, Avoma, Intercom, and similar tools. Quick to adopt new technology.
  • Deeply tech savvy. You configure and adopt tools yourself - you don’t wait for someone else to set them up. You pick up new platforms fast, dig into product details, and can translate complex capabilities into business value for a prospect.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset. Self-disciplined, resourceful, and hungry to grow. You treat your territory like your own business and take full ownership of outcomes.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Accounting, or Finance.

Extra

  • 2+ years of practical experience in accounting, bookkeeping, or finance.
  • Experience managing high-volume transactional sales alongside longer consultative cycles.
  • Ability to travel to conferences.

jobs.excerpt: About Scene Health Scene’s 360° model of care enhances the gold standard of medication adherence, Directly Observed Therapy.
jobs.description:
About Scene Health

Scene’s 360° model of care enhances the gold standard of medication adherence, Directly Observed Therapy. Combining personalized video coaching, education, and motivational content, we bring healthcare professionals, patients, and their families together to solve the $500B medication nonadherence problem. Our mobile app allows patients to connect with a care team of pharmacists, nurses, and health coaches through daily video check-ins, anytime and anywhere. We make it fun for patients to stay on top of their medications, help them address medication challenges, and empower them to improve their health by addressing barriers to adherence related to social determinants of health.

Job Overview – Clinical Pharmacist (PharmD)

The Clinical Pharmacist (PharmD) functions as a trusted health advisor and behavior-change coach; someone patients look forward to hearing from. You will use clinical expertise as the foundation, but your primary skill is building enough trust with patients that they want to stay engaged in their care, disclose barriers and follow through on recommendations.

You will conduct MTM services, in particular Comprehensive Medication Reviews (CMRs), for eligible patients. Your real primary responsibility is identifying and addressing the full range of issues — clinical, behavioral, social, financial, logistical — that keep a patient from taking their medication and staying healthy. You will also establish protocols to help the team navigate and respond to different situations that may arise with patients, and liaise with non-clinical and clinical staff members to ensure continuity of care, and resolution of medication challenges during our program. The ideal candidate will demonstrate supportive, motivating, and expert patient and provider engagement, and demonstrate thought leadership in areas for further optimization of pharmacy services.

Responsibilities Include:

  • Build durable, trust-based relationships with patients through telephonic and video engagement; acting as a consistent, human touchpoint in their care, not a one-time transaction
  • Deliver MTM services (CMRs, targeted reviews, medication reconciliation, prior auth review) as a starting point for a broader conversation about the patient’s life, barriers, and goals
  • Proactively screen for and address social determinants of health (transportation, cost, food insecurity, health literacy, caregiver burden, mental health) that affect adherence, and connect patients to appropriate resources or teammates
  • Use motivational interviewing and behavior-change techniques, not just clinical scripts to understand why a patient is nonadherent and tailor the approach accordingly
  • Actively sell patients on the value of the vDOT program itself: articulate why daily engagement matters, address skepticism or fatigue, and re-engage patients who are drifting away
  • Assess the use of prescribed medication therapy for unnecessary medications, additional medication needs, inappropriate dosing, adverse drug reactions, ineffective medications, and adherence issues
  • Identify non-medication health issues (missed follow-ups, gaps in care, undiagnosed symptoms, mental health concerns) surfaced during conversations and route them to the right team member or provider
  • Document clinical recommendations and patient narrative context (not just clinical facts) so the care team can maintain continuity and personalize future outreach
  • Send clinical recommendations to provider offices and follow up on the responses to ensure recommendations are enacted
  • Coordinate with Scene Team, including nurses, health coaches, management, product managers, and client-facing staff as needed
  • Serve as a model of engagement style for other clinical staff; contribute to coaching frameworks/scripts that improve conversion and retention across the team
  • Introduce and explain our video-based direct observation therapy program to members, and assist them in starting their video submissions.
  • Record asynchronous videos and engage with members via video and chat to summarize key next steps from the medication review, respond to clinical questions, and encourage continued participation in Scene’s program

Required Qualifications

  • Active Pharmacist License with at least 3 years of pharmacy practice
  • Medically fluent in English and Spanish (native Spanish fluency preferred)
  • Demonstrated experience in a role requiring sustained patient relationship-building; health coaching, care management, telehealth, chronic disease management, or similar
  • Comfort and skill with motivational interviewing, behavioral health screening, or coaching frameworks (training can be provided, but some prior exposure or aptitude expected)
  • Experience in digital health, health startups, health plans, or hospital quality improvement
  • Strong telephonic/video presence: warm, clear, unhurried communication style suited to the elderly population
  • Demonstrated ability to influence patient behavior — not just inform it
  • Ability to work autonomously in a virtual/decentralized team with minimal script-following

jobs.title: Generative Media Engineer, AI Social - US
jobs.excerpt: Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate.
jobs.description:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

The Opportunity

AI Social is one of the most ambitious products we've ever shipped. An AI agent that produces on-brand Instagram carousels and reels for every Luxury Presence customer, from raw input data to finished media. It isn't LLMs writing code. It's LLMs designing, choosing the photo, voicing the script, picking the cuts, and composing the final frame.

As the Generative Media Engineer on AI Social, you own the render pipeline, the prompts and agent loops that drive it, and the visual quality of what ships. Product and content strategy partners set the direction; engineering and design peers ship alongside you. This is an unusual role at the intersection of code, design, AI, and social media. You don't fit the normal engineering mold, that's the point.

Skills and experience

  • Solid working knowledge of TypeScript and Node.js. You're comfortable shipping production code and you're ready to grow into our stack.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM-driven systems. Prompts, structured outputs, tool-calling, agent loops, evals.
  • At least one shipped piece of generative media in image, video, voice, or music that someone other than you has seen and used.
  • A portfolio or body of work that demonstrates both technical depth and design sensibility.
  • Bonus: a personal creator practice somewhere. A feed, a portfolio, a side project, a YouTube channel, an . Public, ongoing, under your own name. You understand the medium because you've lived in it.
  • Formal or self-taught grounding in design, visual art, film, or motion.
  • Comfort moving between exploratory PoC work and shipped-to-customers polish, with judgment about which mode is appropriate when.

Technical fluency with AI tools

  • You're already using Claude Code, Cursor, or similar AI-assisted development tools in your daily workflow. We're a Claude Code shop and we expect you to be fluent.
  • Familiarity with MCPs and how tools like Figma, Notion, and Linear connect into AI-assisted workflows. You understand how these tools and integrations fit together and can help the team get more out of them.
  • Beyond fluency, you're a dabbler and experimenter. You try new prompts, push their limits, and share what you learn. You have opinions about where the medium is headed.

Mindset

  • You're a tinkerer. You don't just build what's asked; you spot leverage points and build what's needed.
  • You care about systems more than features. You'd rather build a template family that ships ten posts well than ten bespoke posts that age out by next week.
  • You build on shared systems. Constraints feel like leverage, not obstacles.
  • You have strong convictions about quality, but you ship. You know the difference between polish that matters and perfection that stalls.
  • You partner well with non-engineers. You'll collaborate across product, design, and content strategy. Patience and clarity with people outside engineering is non-negotiable.
  • You operate with high ownership and low ego. You take direction from product and strategy partners on what to build, and you raise the bar on everything you ship.

What You Won't Be Doing

To be clear about what this role is not:

  • You won't own platform architecture or distributed systems work. You'll partner with engineering teams that do, while you stay focused on the AI Social pipeline itself.
  • You won't own the social strategy. You'll have a real voice in shaping it, but the call sits with our product and content strategy partners.
  • You won't be managing people on day one. This is a hands-on IC role with the expectation that you lead through craft and influence.

Tech stack

  • Platform: Node, TypeScript, React, Postgres, AWS, Temporal
  • LLMs and agents: the major model SDKs, with tool-calling, structured outputs, and multi-step agent loops
  • Media pipeline: image and video generation (Veo for video), voice and music synthesis (ElevenLabs), composite (Shotstack), and headless browser rendering

Join us in shaping the future of real estate

The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages.
We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition.
Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date.
More than 18,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry's most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner.
Every year since 2020, Luxury Presence has ranked on BuiltIn's Best Place to Work lists. HousingWire named our founder and CEO a 2024 Tech Trendsetter, we've received several Tech100 Awards, and we just scored an Inman Innovation Award for Best AI-Powered Platform.

Our client currently has a vacancy for a Scrum Master to offer his/her services as an expert remotely within the EU. In the context of the first assignment, the successful candidate will be integrated in the team of the company that will closely cooperate with a major client’s IT team on site.

Job Type: B2B Contract

Workplace: Remote

Requirements

  • University Degree and at least 8 years of IT professional experience;
  • Minimum of 3 of dedicated experience working as a Scrum Master at SM2 level or above;
  • Led at least 2 production teams through full sprint cycles (planning, review, retrospective, and refinement);
  • Implemented data-driven continuous improvement initiatives, such as increasing team velocity or reducing lead time;
  • Experience coordinating cross-team work via Scrum-of-Scrums or PI Planning events;
  • Deep knowledge of the Scrum Guide and Agile Manifesto principles and values;
  • Good knowledge of facilitation techniques (e.g., Fist of Five, participatory decision-making, Liberating Structures);
  • Good knowledge of systems-thinking and process tailoring to fit complex or evolving environments;
  • Good knowledge of team motivation and stakeholder engagement techniques (e.g., information radiators, team empowerment models);
  • Good knowledge of Agile metrics (velocity, cycle time, burn-up/down charts, cumulative flow diagrams) and the ability to build and interpret dashboards to support team performance and forecasting;
  • Tool proficiency in Azure DevOps (preferred) or Jira, particularly in backlog management, dashboards, and workflow configuration;
  • Possession of Scrum Master certifications: PSM II (or higher) and SAFe 5/6 Agilist;
  • Experience with one or more scaled Agile frameworks (SAFe, Nexus, LeSS, etc.) is considered as an asset;
  • Knowledge of integrating SAFe and Kanban approaches to optimize flow and delivery predictability is considered as an asset;
  • Excellent command of the English language.

Responsibilities

  • Organize and facilitate agile activities and ceremonies including daily stand-up meetings, sprint reviews, retrospectives, sprint and release planning, and product backlog refinement sessions;
  • Ensure that all meetings are positive, productive, stay on topic, and are kept within the timebox;
  • Collaborate closely with the product owner to manage the backlog;
  • Coach team and Product Owner on empiricism, value‑based backlog slicing, and incremental delivery;
  • Track and radiate flow metrics (velocity, sprint burndown, iteration burn rate) and guide the team in data‑driven improvement;
  • Champion and facilitate adoption of agile standards, tools, and best practices;
  • Proactively identify and resolve impediments to team progress;
  • Promote empowered, self‑organising teams, shared vision, psychological safety, collaborative decisions (e.g., Fist‑of‑Five);
  • Uphold Definition of Done, quality gates, and compliance with organisational standards;
  • Communicate with other SCRUM masters and product owners across the organization to ensure transparency into delivery progress, challenges, and risks;
  • Utilize team feedback and metrics (e.g., quality, delivery, cadence, etc.) to identify areas of opportunity and work with team to continuously improve;
  • Support the team in using agile planning and development tools (e.g. Azure DevOps, Confluence);
  • Experiment with new practices and frameworks to improve team outcomes;
  • Actively participate in learning opportunities such as communities of practice or conferences to improve skills and better support the team;
  • Contribute to the advancement and improvement of agile practices within the organization.

jobs.excerpt: About WonderlyWonderly gives Main Street businesses the AI agents, capital, and growth team they need to scale, and charges nothing for any of it.
jobs.description:
About Wonderly

Wonderly gives Main Street businesses the AI agents, capital, and growth team they need to scale, and charges nothing for any of it. We only get paid when our customers make real money. We’re here helping real small businesses make a life, pay for their children’s college tuition, and live the American dream. No surprise fees or gotchas.

We own the entire system of record, all business applications (we replace ServiceTitan, House Call Pro, RingCentral, Squarespace, Docusign, Square, and a dozen other applications), and dozens of AI agents ourselves embedded natively inside our business applications, with native data read & write access to our system of record. As a result, we can deploy dozens of production-ready AI Agents to our customers in under 30 minutes with no FDEs, no integrations, and no data cleaning work.

We are the most outcome driven business model in the business because we’ve proven our system and AI Agents work. We are not trying to sell our customers a dream - we deliver real revenue and profit to our customers. All of our software and AI Agents are free - we only charge a percent of revenue we deliver for our customers. Each of our 10+ core AI Agents help improve their revenue by 5-20%.

Wonderly already has PMF and has gone from 0 → 1 (we are happy to share more over a call), with very clear moat and deep industry knowledge that took a team of 70 hardcore A-players 18 months of stealth to build. We believe Wonderly has the potential to be a $100B - $1T outcome. The market is massive: home service businesses across North America (a $2T market). We’ve raised over $50M from top-tier investors, have $20M a year in free cashflow from another product line (Motion), and all that money gets pumped into Wonderly.

"AGI"

So you’ve been token maxxing and spending $4,000 a month on AI subscriptions. You’re vibe coding to the max, and sleeping barely 5 hours a day. You’ve embraced the polyphasic sleep cycle, so you can wake up in the middle of the night and press ‘Enter’ a couple times (I think that’s called harness engineering these days). And at the end of it, what exactly have you shipped? Have you made anyone’s life better?

If you are focused on technology purely for the sake of technology, then this is not the company for you. If you cannot tie your technology to real, obvious, business results, then this is not the company for you. In a world of slop factories, Wonderly had a radical idea: the purpose of software is to make someone’s life better. And in return, they pay you money.

Crazy, I know.

We are ruthlessly focused on helping small business owners in middle America put food on the table, send their children to college, and live the American Dream. And our customers love us for it.

Wonderly gives Main Street the AI agents, capital, and growth team they need to scale, and charges nothing for any of it. We only get paid when our customers make real money. No surprise fees or gotchas.

Who You Are

You are a technologist at heart.

  • Your dream vacation is tinkering and building something new. Every couple months you have a new side project. If you do not tinker, you cannot have taste.

  • You are someone who keeps up with technology for fun. If I pulled up your youtube feed, it would be littered with tech talks.

  • You explore new ways of building purely for the craft.

  • You’re able to work startup hours because work is fun. This is the type of career someone would have to pay you to not do.

You’re someone who’s guided engineering orgs before, and you know the importance of a steady hand. That doesn’t mean you’re afraid to make big calls when necessary.

You’re someone who’s thought deeply about engineering strategy. You have strong opinions about the SDLC, and how it changes in the age of AI.

Above all, you’re deeply practical. The world is a messy place. You work with the world how it is, not how it should be.

The Role

Wonderly is building the first enterprise grade dark software factory. We have 50 internal tools (and growing) built this way, and we are rapidly improving our own development methods based on feedback from this development process. We are extremely reluctant to use external vendors; with our internal tools factory, we have replaced ~50 vendors (and more will be replaced soon). We do this for three main reasons:

  1. Margin

Software is entering a low-margin era. Most of our customers’ margins are only 30-40%, and as a result, we cannot pay frivolously for vendors that we could easily replicate in-house ourselves.

With AI, the cost of building – and yes, maintaining – these tools in-house has dramatically decreased. Every dollar that we can save is a dollar more we can invest on behalf of our customers.

  1. Operational excellence

Stitching together well known tools can quickly bootstrap you to an MVP in terms of business and engineering processes, but as you scale, you’ll find yourself tied down to the lowest common denominator of what each of these tools allow you to do. As a result, you’ll naturally adopt sub-optimal processes, and this will drive down your operational excellence.

Every operational mistake costs our customers real money. We cannot afford for this to happen. As we rapidly scale, we must have maximum flexibility to choose the best process first, and build the tooling to enable that process after the fact.

  1. Software revolution

As AI continues to eat software and its production lifecycle, we need to have a semi-production environment to push the boundaries. We need a place where we can experiment without risking customer outages. I say semi-production because everything can work in a toy sandbox environment. Our internal tools on the other hand have real customers, real traffic, and numerous edge cases. It is complex enough to give a real sense of whether this will work without immediately putting our end customers at risk.

Many of the architectural and AI coding decisions we took in production were first started in our internal tools test bed.

Your role is the ultimate culmination of both the tinkering in internal tools and the maturity of actual production. We need both to co-evolve with each other. We’re looking for someone who is bringing technical excellence (real money is on the line here!) first and foremost, but can also peer into the future for what’s coming and position Wonderly for the AI native era.

You are capable of holding two opposing view points simultaneously: AI is going to change everything, and yet, most of what it produces today continues to be slop.

And your answer to the above paradox is ultimately going to be your roadmap in this company.
